lines.text: But... I bought so much butter!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This time you'll be taking a photo, and then we can frame it. Who knows what we'll catch?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That's true, dearie. The ocean is awfully deep. You never know what secrets you might dredge up...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Alright, let's go fishing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I'm sure we'll catch something with these...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm, maybe you're right. We should find some better rods!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well done, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: l... I wasn't actually expecting to catch anything!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That fish is almost as big as you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It's Julius' other boot! He's been looking for that for ages! Don't throw it away!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are we seriously going to keep it?!! This thing belongs in the trash!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This fish looks really fast! I'm surprised I caught it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Are you sure you can pick it up? Maybe you can sit next to it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No... No-... I got this! l... ugh.. HAVE YOU TAKEN THE PICTURE YET?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oooh, a Red Snapper!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: A very tasty fish! Can't we just keep this one at least?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grab that camera, Grandma. Remember, this is catch and release!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wowee, those spines look sharp!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Quick Maddie, let me take this photo before you pierce yourself!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This'll up our fishing game!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That's a fancy-looking rod you have there. Looks complicated too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The manual was over forty-eight pages long! I loved it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at this fish, Grandma! Isn't it great?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It's magnificent! I guess your fancy gear really helped!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Now nothing can stop us from catching the most epic offish!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Good grief, dearie! You look like someone out ofa fishing magazine.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's right! The title would read, "Maddie Boulton: EPIC Fisher!"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's no hiding from me now, big fish. This rod has your name on it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I remember hearing a story once about a fisher catching something very large and rare with a rod like that...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This one was quite the battle, but I got it in the end!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I swear I almost saw you get pulled off the side twice...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I almost did! It was so exciting!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: How heavy did you say that fish was?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How come?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well, according to the fish guide, you just beat the world record!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Everything is ready to catch us some big fish!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hahaha! You sound like your Grandpa Charlie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: He had such big fish stories. Swore he caught the Loch Ness Monster, once.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a struggle! She gave me quite a fight!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: She?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Female Blue Marlins are sometimes four times larger than males!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And this one is HUGE!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You caught a Hopewell Pollock!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And a big one, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Get ready to smile to the camera! Cheeeeese!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I caught a Greater Amberjack!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Did you know that it has also been called a 'donkey fish' and 'sailors choice'?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I bet it has a fascinating history.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: And it props up my position in our little competition nicely!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whooooah, a swordfish! Can you handle it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Phew! There is still some strength left in this old lady but... nnggh... maybe a bit of help would not hurt!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a specimen! You definitely take the lead with that whopper.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It would make so many tasty pies...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's time to release it, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Don't tell me we're going fishing - AGAIN!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This time will be totally different. It's spring!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I am not buying it... Can I at least actually keep the fish I catch this time?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You're so funny, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I was not trying to be funny...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Fishing is a big part of Hopewell Bay's history, Grandma - you know that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We're just keeping the tradition alive.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, alright! Let the fishing commence!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder if there are sharks in these wat... WHOA!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hold on! You caught a big one, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hnnngg... Take... the photo... already!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This snook put up quite a fight!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well done, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: They say snook are excellent culinary fish.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Couldn't we just take it home?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No, Grandma. Just no.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can feel that fish watching us...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is a curious creature, and no mistake!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think it's time for it to return to the depths. It's creeping me out!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The Atlantic halibut is really overfished, so you are right.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Goodbye, big guy!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Wooooow, is that a fish or a whale??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think we need a bigger boat!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What an adorable little fish!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You don't see that many red fish.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: How about the red snapper?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: And the red emperor?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How do you know so much about fish all ofa sudden?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whoa! Look out for that spike!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Actually, it is called a "bill. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It looks sharp, whatever it's called!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Watch your fingers - that slippery guy bites!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And it's putting up a fight, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Eeeek - he can go back...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Where did you get that fishing rod??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: They say to get the right tools for the job.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What are you hoping to catch - a humpback whale?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: WHAT is that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let me check the guidebook... I think it is a mola mola!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Poor little guy! It looks like just a fish head with no tail.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I bet it would still be tasty!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You guessed it -- it's time to...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: ...t-to go fishing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Are you feeling alright, dearie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, just a bit light-headed... Like something seems a bit off somehow...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We should really get going. There is plenty offish to catch and release!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Y-yes, just snap a photo and let them go!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Are you ready?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Err... Let's fish!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well done, dearie! You caught a big one!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Err... What kind offish is that??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is a mummyfish! Very rare and interesting.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, ofc-course!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This one is putting up a REAL fight!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And it looks REALLY mean!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: B-but... Is that a jack-o'-lantern??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Naturally! It is called thejack-o'-angler, after all.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've never caught an octopus in these waters.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How do you catch one with a fishing rod, anyway??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But it is adorable, isn't it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whoooah!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm... speechless. Is that a... catfish?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, and a very attractive one, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This is getting weirder by the moment...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What IS going on??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma...!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, dear?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's a fish in the boat!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The terrafish is able to crawl as well as swim. It is a real super fish!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I've got one, Grandma...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is it a koi carp or a dragon??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Isn't it obvious? It's a dragon koi!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But don't worry - it does not breathe fire.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Do you believe in mermaids, dear?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't think so...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Look what I caught!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aaaaaah!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: WHAT is that in the water?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I think you just spotted the most elusive fish in the sea...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I d-did??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That fish is called Grandma-grandma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hold on. Am I dreaming??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maybe...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Good morning, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You guessed it - it's time to go f---
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Are you feeling alright?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm not feeling up for fishing today...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I just had the weirdest dream full of the weirdest fish.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It was so vivid!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Sounds like Halloween is playing tricks on you, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This fish is putting up a fight! Feels like we've been reeling it for a month!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is coming closer, and I think I just saw a flash of silver!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Does that mean...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It's a bluefin tuna!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a monster! I-is that a black drum?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I think it is!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I thought it was much smaller - like a salmon.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Not quite!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've got one and it... it's big!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Can you reel it in?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm... trying!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Almost there! Just a little... bit... more...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes!! A giant sea bass!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: And a big one, too. It could be almost a hundred years old.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So your generation, then!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Very funny.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I caught a cod!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You know, cod is an excellent culinary fish...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: How about we finally take one home to make a nice pie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Catch and release, remember?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, fine!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did you see that??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I think we've got a sailfish on the hook!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You mean the fastest fish in the ocean? THAT sailfish?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The very same!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is there a fish you've always wanted to catch?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I've always hoped we might catch a black marlin on one ofour fishing trips.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: They're very impressive fish, challenging to catch, so I am not hopeful we will ever...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Huh! I think I've got something pretty big on my hook...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes, you do! And it's a black marlin!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Nice catch, Grandma? Is it a dorado?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: No, the color is wrong and fins look different... I think this is a permit.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Permit? How on earth did you know that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Always be prepared, dearie, and do your research!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whoa, did you see that silvery fish?? It was fast. And BIG!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What in the world was it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think we're about to find out. I've got it on the hook!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Nnng... It's putting up quite a fight.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Come on, dearie! Put some muscle into it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ha! I got it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You caught an Albacore, a type of tuna. A very nice catch, indeed!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yikes, what a looker! That has to be a Halibut!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I just can't get over those weird eyes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Now, Halibut is a tasty fish! Especially delicious with some potatoes and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: One day you will let me take one home.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Dearie, I think I got a big one!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you want me to reel it in for you, Grandma?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I am old, not infirm! Just be ready with the net.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Got it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It looks like a huge snapper! Look at those teeth!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Not bad, if I do say so myself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is that a... shark?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: My dear, that's a Sailfish.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Err, let's see... Ah, a Pacific Sailfish to be exact!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How did you...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Know that? I recognize it by its lovely blue back!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I have also been doing some light reading. We go fishing often enough that I want to be well informed.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Very impressive, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: This is a promising start!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I-is it? What is that anyway? A fish or a... bat?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: A Crimson-lipped Batfish! Look at those ears!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A fish with ears?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I caught something! I think it looks like some kind of shark.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Don't give up! Keep reeling it in.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I got it! But what is it??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: No wonder it put up a fight! It's a Hobgoblin Shark.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The meanest fish in these waters!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Can you hear howling?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well, well! There must be a Werefish nearby!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?? There is no such thing as a Werefish! And fish can't howl!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This must be a weird dream or something...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: If this were a dream, could I pinch you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ouch!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Come on, and catch the Werefish in the net so we can take a photo!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is it time to go home yet? I'm getting a really spooky feeling out here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: AAAH! What's that weird blob floating in the water? A j-jellyfish?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: A Blob Fish, dearie! We're lucky to catch one. Usually they're only seen...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: In your worst nightmares?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The conditions are perfect for catching a Count Squidula.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wh... You know, I'm not even going to ask.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are you talking about a squid that looks like a vampire?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You're catching on, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, my! This is a feisty one... a Dog Snapper, if I'm not mistaken!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You're right. Look at those teeth!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It has a bit of an overbite, hasn't it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma! That's not very nice!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What? I think it is charming.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What is this one? It has a striped back...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A Striped Bass! Good catch, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Not caught yet. It is putting up a fight.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You got it! Nice work.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Quite the workout! No wonder they call it sport fishing...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I think we've got a shark on the line.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: And it's a fighter!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I think you are right!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's a kind of mackerel shark. You can tell by the white patch on the back of its dorsal fin.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Aren't you a shark-Sherlock...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: My goodness, will you look at that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Careful! I can take the picture from here, no need to reel it all the way in!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What is it? It looks like...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A Stingray! A Pelagic Stingray to be precise. Careful of that tail!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Do not worry, dearie. I have dodged worse in my time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: This is a big one. I might need a little help here!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at those fins! They're spiky!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: So, what have we got here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's a Misty Grouper, it's very rare to find it at this depth.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Those stripes remind me of old-style convict overalls. Stylish!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oops. Looks like it escaped!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Aha! I know this one. It is an Atlantic Sturgeon.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So it is! Did you know they can live up to sixty years? They're living fossils.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That is fascinating! And did you know that Sturgeon caviar is delicious?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The Boultons used to can it, you know. Called it Black Gold.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let the sturgeon go, Grandma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, fine. Spoilsport.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Gosh, look at that tail! That's a Thresher Shark!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is definitely trashing about...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They use their tails like whips, stunning small fish.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But they're harmless to humans. We're much too big for them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I think this one might give us a try... watch out!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Hello, Mrs. Boulton!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Emilio? What are you doing here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Ah, Maddie couldn't make it, but she didn't want you to miss your fishing trip!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: So she wondered if I could take you instead.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I see. Are you going to let me actually keep the fish?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Keep... the fish? To do what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, nevermind. And call me Grandma. Everyone else does.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Umm, okay then. Let's get going! This is going to be so exciting!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Ah! Look at those teeth! Do you know what it is, Mrs. Boulton?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Grandma. That's... a barracuda. And a big one at that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Exactly right - it's a Great Barracuda, the biggest of its kind! Look at that bullet shape.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Perfect for hunting! They can swim in bursts at nearly forty miles per hour.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Lots of muscle on it then, I gather?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Oh yes! Ah - there it went! Too bad. I would've liked to measure it... some can be over five feet long!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Oh, looks like I caught a...boot?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: I'm glad we got it out of the sea. Less trash in our oceans.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I have something for you, Emilio. A new fishing rod!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: This looks professional. Where did you get it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, you know. A lady has got to have her secrets.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Mrs. Boulton! Look at what you've caught! That's a Totoaba!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That's... a really big fish! Are you sure it's not some kind of tuna?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: No, no. But it is very lost if it's in Hopewell Bay: they only live in the GulfofCalifornia!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Be careful, Mrs. Boulton - they are very endangered.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It looks... very tasty...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Actually, it's not hunted for its meat. It's hunted for its swim bladder - a kind of organ that helps it float.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It definitely doesn't want to float for me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Let it go, Mrs. Boulton. Godspeed, Totoaba! I hope you find your way back home.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Look at what you've caught! Incredible!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is definitely putting up a fight! What is it - an eel?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: A Green Moray Eel, to be precise! A native of coral reefs and warm climates. A voracious predator!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It looks poisonous.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: No, no, it just excretes a kind of green mucus that colors it. It's actually very interesting--
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That doesn't sound very palatable. Back in you go!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Ah. Well. I hope it finds its way back home. Hopewell Bay is not where you belong.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Huh? Emilio, what's this thing I caught? It is... rather weird.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Oh! That's a European Monkfish, or Lophius piscatorius. A type ofangler fish!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hold on a second... I think I might have seen a skeleton ofone of these somewhere in the Mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Perhaps you have an ancestor who had a culinary interest? Their tails are reportedly quite delicious.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I don't know about ancestors, but I know I do... Oh You let it go.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Ofcourse! I got a great picture too! Isn't this fun?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hupp! I got a shark on the line! A very funnily colored shark!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Ah! You've caught a Lemon Shark! Quick, let's take a picture and let it return to its friends!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It brought friends?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Lemon Sharks are very social - although this one is quite far from its habitat. Curious.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh-ho, this isn't anything yet. You should see what we've dredged out of the depths here, my dear...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: This is what I'm talking about! Oh, the specimens we'll be able to catch with this...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I remember hearing a story once about a fisherman catching something very large and rare with a rod like that...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Umm. Mrs. Boulton, what... is that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: My fishing rod, Emilio. What does it look like?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: ...you do know whale-fishing is illegal, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: That is a Mola Mola, also known as an ocean sunfish! Amazing catch!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Poor little guy! It looks like just a fish head with no tail.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Not so little! They are fascinating fish, even if... a little funny-looking!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Incredible! Look at that - a Smalltooth Sawfish! How is this possible?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It's probably not going to be the oddest thing you find here. Look at that sword!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Did you know they are actually a type of ray? Their mouth and gills are all on the underside of their bodies!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Huh. Anyway, not what you expected to see, is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: No, but I'm incredibly happy to see one so far north! They used to range much further than they do now.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Overfishing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Not really - bycatching. Caught accidentally when fishing for other fish. Which is why...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: ...we better release this one now. Bye-bye, Mr. Sawfish! Best of luck!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Emiiliooo...! I have got a beast on the line!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Oh! Ah-hah! Incredible! You've caught a dinosaur!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Again?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: That's a Bluntnose Sixgill Shark! Look - it has six gills! Most modern sharks only have five.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: ...also what do you mean again?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Let's just say it's not the first 'living fossil' I've caught.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Better be careful. They've been known to attack submarines.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Back into the water with you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well now! No one can say you don't look ready to take on even the biggest fish, Emilio.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: I feel like a sports fisherman! Is all of this really necessary?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It suits you. And it's all for the science, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Perfect! With this, our scientific journey of discovery can begin!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You mean our fishing trip.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: This is about the science, Mrs. Boulton, and these tools will make sure it is as painless as possible for the fish.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This place is stunning! So much gold and glitz... underneath all the dust and grime, that is.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: I see your endeavors to reclaim the grandeur of your past home have come to a head, Ma'am.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: While your efforts in restoring the other rooms are admirable, I honestly believe that this room is a lost cause...
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: No one will EVER be visiting Beaumont Hall again!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What do you mean?
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: He means, the wonderful old days of this mansion holding amazing dinner parties are over.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Dinner parties?
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Tell me more about these dinner parties.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Oh, sweetie! Some ofthe most influential people used to dine within these very walls!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: "USED TO", being the operative phrase.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Hmph! Ignore the old buffoon, Maddie. He's just bitter he can't serve the president like he used to.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: P- President?!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Oh yes, sweetie! I'm sure you'll find some trinkets from then amongst this trash. It seems as if Winston here hasn't bothered to clean up.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: I beg your pardon, Debbie, but while you were gallivanting across Europe and who knows where...
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: I have been doing MY best to take care of "YOUR" legacy!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That's enough, Mr. Winston!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What was all that about, Grandma? Why were those two fighting?
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, you know my sister can be a bit "much" sometimes!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No, this seems personal. Does Winston have a grudge against her?
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aww! The whole family together. There's grandpa and Leonard and... wait!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Deb's missing! That's quite strange. Was it deliberate?
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This grand piano certainly isn't "grand", anymore but a little love and a lot of tuning can do wonders!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Hi Maddie, Winston let me in and... Wait, is everything okay? You look upset.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's this Mansion. Ever since I've opened it, in hopes to clear Grandma's name, I've been learning... things.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: What kind of things?
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Things about my family that are beginning to make me understand why Grandma kept them secret from me, for all these years.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Haha! Oh, Roddy!! Thank you, but I don't think our secrets can even compare.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I find it hard to believe that a president was within these very walls!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: He stopped in Hopewell Bay when he was on tour.
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: The Boultons entertained him for an evening, and he even stayed in this house overnight!
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's amazing! I wonder what they talked about, over dinner, that night?
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, why is there a baby chair here?
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No way! But, come to think ofit, I do have some vague memories of this room...
lines.author: fredcurtis

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello, can I help you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: No, my child... It is I who has come to help... YOU!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh... Kay
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maddie, dearie! I see you have met my old friend, Lady Voyance.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: She's a psychic, you know!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Really? How interesting! Came here to give Grandma a reading?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: For heaven's sake, no! I have come to help all of Hopewell Bay! I sense a great change in the future!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Ursula has graciously let me set up my services temporarily, so that I may help everyone in need.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: . Especially you, Maddie. I can sense that something amazing is in store for you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Really?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Yes, my child! Love is in the air!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait... You read people's fortunes from...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A SNOW GLOBE?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Yes, my child! The snowflakes react to the strands of fate that bind us all...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: And so, I read the unique patterns of their fall.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: . It's a snow globe! But..
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Hello, my child! Come to have your fortune told?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: My fortune? No, I just came over to ask if Ma-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Shh! Let me consult the snow! You are here to see... Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Yes... She here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: No, my child, your paths do not cross at this time...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I'm not a child. My name is-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Shh! I sense your name is... Jackie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Incredible... Exactly what is written on my press badge.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Ah... A skeptic.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: A reporter.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I sense GREEEAT conflict in your future!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Hi... I'm uuuh, here to see the psychic?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Yes, my child... I knew you would come.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Y- You did?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Ofcourse! The globe never lies... And for you, I see wonderful things ahead!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Finally!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I sense that you've been waiting for a looong time too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: l... I have!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Do not worry, my child... Your wait is almost over.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Oh wow!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Ah, Maddie! Please, step inside.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello, Lady Voyance! I guess I'm ready for my reading now.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I know, my child... Let us begin
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I see a great loss in your life. Oh, poor thing, you've lost so much! But yet...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Despite it all, you've gained a lot more in return. Perhaps even things you do not yet know you have!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What does that mean?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Shh! The globe still SPEAKS to me! I see that you are searching for... Something.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Actually, I'm looking for something to help Gran-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Love!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Love?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Yes! And your search is almost over, for love has found.... YOU!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?! who?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
