lines.text: Blow me down! A whole chest full ofgold!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: And the chest has the same 'B' as the doubloons...
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: So there were pirates in the Boulton family!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: There's no mistaking it now.
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Pirates sail here, so att landlubbers better beware!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Are you ready for an adventure?
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yes and it will be EPIC! Only...
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Don't get me wrong. I love it! Its better than I ever could have imagined, but...
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Don't tell me.
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: there's no Monkey Cave.
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: So the stories of pirates in the Boulton family are true...
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: And I found their ULTIMATE pirate treasure!!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I'm... RICH!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Thus ends the epic adventure of Captain Mason, the terror of the Seven Seas.
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: It's PERFECT!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: The ship, the cannons, the lake, the MONKEY CAVE!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Yes, it's more than I had planned for, but...
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: It really is glorious. And there's some very interesting sealife in there, too. Did you notice... Maddie!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ohoy! I can't believe you've built all this!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Well, Emilio did help a little.
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Well, adventure calls! See you later, you scallywags!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Safe travels, young Mason!
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: HARRR! That's Captain Mason, if you don't mind.
lines.author: rmagic

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Have you ever been on a pirate adventure, Roddy?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I can't say that I have. Why?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Grandma Ursula told me about pirates in her family, and their ship ran aground, so they had to abandon their treasure...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: But there's a LOG BOOK!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Destiny is calling Captain Mason to search for it, but I need a first mate tojoin me on this quest.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: This is a real antique coin, Mason!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Boring! We're looking for gold!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I guess we'll keep searching...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: This is really historical. Maybe we should show these to an expert...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: MAYBE we should keep looking for the treasure!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yes! A mega high-powered battery. This is exactly what we need!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I-is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yes, for the metal detector!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Metal detector?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: To find the key.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: The key? I thought we already have the map!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: We do, but we need a key for the chest that contains the lost log book!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: And now we search?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Now we search.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Bingo! We found the key!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Well done, Roddy. You make a great first mate.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Why thank you, Captain!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Look at this - a complete pirate captain's costume!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: That sword still looks really sharp. Can I have it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: No, Mason.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Wood, nails, rope, an anchor... What else do I need to build a MEGA pirate ship?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Emilio made building a ship look really easy. I wish I had someone to help me...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Hello, Mason! Planning a building project?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Roddy! Yeah, it's going to be an EPIC pirate ship. What brings you here on this fine day?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I-I was just down the road on business and thought I'd come and see how Maddie is getting on with the renovations.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Say, Roddy... Do you wanna help me build this ship? I could sure use a hand!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well, I'm an architect, so I don't really know anything about building ships.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I understand. I guess it takes special expert to do that... Like Emilio.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: But it's 0K. I'm sure you're really busy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Emilio...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: What's that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Never mind. I'll help you. Where do we begin?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Those pirates ended up sailing into a big storm... We'll need to be prepared for the worst, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Right-o, captain! With this equipment we'll be safe and sound.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Let's pack it all up and head out!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Aye-aye!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: So you have... a map to find this treasure?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Ofcourse I do!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I drew it myself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Grandma was so cool to tell me about this secret!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Grandma Ursula revealed a secret? That's a first...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Let's see what the log book says!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: "It has been most terrible of late... My crew constantly grumble about the quality of food and stale ship biscuits... "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I would totally complain about stale biscuits, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: More treasure? Oh, these are just old clocks.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: They look kinda valuable...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Forget about them. Who cares about some dusty antiques, when we're searching for ACTUAL pirate treasure!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Do I really have to wear this?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Emilio totally would've...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I'll do it. *Sigh* Hand it over.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Listen to this:
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: "The island rose from the mist like the hump of an angry whale. Everything about it looked menacing, but we had no choice but to head for it. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Oooh, I can't take the suspense!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Why are we going to a costume store?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: We need the right outfits if we wanna pass for real pirates, of course!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I can see the old ship!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: "It is here we left our treasure, in the hopes that we can return to fetch it later. If that does not come to pass, I can only hope that it is found by a worthy sailor. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: We did it!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: The treasure! Mason, we found the treasure!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: We totally did! Oh, there's a note...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: "Well done, me hearties. You completed your quest with great bravery. Now come over for some apple pie! - Grandma Ursula"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I think we've been pranked!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Oh, dagnabbit! Grandma Ursula's always one step ahead...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: But I had the best time anyway!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Me too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hey, Maddie! Is everything 0K with Grandma Ursula?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There are so many ways to answer that... Why do you ask?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Erm, there are a bunch of big motorcycles outside her house! But they look oddly... cozy and sweet.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... I know she loves her bike, but that sounds pretty wild, even for her!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I think we need to find out what's going on. Let's just sneak a little bit closer and take a look...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at that! Grandma's house is full of old ladies having tea - in full biker gear!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Grannies of Anarchy... I've heard rumblings about this gang. I should have guessed your Grandma is involved somehow!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma's in a BIKER GANG? What is she - Easy Rider?! What are they whispering about, anyway?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Eavesdropping on your own Grandma, Maddie? I'm so here for it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Uh-oh... Did you hear that? I'm pretty sure one of them just said something about... a MURDER!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did you just hear those ladies whisper something about a murder?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: They are a biker gang, but murder? Then again, those knitting needles look pretty sharp...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What are they doing - drawing up a biker granny hit list?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think we need to dig a little deeper. Come on, Jackie. Let's see what these biking buddies are up to!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maddie, what on earth are you doing sneaking around?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Err... We were just admiring these impressive motorbikes on your drive.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I didn't know you were expecting guests, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: There's plenty you don't know, dearie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: These are my friends. We are all members ofa little hobby group.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well, we all enjoy a good kicker with some farkle, but a citizen like you would probably not understand such things.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That was biker slang. This is our biker gang, the Grannies of Anarchy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Ha! So I was right!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Tell us more, Grandma! When did you join your biker gang?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ohl we've been flying our colors for decades.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The world was different when we founded the club, and we yearned for the freedom of the open road...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: So, we decided to put together a group of like-minded ladies to challenge the more... traditional views.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What an amazing story, Ursula. An all-female biker gang is a totally rebellious idea.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And the knitted decorations on your bikes are really amazing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We do know a thing or two about knitting... and rebellion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: When we started our motorcycle club, people just did not take us seriously.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: So, we were forced to break the rules every now and again.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We did ruffle some feathers, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Your biker club looks like a wild bunch! But what exactly do you do?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Burn rubber and stand up against the man, ofcourse!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh? So things sometimes get out of hand?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Whatever do you mean?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Does your gang dabble with anything... criminal?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Murder?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Murder?? You should get your ears checked, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ohl now I understand. My friend Mama said that we need a new recorder. You must have misheard her!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess that could've been it, but...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That's settled then!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a relief! They're just a group of nice old ladies.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Who happen to ride around on big bikes and wear leatherjackets!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Your Grandma is full of surprises!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She certainly is...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So, you don't think they are really involved in anything shady?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I guess not. But what would a biker gang need a recorder for?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It's time for us to get our domes on and grab a handful.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That means that we are going take off for a drive, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I gathered that, Grandma. You and your friends are quite an impressive bunch!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Thank you! You can forget about any crimes. The Grannies of Anarchy always ride on the right side of the law.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I still feel like you're not telling me everything. There's more to your skillfully knitted patches than you let on...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Some of us were just born to be wild, Maddie, dearest.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Lady Voyance! How are the snows of fate swirling these days?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Destiny has steered me back to this place. My snow globe is downright VIBRATING with energy!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: All the signs tell me there is something MYSTERIOUS afoot here, Ursula. Suspicious even!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Erm, suspicious? I think your snowglobe has cracked...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maddie! You remember my dear friend, Lady Voyance?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Aaah, Maddie! The signs are still STRONG with you, my child!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I have come to share with you the message of fate once more.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I also offer birth charts and homemade charm bracelets. Pretty AND well priced!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sounds great, but first I'd like to hear about my future... And I have some questions!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The house inside your snow globe is cute!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Not cute, my child! It is mysterious and enigmatic!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: This little book tells me which way the STARS are turning!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm not sure it works like that...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Everything is ready, but the globe is still silent...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe it's broken?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Oh NO, my child! ltjust needs a good shake!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: The future is BRIGHT, my child! Bright purple!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I wonder whether Ursula might let me set up shop on her driveway...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ehem!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Well, maybe not!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Well, well, well... The globe has taken me to the past!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: You were quite the artist, I see!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow!! I made everyone's xmas presents on that crafting table! They were... original.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I always bring extra candles!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: The flames of my candles shed a light on paths of fate...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And they have a very pleasant scent, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: You must know where you ARE to see where you are GOING, my child!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: The "Little Sister"! Adorable, isn't it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I see... a tasty loaf of bread? No, no... It is an arm cast.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: You should be careful in the garden, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: The cards are as right as their reader. So you have absolutely nothing to worry about!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Is it true? Is Lady Voyance back to divine our futures?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, Roddy! She is indeed. Are you going to ask her to tell your fortune?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: She predicted something pretty interesting for me last time - maybe something romantic.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I just wonder if she meant what I THOUGHT she meant... Do you think...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe you'll find someone who shares your love of hard hats and architecture!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Oh, yeah! Maybe...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She really is a character, isn't she!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: She sure is.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Your future looks VERY interesting - you may grow a BEARD!
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I hope not! Is there anything else?
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Well, there might be some wedding rings and burning matches as well.
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sounds oddly famdtar.. . Events I would rather not think about.
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But why would those old events appear in my future?
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Do you have time for another client, Lady Voyance?
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Of course! I am here to help ALL who want a glimpse of their fate!
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Great! You told my fortune last time you were here and...
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: You said that I've waited for a long time and that my wait would be over soon?
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Did I really? Let's see what the globe conveys...
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: No. I think I must have read the globe upside down - it happens!
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Hmm... I see SOMETHING powerful headed your way... Possibly indigestion...
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Something to look forward to, anyway!
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Ah, the most handsome constellation in the sky!
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: They say it brings good luck to those who see it.
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: So, Maddie... You've come to hear what the snowglobe knows?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess I have...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Last time you mentioned that you sensed love in my future...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: interpret the signs in the globe... What it is
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I see a big house... a MANSION even! Does that sound familiar?
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Erhm... well, yes.
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Ah, yes.
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: So you want to know about love! Let's me see...
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Oh, sands past, present and future - show me what A WAITS my young friend!
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I see... someone tall, dark and HANDSOME... and his name is ummm...
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Umm... Emilio??
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: O-ohyes, it IS Emilio!
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Do you KNOW someone called Emilio?
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, kind of... But now what should I do?
lines.author: s_6499

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: ALAS, the sands of the globe have seized!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Voyance! I think I got what I wanted.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: The pleasure is ALL mine, my child! Go forth and seek your happiness with Emilio!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thanks, Lady Voyance!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Oh, what is this? The sands are stirring, forming a name... Arthur? It is probably nothing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: sooo, did Lady Voyance tell you something exciting?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She certainly did! Her snowglobe is not the most reliable thing, but I don't know...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe she is right this time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well, at least 20% right. You never know, Maddie. You never know!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Looks like it's the holiday season again, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, dearie! I can't wait to make my special holiday pie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ooh! Is it the one with cinnamon, hopeberries and oranges?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That's the one! I know little Mason has always wanted to try it, so I thought I'd surprise him.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's sweet.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Not as sweet as my pie, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It's getting cold, let's head inside... Brrr...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Oh, man... Grandma has been so awesome this year! And now she's making me pie?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I wonder what she would want for this holiday season?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These ornaments will look great on our tree, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Can't go wrong with the classics, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Getting into the holiday spirit, I see!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes... I guess...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's wrong? I think it looks lovely, if not hectic.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well, you see...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I didn't do it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What? Then... Who did?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: How pretty, sis!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It wasn't me! Someone is coming over and decorating my home in secret!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Is... Is that bad?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: No.... No, I guess not. But I'm wondering who it might be!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Well... When they're done, tell them to do my house too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: That tree doesn't look structurally sound. Hmm...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Looks like a croquembouche! I bet they built it around a mold and the structure supports itself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Wow. Didn't think of it like that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I used to do desserts as a hobby. Big showy ones and gingerbread houses, mostly.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: But I guess, it's really my love of architecture and structural design. Desserts were just a way for me to express myself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: R- Really?! You love architecture?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Come on Roddy... My first article was on the architectural designs of Hopewell Bay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: l... I never realized!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So, who do you think is behind this?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I have a theory...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, I did...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I heard you figured it out!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, dearie... Mason? You can come out from behind the bushes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Oh! Hello, Grandma... I guess you figured it out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I did. But I have to say, you had me going for a while! That's a hard thing to do!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Really?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You bet, Mason! It's really rare to fool Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Oh, cool!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh Mason...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Why would you go through all this trouble, dearie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Well... You know... I've had so much fun around here in the past year... The spooky summer camp, the swimming pool.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Not to mention the awesome pirate ship! I just...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I just wanted to give something back.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well, I love it! Thank you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Happy holidays, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Happy holidays, Mason!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: It's the season of good cheer... and gingerbread! But who makes it the most scrumptious? Let's find out!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Although everyone knows my gingerbread is the tastiest...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maybe we'll let the people decide, Cherry? Besides, mine has been a firm favorite for decades.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look! I found something interesting in the Boulton attic! It looks like a really old recipe book.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What does it say here? "The Best Gingerbread Recipe Ever Written?"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Someone has scribbled stuff around it... "Add a pinch of magic and stir through"?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: What do you say if we skip the competition this year and bake together with this recipe instead?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I suppose it is the season for peace and goodwill to all bakers... Why not?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: This recipe looks REALLY old! Do you know who could've written it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: No idea... But they clearly knew what they are doing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: This thing does not seem to be working.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Did you try turning it on and offagain?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There! Now we're in business!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Let's see if we can bake a batch...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: I think we left them in the oven for too long...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You think?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: This is just like my trusted stove!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: My great-grandmother had one just like it, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Did you plug it in?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ofcourse, I did! Try turning the knobs again...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: I see a light - in the oven, I mean!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It's working! I hope this gingerbread does not burn...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The stove is nice and hot - in you go!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: What?? Oh, you mean the gingerbread...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: When it comes to decorating gingerbread, less is definitely NOT more!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Not bad, Cherry! It just needs a roof and the rest of the walls!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Ursula, what an adorable little house! I would add just a SMIDGE more icing...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That is a very impressive gingerbread house, Cherry! But it has no chimney...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Use your creativity and don't spare the icing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Wow, you've truly outdone yourself, Ursula! This could be difficult to beat.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Phew, what a masterpiece - and we did it together!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Indeed! Just like the recipe said.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Remember to add candy cane and lots of sprinkles!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: The book might just be right. This gingerbread is GREAT!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hmm, you are right. It is making me feel... all warm and fuzzy inside.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Maybe there really is a pinch of magic in there...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ha-ha! Maybe there is!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: But next year, I will show you the best gingerbread recipe...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Just have another gingerbread and enjoy the moment, will you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Here we go!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That tree looks awfully small...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, yes, but we're on the right track.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let'sjust keep looking!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This one seems more promising!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I knew we had a bigger tree! It's better to have a tree you can use year after year, you know, instead of cutting down a brand-new tree every year.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You've got that right, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Very nice, indeed! I just think...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That it needs more ornaments?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Exactly!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think we have everything we need for the tree.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: There's ornaments, tinsel, the star... Looking good to me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But this isjust the start. I'm curious to see what else we'll find...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Another door!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you have the key to open it, Grandma?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ofcourse I do, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder what's on the other side! Family secrets, lost treasures...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Apart from all the dust and cobwebs?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow! This room is FULL of stuff.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I think it's time we clear some space in here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But all of this stuff is perfectly good... Do we have to give it away?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Reduce, reuse, recycle, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you remember what a great time we had at your birthday party?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Mmm, yes. Even though I said I didn't really need a party...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You had a great time, I know it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I admit, I have had worse!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What an elegant bottle! Wasn 't this a birthday present from Julius?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It was! He does have impeccable taste.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Someone is going to be so happy to have this!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think 'podcaster' is the number one dream profession among 12-year-olds today.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Is it really??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, maybe not. But hopefully someone will get some use out of this stuff!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: They say that fashion comes back in cycles.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then this stuff should be pretty trendy soon!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You can't beat the classics, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's this... Looks liks something's fallen behind the boxes...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Got it! This doesn't look like it belongs in a dusty basement...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I've been looking for this everywhere!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look what I found in a box with all the bags and hats! What a beautiful watch.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I remember that one! If I remember correctly, you can dive to 100 meters while wearing it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe someone has more use for it than you, Grandma...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Another door!! This place IS like a maze!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: A house like this doesn't give up its secrets easily. You should know that, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, the only way is forward.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: People complain about winter being cold...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: They are just not dressed approriately!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We have a whole bunch of lovely holiday cards, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's enough here to send a greeting to all of our friends.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Let's send them. After all, good friends are card to find!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Spinning tops, toy trains, puppets... This basement is like Santa's workshop.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It does seem like it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's wrap it all up for a holiday delivery!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at all of these old toys!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I've got an idea! Why don't we wrap these up and give them to Mason's class? That nice boy deserves a little holiday surprise!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Let's do it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Tape, ribbon, paper... Here's everything we need to wrap the presents.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You know, I am excellent at wrapping presents. Do you want to have a little wrapping race?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't think that's in the spirit of the season, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, boy. There's a lot to wrap!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But we did find a LOT of treasures to give away. Now they can be treasured by someone else!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: All done!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The basement is a little bit neater, we've got plenty of great presents all wrapped up, and we found the decorations.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Not bad, I have to admit.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You know what would be perfect right now?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: A mug ofeggnog?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes, with an extra candy cane!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This really is the best holiday. Even the treats are better!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I completely agree. Here's to the holidays, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's make it the best yet!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Dashing through the snow, do-do-doo-bee-doo...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You seem to be full of the season's cheer, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't help it! It's the snow, the atmosphere, the...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Mulled Hopeberryjuice?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ha! I really want to spread the happiness.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That sounds like a delightful idea! And you 100k like you already have a plan...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well... you're right! Julius told me that there used to be a caroling troupe in Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They were just a bunch of folks from all kinds of backgrounds who wanted to promote the holiday spirit.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: oh, I remember them! They played all kinds of instruments and sang... sometimes a bit too long for my liking!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Who will you ask to join you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Just friends like Roddy, Julius, Deb, Mason... Maybe Emilio....
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Sounds like you'll have a lot of fun!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: What's the name of our group?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sleigh Bell Serenaders!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Too much? How about... the Fa-la-la-la Follies?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: That's better!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: How's your rhythm?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Excellent, I assure you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Then you'll play the tambourine!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then a bit of sparkle...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: You can never have too much!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Why don't you join our caroling troupe?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Who else is in it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Everyone! If you join, you'll be paid in gingerbread and good cheer...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You had me at candy cane.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This looks great, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Thank you, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You could even say you're "sleigh-in' it. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Unfortunately, I can't wear this. It does not go with my colors...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think green and red are very becoming on you, Deb!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Do you really... Well, if you say so!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We really are wrapping up warm.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I don't want you to catch a cold. God forbid you all lose your voice!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think we have enough stockings for everyone.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Can mine be extra big?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Oh, schnikes! I bet I'll get helmet hair from wearing this crown!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Somehow I think you don't have to worry about that...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: How does this open?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We both hold one end and... pull!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Don't trip over the cello!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: You can trust me, Maddie. I never trip over...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oops...

lines.text: What a weird-looking trumpet!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: I think it's a bassoon.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I'll take care of the harp, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow, sounds good! Can you... play it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: There's a lot you don't know about me...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No kidding!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This is it! Are you ready to sing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Gulp! Let's do it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: One, two, three, four...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: What an unexpected present...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well, you always need socks!

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: This one's been twisted into knots.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Looks like Rufus got his wish!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Where will our troupe perform?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We can go from door to door, but that's a lot of doors...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maybe we could build a stage... And I know the perfect place for it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: The stage will need some decorations, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And plenty of them!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Someone knows me well.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Nice pearls go with any outfit, I always say!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Can I sing a solo?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why not... Do you have a lot of singing experience?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Sure! I sing in the shower every day.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: This is starting to look wonderful, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thank you, Emilio. I was actually hoping to see you...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: You were?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, you'll never believe what Lady Voyance said...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: How is this played? Like this?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Be careful, it can be PRETTY loud...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You can never have too many tape recorders!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I wonder if Santa would give me an exclusive interview...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maddie, I know you're super busy with the caroling troupe, but I had an idea...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is it, Mason? Don't worry - you'll get some candy apples.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Oh, great! But actually this is about something else...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I thought we could all write a post card - you know, like season's greetings! But they're not addressed to anyone in particular.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: we'll alljustput them in a mailbox and then see which one we get.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's an excellent idea! I'll get the mailbox; you ask everyone to send a card!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You can't beat the classics!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I bet you were singing these songs when the dinosaurs were around...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I am not that old, Mason!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: All this stage needs now is the instruments!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: But who's going to play them?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Oooooh, right!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I guess I am pretty good with the tambourine!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a wonderful set-up, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It'sjust...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I suffer from terrible stage fright!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Is that mistletoe?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, it is! I wonder who hung it there...

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Apparently, you can kiss someone when you're standing under that stuff.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: T-that's true!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Why are you turning red?

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I got this as a present for my birthday. I was told to only use it for emergencies.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Where did I put my Lightning Card? Or did I loan it to someone?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Grandma Ursula!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Whatever is going on, Mason?

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: You'll never believe what I just saw!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I'm gonna be honest and say how I feel.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I'm gonna do it...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: ... I'm not gonna do it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Great. Another year, and I still can't speak my mind.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Something's gotta change.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Next year is going to be different. I'm going to be different.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Okay, resolutions are done! Get a new haircut, buy self-help books, find a new style...

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: That's a lot of stuff to do. Should I pick one at first?

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: But where should I start?

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hey, Maddie! Have you seen Roddy around?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No! I think he's been really busy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Yeah, busy working out!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What? I haven't noticed!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Of course you haven't. You're all about Emilio now!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It is going really well. I think next year is gonna be the best ever!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You... wouldn't happen to have Roddy's number?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did you know that Emilio climbed Mount Everest?

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Ofcourse he did...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.text: Maaaason?

lines.text: Yes, Mom? You sound like you're about to ask me to do something boring.

lines.text: I promised to organize a little Valentine's party at Grandma Ursula's place, but there's so much to do. Could you help me?

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: A Valentine's party? I knew it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Please? I need to get a little present for everyone. Could you pick them and order them on my credit card?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: So I would get to choose a present for everyone?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Yes, something special to each of our friends - but within reason! No sports cars or exotic animals.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: So, no frilly hearts and the rest of that romantic stuff? I guess I can do that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Great! I'll get everything else ready. I think this will be fun!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yes, it will...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These presents look... suspiciously nice!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: They ARE nice. I chose them myself!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: And I can't wait to see everyone's reactions!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: You get the first present.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Why, thank you, Mason!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: A Japanese teapot! What amazing craftmanship!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: This was not a cheap present, my boy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Only the best for you, Grandma Ursula!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do I get a present too?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: You most definitely do, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A silk scarf! T-that's... so beautiful. And so expensive!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Valentine's Day is all about making people feel special, and you deserve it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: This one is for you, Roddy!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Wow, this is great. I wonder what you've got for me...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: A gold watch?? Thanks, Mason, but this seems a bit too much...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Friendship is more valuable than gold!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's this old burned teddy?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I didn't order that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It looks really familiar... but it can't be!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What is it, Maddie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It looks like my old childhood teddy... but I thought I lost it in the fire!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: S-someone has sent it to me... But who?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Lady Voyance's snow globe did also show me something weird... I'm sure its just a coincidence...

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Mason?? How much did you spend on all these presents?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Some... but YOU told me to get something "special" for everyone. And I didn't get a sports car or exotic animals!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: And I was really tempted...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: The thought is lovely, but it's all just WAY too much. We'll have to return them...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: But your friendship is enough for us, Mason. It doesn't cost anything, but it's more valuable than any fancy present.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Aww, shucks! Thanks, guys. I guess Valentine's Day doesn't have to be about just yucky love or expensive gifts.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: It's great to have friends!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It is! But seriously, though...

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Was that diamond ring actually Hank's? What's he planning??

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Welcome to Floral Frenzy, a competition where we find out who makes the most magnificent flower arrangements in Hopewell Bay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Our contenders are Deb, a lover of the more exotic flowers...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: I do have a penchant for the unusual.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Err, yes. And Julius who specializes in the gentle Japanese art of Ikebana. I can't wait to see what kind of creations you will produce!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Salutations! Did you know that the history of Ikebana reaches back over 600 years?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Very interesting, indeed! And our last contender is... Jackie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Pearl, I told you I'm too busy to take part in a silly competition. I've never even tried flower arranging before!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Haha, you're so funny!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Let's get to it, people. The competition is officially on - may the best amateur florist win!

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: How so?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.text: Well, the size... and smell...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What am I talking about? It is wonderful!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Look at all of these magnificent flowers! It is so difficult to choose, don't you think?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: A flower's a flower, right? So a little bit of this and a little bit of that...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It is more than that, my dear Jackie! Take a moment to appreciate the flowers; find the beauty in each one of them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Thanks, Julius! I think I can do better, though...

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What a lovely ensemble, Deb! That will be hard to beat.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: What bold use of color and shape. You have outdone yourself, Julius!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You're certainly not holding back. This bouquet is gorgeous!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Why thank you, Jackie. It's all about confidence!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Are you sure you've never tried flower arranging before, Jackie? You're a natural!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I'm confident I've found a new passion!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: What a competition we've had! I had no idea we have such flower arranging talent in our little town.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Aaand the winner is... Jackie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: W-what?? I really didn't expect this...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I'd like to thank my fellow contenders for educating and inspiring me. I never knew I had it in me to get excited about flower arranging!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Next time, we can see if it wasjust beginner's luck... but congratulations, Jackie. You did well!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Thank you, Deb!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Ah, Maddie. It still astonishes me how you make every day feel like the best day of my life.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm really happy I met you, Emilio.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: It was fate, I guess.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy

lines.text: Anyway, I'm off to get ready.

lines.speaker: Maddie

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Oh, right! Ofcourse! See you tonight!

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.text: What's up, buddy?

lines.text: I totally forgot it was Valentine's Day!

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Oh boy... I haven't worn this in a long time...

lines.text: Actually, I think this was my grandad's!

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Oh... Oops.

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: This one?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Yes, just the putters!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: I'm impressed, Roddy. These look superb!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Thanks, buddy! Mason has been helping out with making them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: A mini golfcourse?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Yeah! She'll love it! She's an engineer, after all. And she's spoken about it before...

lines.text: I was actually considering asking her o- Um. Asking her... This was before she met you, you understand?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Roddy, my friend, don't worry.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: I trust you. If you think this is a good idea, then let's go with it. Who will you bring along?

lines.text: Ofcourse. Mini Golf is always better in teams!

lines.speaker: Roddy

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Hmm... What's in here that I can use?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Looking good, Roddy! Looking gooood!

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I'm sure we can make something delicious with these!

lines.text: I got a few tasty recipes.

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Leave this one to me, buddy!

lines.text: Erm... I borrowed them from Grandma!

lines.text: Here we go; let's get cooking!

lines.text: A simple and eloquent dish.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Wow, Roddy!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Time to finish on a high! This is my mother's recipe, reserved for SPECIAL occasions!

lines.speaker: Roddy

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: No holding back now.

lines.text: Roddy... What's this?

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: l... I don't get it.

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well... Um, it's just that Emilio is planning this whole double date thing and...

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I mean, I'm flattered, but don't you have a thing for... You know?

lines.text: That ship has sailed a while ago. And I'm sure you can guess who the captain is, anyway.

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Haha! Fair enough. But back to your original question... Sure, why not?!

lines.text: Putter?

lines.text: Uuuhm.... Why is it on fire?

lines.text: I didn't... MASON!!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's all this?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Surprise! I thought for our first Valentine's I would do something special!
