lines.text: Hmm... I was about to throw this piece of paper out, but it looks important.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's see...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's a cease and desist notice, addressed to Leonard!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Says here that they suspect he was running an illegal casino.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, they're not wrong. Looks like there was definitely an investigation.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But, wow! This explains why most of the things in this room were upturned. I guess this place was thoroughly searched...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow! This stage looks great!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Judging from the instruments, I think they used to play jazz.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wish I could have been a fly on the wall.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Restoring this carpet is hard work, but I can see why...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It looks like it has a high knot count, and it was probably made especially for this room.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Leonard definitely invested a lot in this lounge!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Backgammon? This seems a bit out of place...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But then again, I've seen people gamble over a game of backgammon in the movies...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: My... that was riveting...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy, I didn't know you were still around...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Ouch.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well, it looks like you got things handled here, so I'll head back to the office.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh Roddy, calm down.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: No no... maybe I'm just not good company.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy, I was just distracted-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Hmph...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: Ma'am... It seems I found the intruder that was munching on all the foliage...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Brilliant! So what was it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: Something I wasn't expecting...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: It's a horse, ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A horse?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: Yes, a runaway one, it seems. Quite stubborn. I managed to lead the rascal to the Ranch.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Butler
lines.text: You must go there immediately.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We have a ranch? This keeps getting more and more shocking...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Don't worry, Winston, I'm on it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't believe that today is the big day! Eeeh! So exciting!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Settle down, Maddie. I'm the one getting married today.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Haha! I know that. I'm just so happy for you! In fact, I want to show you my wedding gift for you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Tadaa!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Wh... What is it?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This area, silly! I cleared it out for you! It'll be perfect, trust me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Oh, my... Maddie, it's perfect! I don't know what to say...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The only thing you have to say today Deb is, "l do."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm so happy you found some more of the vintage Hopeberryjuice, Grandma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma? Is everything alright?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hmm? Ohyes, ofcourse it is, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Everything will be alright. Everything will be just fiiiine...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Okay...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello, Deb. Getting ready for the big day, I see.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Yes! Busy, busy!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Put any more thought into what Reginald wrote in that letter about not trusting Hank?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: It only read that he may be hiding something. Nothing about not trusting him! Whatever it is...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I'll find out soon enough.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Riight...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Ursula! Don't you go jinxing my wedding like you did Maddie's, do you understand me?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: l... I'm sorry, dearie. I don't know what came over me. I'll go see if Maddie needs some help.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Good! And don't worry. I'll find out what Hank is hiding!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's so nice of you to officiate their wedding, Roddy! I had no idea you could do that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Oh yeah, I officiated at a friend's wedding after I completed his home.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aaw, that's so sweet of you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Roddy! Why aren't you dressed yet?! You're not marrying them in that hard hat are you?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh! Hi, Jackie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well, I thought that-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: *sigh* Alright, fine. You do you. I couldn't prepare for the wedding either... Had to grab my camera from the office.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Forgot my dress... What a right pair we make, eh?! Oh, hi Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: So you're sure the food is vegan, right? I mean, maybe we should hold off until we're sure, okay?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hank... CALM DOWN! I know it's a big day, but you'll get through it, alright? The food is fine.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: But is it vegan like I ordered? I'm vegan. I can't keep my physique if-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hank... Breathe. You can do this!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: What was that all about?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think Hank just realized he's getting married!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Ha! Ohl did he now? I guess there's nothing more intimidating than marrying a Boulton!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Oh... Sorry.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So! Soon to be Mr and Mrs. Boulton! I'm surprised you took on the Boulton name, Hank!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: What, are you kidding? Hank Boulton... Can't ask for a better name!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Good luck, dearies!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Now, if you would be so kind, I have a few words I need to share with Hank after the ceremony!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Ursula. This better not be the same "talk" you gave my 2nd husband! He was afraid ofairplanes for a month!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hahaha! Oh yes, I remember! Nothing like that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Just a little something I need to discuss with him...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Deborah Boulton, do you take Hank Johnson for your lawful husband, to have and to hold, from this day forward, for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, until death do you part?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: I do.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: I DO!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Then, by the power invested in me by the state of Seranova, I pronounce you husband and wife!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: You may kiss the bride!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: What did you want to talk about, Grandma?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I just wanted to congratulate you on your wonderful wedding!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: And to tell you I've learned something about your past...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Looks like you haven't been ENTIRELY honest with
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Gr- Grandma! l... I don't know what you're talking about!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: How about I give you a LITTLE reminder!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: * ulp*
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, I would call that a very successful wedding!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You did great out there, baby.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Thanks, Jackie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, I uuh... Should start clean-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Have any ofyou seen Hank?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, sure! He was just here a minute ago.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: No, he wasn't... I've looked everywhere! Haaank!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Deb, Deb... Calm down, I'm sure he'sjust inside, doing his hair or lifting weights or something...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: No, his hair is fine and today is leg day. He isn't answering his phone; I can't find him, Maddie! HAANK!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Wasn't.... Wasn't Grandma the last person to speak to him?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I think so...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: HAAANK!!! Where are you?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: How's life at the newspaper, Jackie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Actually, I'm writing a story about fast fashion. Did you know that every SECOND a truckload ofold clothes is burned at a landfill somewhere?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: What? That's shocking!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: 1 know! And the problem is global. The more 1 read about it, the more hopeless I feel...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: You know what they say? Think globally, act locally. Let's do something about it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What do you mean?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: You know how to sew, don't you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Well, my mom taught me a thing or two years ago...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: With your skills and my impeccable eye for fashion, we could put on an event to get people excited about recycling and reusing clothes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: That's not a bad idea... It would be perfect for my story, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: And it would give Maddie something to do about after Emilio left her to go help the fish in Bolivia...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What are we waiting for??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A fashion show with recycled clothes is a great idea - but I don't know how to sew! Grandma's the only one in our family with any crafting skills.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: But you're a good builder... and we need a stage for our runway show.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I bet you've got a bunch of great material from fixing up the Mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: More than a bunch! I'm getting SO many great ideas already - a stage, tire planters, a boutique!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I need to go make some plans... See you later!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: See? This is exactly what she needed.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Is there anything in the Mansion we could repurpose - old clothes, accessories... Anything?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: As you know, Grandma's weird about me rooting around in the Mansion, but there's this old trunk full of stuff I just found in the basement.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Cool vintage stuff? Sounds perfect.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: What do you need to turn all this fabric into clothes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I've drawn some sewing patterns. Now I'll just cut the fabric and start sewing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: That's it??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: It's a lot simpler than you'd think, huh?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Someone donated a box of old crafting supplies. What could we do with them?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How about some jewelry?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: How's it going with Roddy? Are you two getting serious?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I don't know. It's kinda awkward with so much history...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: But I really like him. I just feel like Maddie's a little jealous.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: She's never had the hots for Roddy, has she?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I guess not...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ta-da! A whole collection of bespoke jewelry, all made with recycled materials.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Wow! You really are a woman of many talents.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: This skip is a real treasure trove!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Yep. We'll be able to find all kinds of materials in here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: But we'll wash them first, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Ofcourse!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: People throw away so much cool, usable stuff.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I had thisjumper I used to love... but it had a couple of little holes in it, so I threw it away. I still think about that jumper every day!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Every day?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Well, maybe not EVERY day, but you get what I mean. Mend, don't spend!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Are you ready to serve some fierce lewks?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, I guess it's for a good cause...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Let's go!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are those lightbulbs in that headpiece?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Yeah, I thought they made a BRIGHT choice.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It feels great to have a little project - to get my mind off my terrible love life and everything else.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And there's SO much wood and other material here to reuse and upcycle!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Not to mention all of my old gardening gloves...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Who's gonna model all of these outfits in the show? Imagine us on that runway!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Well, Julius and Roddy couldn't make it, so...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: What's this? An old newspaper?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Are those eyeholes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: A wig? This is starting to look like a collection of disguises...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Why would there be a trunk full of old disguises in the Mansion?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: That Mansion is full of weird secrets...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I'm pretty sure Maddie doesn't know half of her family's history.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Someone is definitely hiding something - are those bullet holes??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: So... How are things, you know, since Emilio left?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Just fine! I've been concentrating on the Mansion and getting a lot done and... Yeah, it's been great!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Good to hear! You're okay with me seeing Roddy, right? I mean...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: W-what -- Of course I am! You guys are so great together. Honestly, don't worry about me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Can I post a photo of you on my social media?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Why not - it's not like this is going viral!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: It must be a slow news day!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But we wanted to raise awareness of an important issue - and did it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Recycled clothes don't have to look like garbage. It's all in how you set it up.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: This boutique is so cute! Jackie and Maddie, you've both outdone yourselves.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: It doesn't look bad, does it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What a show, dearies! Your couture creations really are impressive.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Thank you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But... where did you get the wig and trench coat?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: We found them in an old trunk in the basement... But what are they, anyway - an old Halloween outfit?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Errr, yes... Just an old Halloween outfit!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What do you think about the stuff we found in the trunk? I'm not sure I'm buying the story about an old Halloween costume.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: When I was a kid, people used to talk about the Boultons and their secret business.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Who knows -- maybe they were involved in espionage or something!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I don't know...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: How do you explain the bullet holes in that old hat?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: You've thought ofeverything, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I thought I was getting a little carried away.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: No, it's PERFECT.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Our little project actually made it to the pages ofa fashion magazine.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Who knew recycled couture would be such a hit?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: so, 1 found some wood left overfrom Mason'spirate ship and put together this... sculpture.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What do you think?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I think the whole thing should be on national TV!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Everything here is recycled and reused - and still fabulous. It really shows how much you can do without buying everything new.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I can't believe we pulled Offa fashion show AND made it to the news!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Fast fashion SHOULD be in the news more, and I think we offered a pretty inspiring solution.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Great work, everyone. I am so very proud of all of you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Thanks, Ursula!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: But I have to ask... We found an old hat in the trunk - and it looked like it had bullet holes in it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maybe that old Halloween outfit of yours has some history...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, the holes were made by moths!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: M-moth holes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes! Terrible things, those moths.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Don't look so shocked, dearie - not everything has a secret meaning.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Come on, let's celebrate! The first round of Hopeberryjuice is on me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Dearie me! It's the old machine I used to play with... too many years ago!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: This thing should be long gone by now.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I wonder if it still works...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I bet you are wondering what this machine does.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You thought I was going to tell you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Haha! Think again!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Why don't you press the big green button to find out!

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: What did you think about Roddy's stand-up set?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I admit I was nervous for him, but he was actually good!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I know! Hisjokes about wearing a helmet all the time cracked me up!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I didn't know he even wanted to do stand-up.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: He didn't! He only offered to do it because I was one performer short.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: He did me a big favor!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think he did a lot more than we realize.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy's been pretty busy - helping everyone with their problems.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He and Jackie just broke up, and I know he's been pretty torn up about that, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I always knew he's a good guy, but maybe I didn't really appreciate him enough.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He really is one in a million!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: What kind ofa person am I looking for?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Do I even have an ideal woman?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Hank is right, though. I do know what I don't want.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I don't think I want someone who takes everything too seriously.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: She should be playful and silly, even.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: This one is a dealbreaker. She has to like camping.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Or at least tolerate it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Jackie wouldn't even look at my premium tent, let alone get into it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: So which qualities are totally wrong for me?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I want someone who is honest. I mean, honest with herself, with me and with her friends.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: There has to be trust. Otherwise, there's... no foundation.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Can there really be someone who would have all of these qualities?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: One person who could really make me happy?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I think it's time I'm totally honest with myself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: But can I be totally honest with her?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: You need to know when to stop.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Curiosity is good, but it can go too far...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Everyone has some secrets they want to keep just to themselves. I can't be with a person who makes it their mission to dig them up.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, Roddy! I just wanted to thank you for all of your help with the Hopeberry Festival.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't know what I would've done without you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: D-do you really mean that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Of course!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Listen, Maddie... There's something I wanted to talk to you about.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: mell, it'sjust that... 1 wanted to say... thatyour
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, thank you! Your stand-up set wasn't half bad, either!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, see you around, I guess.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Yeah, see you around.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What in the world is that noise?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I am sure I saw a dog out here... a big one, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I hope it was not lost, poor pooch.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: There is nothing here, though. I guess I'm getting old!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I'd better get back inside before my pie burns to a crisp!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Have you seen Rufus?? It's his dinnertime, but there's no trace of him!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He NEVER misses his dinner!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I am sure he isjust feeling guilty. He has been digging up my flowerbeds!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello? Y-you're calling from the animal shelter?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You caught a stray dog? Yes, my dog IS missing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I live at Beaumont Hall. You can bring him here? Thank you so much!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, Rufus... I wonder what made him run away!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You're not Rufus!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They must have made a mistake at the animal shelter! I think I need to give them a call...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: *RRINGG, RRINGG*
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello? I think you brought me the wrong dog... My dog is black and has a blue collar.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes, that's him, the rascal! Couldyou maybe... Oh, you'll bring him here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Andyou '11 pick up the oneyou brought me earlier? See, we already have one dog, and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A photo? Is it in the paperwork you dropped off with
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So your name is Goldie. And you love to dig holes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It says here you've been alone for a while...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Was she really wandering on the streets all alone? Poor doggie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I GUESS we can keep her...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And I think I know a great spot in the garden for a new dog home...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh... okay! Goldie, you just found your forever home!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: You got another dog!?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Rufus disappeared, and there was a mix-up with animal control... So they brought me the wrong dog!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: And you didn't have the heart to send her back?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well... no
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Do you know where she came from?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No... Only that she's been alone for a while.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She seems like a really sweet dog, and we have plenty of space.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: That's for sure!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Roddy told me you got a new pet, so I had to come see iffor myself- I looove dogs!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: News travels fast, huh? Meet Goldie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hey, Goldie! You get ready for some serious scritches!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She's been a good distraction, for sure. I just...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't stop thinking about ALL the strange stuff that's been going on...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You mean Hank's disappearance?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, first we found out that he was hiding something from Deb. Then he went missing right after their wedding!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Cherry needed a whole bunch of meat for the record-breaking pie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: And your Grandma just happened to have it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Exactly. It alljust seems kinda... fishy
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's that Goldie's got in her mouth?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Looks like a big juicy bone.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A b-bone?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A HUMAN bone?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I-it's HANK!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hey, Maddie! There you are! I have something to ask-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Jackie! I was right, the very same blue gem I discovered is right here at the conservatory!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: The what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The gem from the cryptex! And it looks like one of the gem slots here is actually hollow!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe I just need to place the gem here and see what happens...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I have so many questions...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: W-wait a second, I think the stone is moving!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow! I can't believe this was under the conservatory all this time!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: How did you know it was here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There were clues hidden in the mosaic and-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: LOOK OUT!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ungh!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Are you okay?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah... wow, that was close!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maybe we should stick together for this one. Just in case...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That sounds like a good idea.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Besides, I smell a good story in this room!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ugh... That's not the only thing you're probably smelling... Look at that water!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You know, you should really get your plumbing fixed.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I have a feeling that this lever will help with the bad smell in here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: How do you reckon?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: From what I can see, it looks like it was engineered to drain the water.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Ah, ofcourse! I forget that engineering is your thing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sure is!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Well, let's give it a try because I can't stand this smell much longer!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maddie, I completely forgot to mention what I actually came over here for!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Your article!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: My article? What do you mean?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I did some research for the Bugle. Turns out that people are loving home renovation and cleaning tips...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: There's no one better than you for thejob!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh! I'm flattered! I guess I could do an interview...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Look at all of this stuff! What do you think happened down here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Strange... It sort of reminds me of the gallery. But some of these things...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Some of these things belong in a museum!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Why do you think they're stuck down here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Perhaps it has something to do with the cryptex? It had a word...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Curious. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Curious? Wait... You don't think that...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The Curiosity Fellowship!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: These things look really old...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: And expensive.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe... Maybe I should donate these to the museum anonymously.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hey! This scroll seems to have the tenets of the Fellowship written on it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ooh! What does it say?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hmph... Ofcourse, it's in code.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I know what this is! It's an ancient Mayan calendar!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How do you know that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I took archeology for one semester in university.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I remember hearing a story about how to become a member of the Fellowship.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Oh? I didn't hear that one.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It was said that in order to join, you had to contribute something unique.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We would try to design utterly unique inventions. But judging from all these things...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess unique also meant cool artifacts!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: That would explain the creepy statue in your Gallery.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh! That's right! It's so out of place too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hmm... I wonder what caused them to shut it down?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: The Curiosity Fellowship, that's right!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I remember it from my university days, talk about a strange secret society for inventors, adventurers and explorers.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Me too! The Curiosity Fellowship was a legend for us engineers at Veilwood University!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Rumors about crazy inventions like flying contraptions, free energy, automatons...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: We used to hear stories of their adventures in far- away lands, discovering lost ancient cities!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's right! And their secret sanctum was lost forever...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Until now!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait... You think this is the secret sanctum of the Curiosity Fellowship?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Yeah! What else could it be?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But... They said it was somewhere in the university?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I'm sure they had an office there, but this place... This is where it happened!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Look, Maddie! Robes, masks, weird artifacts... It all fits! Even getting in here with a cryptex!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: They were also very secretive, using passwords and secret identities... Remind you ofsomething?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Okay... You got me there.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I always like to start with planters and flowers!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I just noticed that one of these shoes belongs to a woman!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: OH! Do you think it could be Lindsay?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's possible. This is exactly the kinda thing she'd be into...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ooh, these must be the robes they would wear on initiation days?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Yeah, or formal events...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They're so fancy and kind of eerie at the same time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maddie, our readers want to know ALL about upholstery!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, having a sewing kit can be handy, but make sure to have plenty of fabric!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Yeah, okay... I'm officially creeped out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What, why? These artifacts are beautiful and mysterious!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Sometimes, Maddie, you're more ofa Boulton than you think!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: That thing looks complicated!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Looks like some sort oforrery... But for astrology!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I wonder what my sun sign has in store for me this year...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Are you actually planning to stand on this bridge?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How else am I supposed to fix it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I don't know, Maddie. This place feels like it's full of traps. The lamp-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know, I know. What if I just place one foot on it like so...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Wait, do you hear rumbling? Step back, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Phew! That was close... Thanks, Jackie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I might have to add "saving lives" to my professional profile!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Haha, hopefully this bridge is the last of the traps.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I trust you can build a much sturdier bridge?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Absolutely!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: How do you keep dust away in indoor spaces?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A good, fluffy duster does wonders!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And remember to always dust before you vacuum!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, but what on earth are those numbers?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hmm, maybe it'sjust a pattern?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ewwww! Not again!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: That was a solid bridge, Maddie! I'm sorry if I was still hesitant to cross it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't blame you after the events we've seen down here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder why they didn't want anyone to get to this Side?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hmm... might have something to do with all these blueprints.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You could be right. But what were they building?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Mostly harmless stuff, from the looks of it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Invisibility machine? Early Navigation System? Anti-Distraction Hat?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maddie... These folks had some far out ideas...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This must be their intellectual corner.... The very spot where ideas came to life!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: How exciting!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You know, now that Victoria has an eye on you, maybe this article could help!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How so?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: By getting Hopewell Bay to see how you've revived this mansion!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Look how far you've come! Everyone will surely be on your side!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You might be right. Thanks, Jackie. It's nice to be appreciated!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Thanks for the interview, Maddie. You were a natural!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aw, shucks. This was fun!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I have a feeling that this could be a regular column someday...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ooh, I'd love that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Check out this podium and all these seats, Jackie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Can you imagine all the amazing speakers they had here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I've read that secret societies usually invite prominent speakers in various fields.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Oh how I wish I were a fly on this wall...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you think presidents have been here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I wouldn't be surprised. These societies were known to host a few presidents over the years...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look! It's the same numbers that were in the pool!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Wow, guess it does have a purpose. Do you think it's some sort of puzzle?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It has to be!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Ooh, I bet if we solve this, we might unearth some more secrets...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm, I just have to put the last piece of this puzzle together.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: If this goes here, then... Hmmm I almost have it...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You can do it, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: M-maddie, the lion head!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh my goodness, it worked! There's a beam of light!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And it's bouncing off the fire bowl...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I'm sure this light reflection puzzle unlocks something... Let's polish the bowl and see where it leads!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I thought I heard a faint ringing, and I was right! What's a telephone doing here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's find out! It's a bit muffled...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What was that last bit?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Shh, Jackie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder if we've already met a society member. Could be anyone!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Is it just me or did that sound like a threat?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Can you believe we actually solved one of the Fellowship's puzzles?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Based on that message, there might be more around the mansion. I can't wait!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Are we gonna talk about the bone?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The bone Goldie dug up in Grandma's yard? Yeah, that was creepy!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: First Ursula comes up with all that vegan meat for Cherry's pie, and then Goldie digs up something that looks like a human bone...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: On top of that, Ursula was the last one seen talking to Hank!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: And you need to tell Deb -- she's worried sick about Hank!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: *Gulp* I guess it's the only way...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maddie, dearie! There's someone I want you to meet.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: This is Kazuko. She owns a shop in town, and she is a friend of mine. To round off Hopewell Bay's centennial celebrations, she is organizing a community theater project.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: How lovely to meet you, Maddie. Your grandma has told me so much about you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Nice to meet you! So, the community theater ---
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Sgt. Pepper
lines.text: *Squaaaaawk!* Nice to meet you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yikes! Errr... who are you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: This is my cockatoo, Sgt. Pepper. I'm afraid he is pretty nosey...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Sgt. Pepper
lines.text: Aaaall you need IS a.. • .CRRRACKER!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Let's set up a seating area here! A bench, some cushions, lights...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: I've sensed so much trouble around town after Hank went missing. Maybe this little project can bring some harmony.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a lovely idea! It really HAS been a strange couple of months.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: By the way, how do you know Grandma?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Oh, Ursula and I go way back!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: She spent so long in Japan and speaks the language fluently... You know, that's not exactly usual!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma speaks Japanese??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I don't have any crackers for you... Please don't be offended!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Sgt. Pepper
lines.text: Please don't!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Haha! You're good at copying.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Sgt. Pepper
lines.text: Please don't, Ursula! *Squeeek!* Please don't do it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: E-excuse me?? Could you say that again?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Sgt. Pepper
lines.text: Don't! I'll do anything you want!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ifyou're saying what I thinkyou're saying, this is
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Sgt. Pepper
lines.text: Crackerrr!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, I just had a REALLY worrying talk with Sgt. Pepper!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The cockatoo?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Y-yes, he can talk, you know! And I have to say, he made me pretty scared.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's just that... He said...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Just spit it out, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did you kill Hank and let Cherry bake him into a pie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Would I really kill Hank, my own sister's husband?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: According to what Maddie said, the evidence speaks for itself, Ursula.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The evidence??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The vegan meatyou offered for thepie, the bone
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You were the last person seen with Hank before he disappeared, and Sgt. Pepper repeated Hank's last words.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh dear...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: First ofall, it is just good sense to stock up on quality ingredients when they are on sale. That vegan meat was a great bargain!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Secondly, the bone Goldie found was an old Halloween decoration. Now if I really HAD done what you accuse me of, you would not suspect a thing...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So, where IS Hank?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That is a more complicated question, dearie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I assure you, I did NOT kill poor Hank.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I did speak to him before he left, but he is still in one piece, as far as I know.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: So where is my Hank??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Hello, Deb.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: HANK?? Is that a baby you have with you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: You must be totally confused about what happened to me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: See, Ursula found out that my ex-girlfriend had had a baby and sent me to make things right... I asked her not to tell you, 'cos I was wanted to get everything in order first.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: So here I am! It's your baby, Deb.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: I don't think that's how it works, Hank...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I learned about this child through Reginald's letter and told Hank. He begged me to keep his secret, so I did.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hank is a gentleman at his core, so I knew that he would do what was right.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: My head is spinning.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So... everyone's alive, Hank's back, and everything's fine?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Looks like it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Pearl, hi! I'm great. How are you? You sound kinda hyper...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Amelia Boulton Day? I think I've heard something about that...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Y-yes, I know she's MY ancestor, but there's a LOT I don't know about my family...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, anyway... A parade? Wow, that sounds great!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe we could organize something...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma will know more? I'll see what we can do. Talk to you later!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What is it, dearie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That was Pearl on the phone. Apparently, it's Amelia Boulton Day soon, and she wanted to know if we have something we could exhibit.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I suppose it is that time again... We have some of Amelia's old items - her trunk and other old luggage.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sounds great! But... who was she? I just know she founded the town, founded the hospital and did a lot of good -- but there must be so much more!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: If there is, I do not know it, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Amelia was, and still is, something ofa mystery!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aren't there any family legends about Amelia?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Apart from the things everyone knows, she was not really spoken about much...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Who knows? Maybe it would be best to leave it alone, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why am I not surprised to hear you say that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't know anything about Amelia. What was she like? Where did she come from?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You and your questions!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: If you really want to find out more, ask Julius. He can answer all your questions!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: And he has not visited for a while... Maybe you should pay him a visit and make sure he has not expired under a pile of stamps.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This little compartment is locked... with a combination lock!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It looks old, but I'm sure they didn't exist back in Amelia's day!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... Someone WAS trying to hide something -- but they weren't expecting to have me on the case!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: These are some of Amelia's old clothes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: There are plenty of old things up in the attic, but who knows which ones belonged to her!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know! There's everything from old racing trophies to piles and piles of dusty, old books!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: *Sigh* I guess I'lljust start looking...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Maddie, dear girl! What a pleasure. It feels like we have not met for a while...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No, it has been a hot minute! I wanted to see you about Amelia Boulton -- but what's happened to you??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ah, I have been surfing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The World Wide Web, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This is quite a set-up you've got here, Julius.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are those empty energy drink cans and pizza boxes??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Errr, Herbert instructed me that they provide the best nutrition while surfing the old Web.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: But to get back to Amelia, she has always piqued my interest. Famous, yet so mysterious.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I found some brand-new information that seemed questionable at first, but I cross-referenced everything and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I think I have the answer to your problem, my girl.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I am terribly sorry about my appearance...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You see, my nephew, you may remember Herbert - he's still asking about you - came to visit me for the Hopeberry Harvest Festival.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: He was shocked to find that I still search for information in BOOKS! So, he kindly bought me a computer and a printer, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I found a great many interesting things on the Web, but I'm afraid the time got away from me...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Did you say you wanted to ask me about Amelia Boulton?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Err... yeah, I did. We have an old trunk of hers, but there's a weird locked compartment.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you have ANY idea who set the lock and why... and what's behind it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Funny you should ask...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: After much careful research, I ended up with a strange code. I did not know what it was, but...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Could it be the code for the lock?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: There is only one way to find out!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: *Gasp!* The locked compartment contained old letters and postcards, all sent to Amelia from Veilwood and signed "BB. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: One of them says, "You made a timely escape. The situation is dire, and they are looking for you. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: So, Amelia came to this town because she was running from someone. VERY interesting...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Let's see what else these letters reveal!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Another one of Amelia's secrets is revealed!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She wasn't some meek, little woman. This lady was a racer!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Between Amelia's need for speed and Grandma's love of motorbikes and planes, wild hobbies seem to run in the family!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can see that Amelia did a lot for the town. She founded a hospital, a school, even a shelter for the poor...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It seems like she appeared here out of thin air... without a past or a family.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Where did she come from, and what made her do all of that work for the town?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I love all this old kitsch! You need to be like a super fan to collect all of these things!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ahem... This medal is particularly valuable, my dear - VERY sought after by people who know about these things.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Err... Ofcourse. It's very nice!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's a whole box of old glass squares, labeled "The Amelia Riot. " What are these?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ah! They are dry plate photographs! But these seem to be undeveloped...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I didn't see anything about the "Amelia Riot" in the books you showed me.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is there a way to develop these photographs?? There could be something important in them!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Right you are!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: She was well-traveled... later in life, that is. We don't really know anything about her life from before her arrival here in Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What -- nothing??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: No. She's quite the enigma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There must be something at the library - they have a whole section about her!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I am always up for some good old-fashioned detective work. To the library!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's Amelia in the photo, isn't it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It most certainly is! The image of the man has been scratched away - on the glass plate itself...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: So, she was married - or at least engaged. Something frightful must have happened to them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess Amelia came here to get away from a bad situation and to build a new life.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: And we can assume that she managed to escape from this man's clutches... at least for a while.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you remember all those old racing trophies we found in the attic?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They were all Amelia's! She was a race car driver, and a good one, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: A race car driver? Now, she is a woman after my own heart.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This letter says, "You have completed work on your cottage, but the land behind it stands vacant... "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are they talking about Grandma's cottage? Did Amelia build it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "A grander house would be fitting, but it could invite unwanted attention. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They must mean the Mansion! I had no idea its history meanders so far back in our family history.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: These letters do indeed shed light on Amelia's actions, but they seem to raise more questions...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Who is the writer referring to with "unwanted attention?" I think I need to return to the Web for more information!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow, this town has some history!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Pirates, coal mines, a tin can factory...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I bet it looked pretty different back when Amelia first arrived here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Somehow she turned the place around and gave people hope.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Amelia is EVERYWHERE in Hopewell Bay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She has her own street, park - even a statue - but so little is known about her.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: *Sigh* Yes... The family secrets started with her and just kept on piling up...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I get it now -- you know, why she's so important in this town.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She worked so hard to make it better for everyone...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: She gave everyone a chance for a new beginning - but she wanted one herself, so she hid her past.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: And her descendants kept her secret.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at these photos! I feel like we're traveling right back in time!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: There was a riot in town... People were so angry about their living conditions and the miserable work in the mines...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And Amelia emerged from the crowd to lead the protest!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The Amelia Riot!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Only a couple dozen of this bust were ever made. It is the crown jewel ofmy collection!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She's very impressive, I give you that. Do you think there's a family resemblance?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Hmmm... In the mystery department, at least!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Absolutely! She was a brave, daring woman, who didn't hesitate to stand up for what she thought was right.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Thank you for putting on this exhibition about her, Maddie. I know it came at a short notice, but you really delivered.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I love Amelia's old things. Did you find anything in her old trunk?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We found the usual stuff! Bows, shoes, hats... and a secret compartment!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: A secret what-now??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It turned out there was a lot more to Amelia than we first thought. She had many sides she never shared with the world.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Areyou sureyou didn't know the truth about the role Amelia played in the story 0fHopewe11 Bay?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I had NO idea.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Having said that, I am very impressed by...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Her courage to fight the good fight?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Her racing trophies?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ofcourse, but also...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.text: What the-?!

lines.text: Uuh, Maddie, you don't have to-

lines.text: Maddie... I uuh...

lines.speaker: Maddie

lines.text: Maddie, I really think you sho-

lines.text: Oh boy...

lines.speaker: Maddie
