lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This has to have been made by Leonard. A hidden heart, how symbolic.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Does this mean that he actually has a heart under all those layers?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmph. Remains to be seen, I think.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This marble table has an interesting pattern...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It almost looks like an infinity sign!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Another room without an exit in sight!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy was right though...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: If I just take it easy, I'm sure I'll find a way out somehow.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, look! Another set of cards!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm, it wouldn't hurt to take a little break and indulge in a game.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's see what's in the cards for me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Everyone's busy at the gala, so I can finally slip away.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I'm sure I can get into Bruno's office!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This sounds a bit risky, Jackie. Be careful!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Phew! That was close...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: The security guard almost discovered me, but I managed to escape.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did you find what you needed?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I hope so. I grabbed a bunch of files that looked important, but I'll have to go over it back at the office!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Thanks for all your help, Maddie! I'll keep you updated.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's see what this next fuse does...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This room is so unexpected; I can't even predict what it could be!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sweet! A jukebox!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm starting to get used to things popping out of the ground...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've neverseen ajukebox like this. Looks like it's straight out ofa movie set!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And a tad bit too futuristic for this room. Hmm, I wonder if there's a significance...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... this jukebox is pretty custom.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's an assortment of parts that you wouldn't normally find here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Definitely feels like someone upgraded it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Funny thing is, none of the buttons seem to play any music.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ah! It looks like thejukebox screen has been updated to a modern one.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's possible that it broke, and they couldn't find the original parts anymore...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ooh, there are plenty of old songs here that I've only ever heard Grandma mention!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess Leonard and Grandma have something in common after all.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I just noticed this paper on the fridge.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder... could this be a clue?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: 1-1 think 1 should probably check thejukebox again. It's the only music related thing in the room.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Here's another thing that doesn't quite seem to fit
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This fridge feels a lot more modern than the rest of the room. Kind of like the jukebox.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And it's stuck! The door doesn't budge.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I hope there wasn't anything left inside...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think this jukebox was upgraded to act like a password input device...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But what could it be?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The table! That wasn't an infinity sign; it's a number eight!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There has to be more numbers hidden in plain sight around this room...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There! Another one on the drink dispenser and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: On the side of the fridge!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How do I guess the correct order though?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm, I'm just going to add them in the same order I fixed them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So... 2, 4 and finally 8!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Looks like I still got it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Now, let's get back to fixing up this room...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What!! That's amazing! The fridge is finally open!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And it's the path to another room? Who would've thought!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow, I never imagined I'd be standing inside a fridge...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: At least it isn't cold!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: *Ring Ring*
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.text: Maddie, I never heard back from you
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Bruno. I thought I told you-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.text: Well, I've decided to take matters into my own hands.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.text: My construction company is at the mansion, taking the required measurements before they start their work.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You're joking...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.text: Not at all. I just sent you a photo...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?! You cannot just trespass on my property!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.text: I'm the mayor, Maddie. I can do whatever I want. *Click*
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't believe he'd stoop so low! Does it never end?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I hope Roddy returns with the evidence we need...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well... so much for my relaxing week. Let's see what's going on...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, dear! Are those all the cans Mason dug up?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Maddie! MADDIE!!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Speak of the devil...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Look what I found! I think the storm brought them here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Mom said I can't keep them, so I thought I'd bring them here!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Them?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I think they're called capybaras!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aaw, aren't you a long way from home?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, don't you worry! I'll make sure you feel right at home.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Hello Maddie-san!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Kazuko-san, how are things at the shop?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Really, good! Everyone is going crazy buying up all my can openers!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Didn't you read the newspaper? The storm pulled up all these cans from the factory.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: So everyone got curious. "What's in these cans?" they ask.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Luckily for them, they got the right idea to come to my shop!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: I have the best can openers in all of Hopewell Bay, you know...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't take it! You guys are so CUTE!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's adorable!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How about we give you a name? How about Coco?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You like that, don't you?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You know what? You just gave me a great idea!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Who says we still can't enjoy a relaxing summer? I'm going to build us a spa!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hey, Maddie! I was wondering if I could get a few quotes from you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Quotes? Are you writing something for the Bugle?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Yeah, I was asked to write a piece about all these cans and with what I found, they all came from a large landfill near your old family-owned tin can factory.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Really? I thought they were old tin cans that Mason dug up?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: The boy is industrious but not THAT industrious.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I was wondering if you knew anything about all the strange things that people were finding inside?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Uhm... no. I wouldn't know about that. What strange things?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Some old photos, strange writing in code. I heard some people are now trying to crack it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hi Jackie! How's the article coming along?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Well... I've been doing some digging and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You're probably not going to like it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What? What am I not going to like?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Well, you see... I've been doing some digging, pulling some strings and getting some more information about your ancestor, Ignatius Boulton.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: And... It looks like he may have been using the tin can factory as cover for something way more... clandestine.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Like what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You're the one with the family full of secrets. I was hoping you could tell me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm as much in the dark as you, but... could I ask you a favor?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Sure!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Could you perhaps drop this story? Or at least change it so it doesn't directly tie to my family?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What?! You know I'm a journalist, right? This is my job. You can't ask me to compromise my integrity like that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm sorry! I know... I know. It's just that-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: No, no, I get you. I'll be seeing you around, Maddie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Oh, Maddie-san...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wh- What is it, Kazuko-san?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Have you not read the latest news? My dear Maddie-san, you should really keep up-to-date.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: *sigh* There is an article just released about the tin can factory and possibly the truth behind it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Truth? What truth?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: I knew I should not have sold everyone those can openers...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Kazuko-san, what is going on?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Maddie-san, your ancestor Ignatius Boulton was not a good man! They said that he ran the tin can factory as cover to sell secrets!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Other people's secrets! That's what's in the cans, Maddie-san.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Everyone's secrets... And now they know about it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Aahh, the stars are SPEAKING to me tonight!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: It is lucky Ursula allowed me to set up shop on her driveway.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I shall peak behind the veil of fate to see how the planets align...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: ...and what secrets will be spilled tonight!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: For a VERY reasonable fee, of course!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I feel the cards have something to say!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Hmm... Something looms large in the cosmic sphere... but what is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Oh, cards, tell me your tale!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Now I just need a customer... Who shall it be?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Jackie, what a surprise! What brings you here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: My senses tell me you are looking for romantic advice!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: No, actually I wanted to ask what the universe can tell me about Ursula Boulton.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: U-Ursula Boulton? But why?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Everyone knows she has a mysterious past, and that her family's history is full of secrets...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I'm going to find out what she's hiding, and it occured to me that you could maybe tell me a thing or two!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: That's quite a request, my dear, but let's see what we can see...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I see a roll of film...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Like photos?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Well, I cannot say, my dear. The ball only shows the roll...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: It could well be only a symbol for something else!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Like what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Memories... thoughts... secrets...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Who knows?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: So what does this mean??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Alas, I can only tell you what I see... I cannot make assumptions about its meaning.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: HOWEVER...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: For only a SMALL extra fee, my trusted Malzar can give you the answers you seek.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Figures. Fine, I'll pay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Excellent! Just insert the coin and let the magic happen!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: There's a book... but not an ordinary one.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: This one has a hole carved inside it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Now this is definitely giving me "mystery"!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You don't say!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: You should be glad I didn't see a lunchbox! The universe DETESTS a lunchbox.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I see SOMETHING...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I see YOU, Jackie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I see something strange... For one so fiercely keen to uncover the truth, you seem to carry a great burden.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: W-what do you mean?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: What family secrets YOU are hiding from the world?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: *Gulp* I don't know what you mean!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Malzar
lines.text: A roll offilm, its memories unseen, Likefriendships deep, developing in between.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What does that mean??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Patience! Let's see what else he has to say...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Malzar
lines.text: A book with ahollow, where trinkets reside. /sit knowledge weseek, ortreasures wehide?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Is it knowledge we seek, or treasures we hide... Good question, Malzar!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Ah, now this isjuicy! A bag filled with MONEY.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Money? Like, bills or coins or what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: This tells me about wealth - or the lack of it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Or maybe it's about the bag...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: It's very difficult to tell.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: A-ha! I see a yellowjumper.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: A yellow jumper? Maddie wears a yellow jumper...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Is it Maddie you can see?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: It makes total sense! All of Ursula's secrets MUST be tied to her.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Can you see something about the family? About the Mansion?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Ah, a cosmic MIST has fogged my vision...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Malzar
lines.text: A tatteredsack,fortunesplay hide and seek. Grandma 'sknitting?Ora bank 's quietleak?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: How mysterious!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: But what does it all MEAN?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: You have happened upon quite the enigma, Jackie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: The Boultons are known for their secrecy, and that barrier is not easy to break through - even with my cosmic connections.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: That said, your tenacious mind might be just the thing...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Just keep your EYE open...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You mean both of my eyes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: No, your MIND'S eye, my dear.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: *Sigh* Of course. Well, thank you. This was interesting, as always!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Another satisfied customer!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I wonder what Malzar was talking about... The ways of fate really ARE unknown!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Oh, I forgot to mention I have a sale on my patented magical snow globes...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: My snow globe is polished, and my Tarot cards are shuffled.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Dark clouds are gathering to hide the stars, but I can still read them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Someone is on their way - I can FEEL it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Ah, a new customer!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: A friend of mine said you were able to help her with a personal thing, so...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: No, it was the UNIVERSE that led you here!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Now tell me... What do you SEEK?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Umm... I've just had a weird feeling - like something is going on in Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Well, this town has no doubt had its share of stormy weather lately...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: No kidding! And I moved here with my family to enjoy the peace and quiet.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Now it seems like there's drama everywhere!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Then it is time to consult the stars...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: You must find cosmic clarity!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: What does that mean?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: The evidence for a betrayal exists...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Betrayal? So where do I look for it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I don't have ALL the answers, my dear.

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Correct - and in Latin, it is called Columbalivia.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Did you spot that barn swallow?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look, one of them has made a nest in the roof of the Mansion!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: How charming!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma maybe doesn't agree...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Mute swans mate for life. Their bonds are quite unbreakable!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Of course... Even the birds have a better love life than some people around here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is that bird?? It's lovely - like a little fairy! I think I could watch it for hours.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It is a hummingbird. I think you found your spark bird!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: My spark-what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Your spark bird! The bird that makes you fall in love with bird-watching!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know that one - it's the bald eagle!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Very good, Maddie. It is indeed!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I-is it looking straight at us?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Yes, we better hide...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's a strange looking bird on the ground... and another one! They look like they're about to have a fight!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Well spotted! You can add sage grouse to your Life List.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: There is one more bird I wish we could spot - the Atlantic Puffin.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Does it look like penguin with a funny beak?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Err-- I suppose it does!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then I've spotted it - right there on the cliffs!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I bet you see all kinds of things while you're bird- watching!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You are right about that! You know, I once saw... Oh, I cannot tell you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You'll think I have gone loopy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What was it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Well, I was once trying to spot a charming barn owl when I saw some flashing lights...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Like a..
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I cannot say, Maddie. But it was not a barn owl!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Can't we get closer to get a better photo?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Code of birding ethics stipulates that we must always be cautious around bird habitats.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, that makes sense. There might be nests there.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Exactly, Maddie. You are a natural birder!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you really need all of this stuff just to watch birds?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You need the right tools for thejob, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You can't just go winging it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ah, indeed! Very amusing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: This is where I keep my BEST cameras and lenses...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I still don't understand why you need so many...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: To capture the graceful flight of our most beautiful birds, Maddie, you need the very best equipment.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: In that case, you're ready for anything!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So, I just sit here with the camera, keep watching the birds... and then snap photos?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Exactly!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think there's a bird upside down in the water!
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Well spotted, my dear!
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That is the Mallard. Birds that tilt upside down in the water to look for food are dabblers.
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Dabblers? So they don't take it seriously?
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Can you hear that birdsong? That is the Cardinal singing.
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh... yes, it's lovely!
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Did you happen to bring that bag of seeds?
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes, it's in the bag, next to our lunch.
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Why don't we serve him a little meal to get him closer...
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think it's working! I see him - and his great little hairdo!
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why do you love birding so much, Julius?
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It is the best mindfullness practice I know, my dear.
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Enjoying the fresh air, the vitamin D, the wonderful wildlife. Birding is---
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Wings and flutter! Hand me my binoculars, Maddie! Quickly!
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What did you spot?
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: A long-tailed tit - the fluffiest of all birds!
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Be very quiet, Maddie. I just saw a Snowy Owl in a tree over there.
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Snowy Owl? Aren't owls nocturnal?
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Yes, they are - but not the Snowy Owl.
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Look! Isn't it wonderful and majestic?
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So cute!!
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Err-- and majestic, too!
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Robins are so cute!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: They are! But did you know there are nine subspecies of Robin?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So many?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: And that Robins are so widespread that there are hundreds of millions of them across the globe?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Way to go, little Robin!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can see a bird in the water. I don't think I've ever spotted it before.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Oh? What does it look like?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It has a black head, kind ofa checkered body and... red eyes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ah, it is the Common Loon.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The eyes are a little eerie, I know.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Peacocks are nature's weathermen. They call out when it is going to rain.
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Really?
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Yes, indeed - but unfortunately they are not known for their beautiful song.
lines.author: dawncat

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've done some studying since our last bird- watching trip, and I can't wait to get out there!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: How marvelous! The weather looks most promising, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Hello, old people!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We're not that old!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Are you planning for a *bird-watching* day?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, yes...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I rest my case.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: How about you make it more interesting?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What do you mean?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Let's see which one of you can spot the most exotic creature.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Hmmm... I feel I have an unfair advantage, as I have been bird-watching for much longer.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You might be surprised by how much I've learned. I've had an excellent teacher, after all!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Flattery will get you everywhere. Let's do it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I bet Julius has already spotted a dozen exotic birds...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But I won't give up! I think I can hear something...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It almost sounds like a... tiny kitten!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ah, I can see movement in a tree over there... but I cannot hear its song.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This might be my chance to capture a truly exotic bird.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Nnggh, got it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What am I looking at?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That is a baby squirrel. And so cute!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You may know, Julius, that spring is the best time for bird-watching.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Correct, Maddie. Migratory birds returning to nest offer a veritable cornucopia ofavian delights!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Errr, yes... Exactly!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: In fact, I think I can already see something in the grass!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's no bird!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: A baby hedgehog!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Many birds love the water. I'm hedging my bets and heading towards the biggest splashes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's definitely something over there...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's a big one!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's a... baby capybara??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Okay, I've got this. I just need to remember the basics.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Stay quiet and move slowly. " No problem there. I'm stealth and stealth is me.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Listen before looking." Hmmm, I can definitely hear something close by.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Blend in. " Outfit check, done.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Now, what's that behind that tree?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, that bird forgot its wings... and grew extra cute!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ooh, there's something substantial over there.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: This could win me the competition!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Oh, my! Do my eyes betray me or is that an abnormally large rabbit??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Aaaaah!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Mason!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: This elusive creature loves pranks and practical jokes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Let's hear it! Which one of you spotted the most exotic bird?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I only spotted adorable baby animals, but I'm not complaining!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I am not sure about birds, but I did spot something that took me quite by surprise.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: A rare winged wonder - Mason!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: What can I say? I photograph really well.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: This whole bird-watching thing is actually not as boring as I thought.
lines.author: ansku7128

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: You need to be real quiet to spot them, like a spy.
lines.author: ansku7128

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: AND I read that birds are like tiny dinosaurs!
lines.author: ansku7128

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: My senses are tingling... There's something in a tree over there!
lines.author: ansku7128

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: The cutest little dinosaurs ever!!
lines.author: ansku7128

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I just saw a flash of blue in that big oak tree.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You might have glimpsed a Blue Jay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Acorns are their favorite treat.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Can you hear the song? Yes, that is definitely a Blue Jay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: There is one bird you can always spot, even at this time of year.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The Herring Gull! You can find it in our beautiful Bay, but it also enjoys spending time at garbage dumps and parking lots.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ewww, sounds... lovely.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Eek, we're so close to the cliffs. Maybe we should go back... Whoah!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What was that??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The reason I brought you here. It was a Peregrine Falcon - one of the fastest birds in the world!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are you sure it was a bird? It was so fast it just looked like a flash of brown.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Oh, yes! It is a realjoy to watch.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at that huge hole in the tree trunk!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Was that made by a woodpecker?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You have good eyes, my dear. Yes, that is the handiwork ofa Pileated Woodpecker.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But it's so even and almost... rectangular.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Indeed. And that hole will make a good home for another little animal.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Huh! It must be a good neighbor.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That black bird over there looks very odd!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Actually, I can tell you it's a Crescent-caped Lophorina.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Well, well! You are right! What an amazing display.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It is, right? The male uses its black coloring as a part of its courtship ritual.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: And very effective it is, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe we should head back - it's already getting dark.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Not just yet... I heard there is a Long-eared Owl living in these woods.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Can you hear it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can. It's a real hoot!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is that a small bird or a big dragonfly?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It has a wonderful plumage, don't you think?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Indeed!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can see an owl!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Awww, it's so cute!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What kind of an owl is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Err... I'm not sure. It's brown with white spots. It's not too big.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That sounds like a Burrowing Owl.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Burrowing? Does that mean it lives... underground??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It does, indeed!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The more you know...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You hear that? There must be geese approaching.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yup, I can see a whole flock of Canada Geese flying overhead.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a sight, huh?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It is one of the joys of bird-watching, my dear!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I thought I just saw something over there in those trees, but I don't think it was actually anything.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hang on! There's definitely something there!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Where? Over there, past the shrubbery?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Exactly! No, I think I was wrong, after all.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You weren't wrong at all! It just happens to be a bird that is a true master ofcamouflage - a Willow Ptarmigan!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ohl wow! Is that a Red-crowned Crane?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've never seen one before.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: They are a very rare sight these days, so this is a very lovely surprise!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Do you see how they almost seem to be dancing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, yeah! Why are they doing that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It's a way for them to warn the others of some danger.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Quite inventive, I would say!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How common are Dunlins?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Quite common! But they are mostly found on shorelines, like here in Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We are pretty well situated for bird-watching here, aren't we?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: We sure are. But the autumn is my favorite time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why's that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Fewer mosquitos!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Well, well, well! If it isn't the shoebill wading in the water, looking for a snack!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a silly name.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Do not be fooled! That bill is powerful, with razor- sharp edges and a pointed hook at the end to finish offeven a huge fish.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I think I might have a real treat for you, my dear!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is it? A cool eagle or some exotic bird?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Why don't you take a look!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, WOW! What is that bird??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: A Mandarin Duck. It's a very shy bird, but always a joy to spot.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It might be my new favorite!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What in tarnation! Look at that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ummm. I don't know... some kind ofgrouse?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That, Maddie, is a Eurasian Capercaillie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, my! What vibrant plumage. And that eye!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It is all a part of its elaborate, and famous, courtship display.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Beautiful!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Aha! Do you recognize that bird, Maddie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Of course, I do! It's a Mourning Dove. Also known as a Turtledove!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How strange we haven't seen one until now! They are quite common, after all.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Do you hear that call? Almost sounds like an owl! A sad one.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And if there's one, there's likely to be a lot more. Let's snap that picture!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Look Maddie! Do you see that little white bird?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I do! I got a picture, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That is an Arctic Tern. Look at its little black skullcap.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a cutie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The Arctic Tern is famous for its migration, all the way from the Arctic to Antarctica!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It flies up to 25 000 miles per year.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Quite the frequent flier!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at that beauty! What pretty wings!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ah, yes! A Red-winged Blackbird. Endemic to all of North America.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's a male, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That is correct, Maddie. Only the males have the distinctive red-and-yellow shoulder patch.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Got the shot! Thank you, sir!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: what a beauty! who is this little charmer?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: A Bohemian Waxwing. Look at that crest!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh yes! I think I've seen this one. It eats berries, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Especially in winter. Sometimes it can get a bit dizzy on fermented berries.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A party bird! At least the hairstyle matches.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Oh, my, do you hear that? I think...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: ...that is a White-Breasted Nuthatch!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh! That is a loud, loud little bird!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: So it is! Did you know they sometimes travel in flocks with other birds, like titmice and chickadees?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I did not! Very sociable!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Look! Look at that beauty in pink!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is that a flamingo? It can't be a flamingo?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That is a Roseate Spoonbill. Look at the shape of its bill.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Incredible! Does it also get its color from its diet, like the flamingo?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Right again, my dear. It comes from the crustaceans they eat. Fascinating, is it not?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ah, hmm! I would know that sound anywhere!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The tell-tale sound ofa Common Snipe in flight!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Perhaps not the most exotic animal, but an exciting sight nonetheless! Let's see...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: ...what on Earth! That isn't a Common Snipe! That is an adorable lamb!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's that over there? It's too big to be a mouse, so it must be...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A ferret! Andjust a baby, by the looks of it. Hello, little one!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are you tame? You look tame. Do you want to come home with me?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: This time I'm going to find something better than a chicken!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Not that a chicken isn't pretty cool, ofcourse.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Wait - I think I see something! I bet it's a wolf! Or a tiger!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Whoa! Is that...is that...a raccoon? That's EVEN COOLER!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe I will find that Scarlet Tanager still. It's pretty rare, I think.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Although... it is fun to look down from the sky once in a while.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You never know what you might find, like...oh my gosh!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Isn't that the cutest puppy in the whole world?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Julius, look at that one! That's a Wilson's Warbler, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Close! It is a Hooded Warbler. Wilson's Warblers only have a small black cap, not a whole hood.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Watch for its white tail feathers when it displays them. That is another way you can tell.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aw, shoot. I thought I was getting good at this.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You are, Maddie! I just happen to have, ahem, a few more decades of experience!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Give it time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a beauty - a bluebird, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Yes, my dear - an Eastern Bluebird, to be precise. Looks like it hasn't molted its bright blue feathers yet!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Look how it's perched, looking for insects to eat. They have incredible vision.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Also makes for a great pose for this photo!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Bluebirds can have several broods per year. Their later chicks even stay with them over winter, sometimes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's funny, lately I've been dreaming of bluebirds. Maybe I predicted getting this shot!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I see, I see. That warms my heart, Maddie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at that tail, Julius! It's a little hard to see, but when the sun catches it just right...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: A Black-billed Magpie! And yes, that is some impressive tail plumage.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: They are said to be 'wearing the rainbow' according to Native American myth, as thanks for being so...helpful.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Helpful? Last time I was on a picnic, a magpie 'helpfully' tried to steal my sandwich!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Well now! They are very intelligent, sociable, and fearless birds, to be sure. I am always excited to see one.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmmm. If I feed it, do you think it'll bring me little shiny baubles?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Perhaps! Or perhaps it will steal some from you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Oh! Oh! Maddie, you are getting your wish today! Look at that little fellow!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What little fellow? All I see is sand...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Look for the orange legs! That's a Piping Plover! They are extremely rare and extremely endangered!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I see it now! Let me snap a picture, you handsome little floofball...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Let's not get too close. If you ever see a Piping Plover that looks like its wing is broken...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: ...it's probablyjust trying to lead you away from its nest in the sand!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll be careful. I'm just happy to see one from afar!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This one I know - that's an eider duck!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Yes, indeed, Maddie. It may look like a common duck, but it is quite famous.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Of course - eiderdown, used in pillows and blankets and such.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That is correct! Their latin name is Somateria mollissima, which means 'softest body'.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: We have been collecting down feathers from eider nests since... well, since the 7th century, perhaps earlier!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ofcourse only kings could afford it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: ...l don't think that part's changed very much...l just looked up how much an eiderdown pillow costs!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We've been waiting forever, Julius! Where is this bird of yours?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Patience is a virtue, Maddie. You have been birding long enough to know that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know, I know. I'm just not sure what I'm supposed to see.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: There! That's it! It just flew down to the bottom of that tree!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Huh? I must've missed it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Happens to the best of us, my dear! Look - it's camouflaged against the bark. Now it's creeping upwards, slowly!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh! I see it now. Wow! It'sjust walking up that tree, isn't it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Indeed! A Brown Creeper. They eat insects, methodically zigzagging up the trunks like that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well worth the wait, Julius. I'm sorry for doubting you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Julius! I think I saw a... a parrot?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That can't be right. Unless it's somebody's escaped pet. Let me see...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ah! No, Maddie, not a parrot. That is a type of cardinal! A Painted Bunting!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's so colorful! I never thought I'd see something like this in our neck of the woods.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: And he sings, too! Beautifully! We got very lucky today, Maddie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Not luck, my friend, but perseverance and patience.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Who would do such a thing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, dearie... Have you read the news?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I thought you and Jackie were friends?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So did l...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It says here that Ignatius Boulton spied on the people of Hopewell Bay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And sold those secrets! He... allegedly did this across the country and secretly used the tin can factory to transport them!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: ... Is this true, Grandma? Is our family responsible?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maddie, it's very complicated...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: l... I need some time alone, Grandma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And do something with all these cans!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Alright, dearie... Alright.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Maddie! I made these for you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Binoculars? Why?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yeah! The papers said your family are spies!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: And every good spy needs good binoculars.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Good grief...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hi, Maddie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Jackie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I guess... I guess you read the paper.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yep. And used it to wipe off the little message your "fans" left on my door.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thanks for that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maddie! I didn't mean to-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, I know exactly what you meant!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "NEVER trust a Boulton?!" Jackie! We were friends!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How could you do this?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Just go...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Hi, Maddie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy! If Jackie sent you here to talk, I swear...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Easy! No, she doesn't know I'm here. I just wanted to come and see how you're doing...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, as you can see, I'm doing my darndest to work off some steam.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I have to get rid of these cans somehow.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Need some help?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thanks, Roddy... I'd like that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Wow, neat! You're really creative, Maddie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Hey... That guy looks familiar...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: YEAH!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, you need to tell me, is what Jackie wrote the truth?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I'm sorry, dearie... But yes. Yes, it is.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But... But why would he do that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Because tin cans weren't the only way our family made their fortune...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ignatius Boulton started by collecting secrets from all the wealthiest families in Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Soon, that turned into ALL the families in the country. Information like that is worth a lot of money.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: His connections allowed him to create a vast network of information gathering. He used the tin can factory as a cover to transport them secretly to all his clients.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: ... Sometimes, I wish she never invented the thing...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She? Who?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, sorry... I must have gotten confused.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But, dearie, this was a long time ago. The entire operation was shut down.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: This'll all blow over soon enough. It always does...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Tadaa!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Holy smokes, you built all that?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yeah! Well... Roddy helped a bit.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: A bit?! I did the whole thing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Alone...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yeah, well, I drew the schematics!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: In crayon!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Well, what did you expect? I'm just a kid!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Haha! You two are cute!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Is that supposed to be you, dearie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Er... Yeah.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Why do you look so sad?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I dunno... I guess I feel like all I do is clean up the family mess.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma! What are you doing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I'm building myself. We're in this together, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well... At least all the cans are gone. Feel any better?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah... A little. I just needed to let out some frustration.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What better way than to use all these cans for some art!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Just kidding!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Boy... What a year, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Something tells me it'll only get crazier...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... This place looks more like a music studio than anything else!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder what type of music was made in here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And who this person was, for that matter!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ooh, I think they were someone famous! It could be the one who made that hit single - Homegrown in Hopewell Bay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow... Who would hide a room like this behind a fridge?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie, there you are! Wait, did I just walk through a fridge- Wow!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, more secret rooms. Who would have thought! What is it, Roddy?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well, you won't believe it, but I think this mansion is protected!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It certainly is! I'll do anythin-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: No! I mean historically protected! As in protected by the state!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie, I might have found documents that confirm THIS mansion is a historical heritage site!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?! That means-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: That means it can't be torn down, changed, or even touched by Bruno!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy, that's FANTASTIC!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well, hold your horses. I still need to find the original documents and blueprints. They seem to have been "misplaced."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Bruno...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Yeah... I'm pulling some strings to see if I can scrounge them up.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: You called, ma'am? I assume this has something to do with the construction workers outside...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes! Winston, do you think you can deal with the mayor's cronies and tell me what they're up to?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: With pleasure, ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well... I should head back to city hall and see if I can't find those documents.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Yeah?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: With everything that's happened... and is happening, I don't think I've properly ever had the chance to thank you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Oh, don't mention it... I'm only-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No Roddy, listen to me... Thank you. You've had my back ever since we've met.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Huh? Ohl I mean, yeah...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You've always been around to help me, never doubted me... You've been the best!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well,er I
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: The thing is, Maddie... I - I think you're an amazing person.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aw shucks, Roddy! You're amazing too...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie... The real reason l... We... Maddie, I think I'm in l-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: *beep beep*
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What the- a message from ARTHUR?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Hey, Mads...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know you're still upset... You have every right to be, but you must believe me when I say that I had no choice.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wish I could go back to that day and change things.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Every day, I regret what I did to you... But things will change.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I hope to see you soon, Mads... This time, it will be different. - Arthur"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: l... I don't believe it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't believe he sent me a message after all this time!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Are you going to reply?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess I have to think about it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait, what were you saying earlier? Before the text?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: That l... I got to get back to the office.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh... Okay. See you, Roddy...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy, you're back so soon! Did you find the documents?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: No... Not yet. A lot of the files for the older buildings in Hopewell Bay are disorganized.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: It almost seems as if on purpose. No one at city hall nor the archives can be bothered to go through them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I'm doing my best to check, but a lot of the archived files have been thrown into the basement.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: And it's dark down there...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie! I found out that family members of people who built this mansion are still alive.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: They might know something, but they said I need to help them with some errands first.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Trying to earn some brownie points?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: A tried and tested method, Maddie. Tried and tested...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Dearie, who are all these people outside in hard hats?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: For a moment, I thought we were being ambushed by an army of Roddys.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They're Bruno's people. Hopefully Winston has slowed them down.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: If there's anything he's capable of doing well, it is slowing things down.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Good. Then we mightjust have enough time to save the mansion!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What do you mean, dearie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's right, Grandma! Roddy has found a way to save the mansion!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Really? How?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He says the mansion was declared a heritage site, but he needs to find the documents to prove it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I always knew that boy was bright!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Is everything alright with you, dearie? You look like you've seen a ghost!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You could say that. I just received a text from Arthur!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: WHAT? That no good, meddling-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I thought I told him-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Told him what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh nothing, dearie... I'm mixing things up.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, I've been meaning to ask about the resident of this room...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Who was this person, anyway?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ah yes, they called him the "Musical Maverick. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But his real name was Eddie. A distant cousin and quite the recluse!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Eddie went through a time where fans would chase him wherever he went and linger around his studio.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sounds like he was really popular...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, but he was so terribly fed up that he asked if he could record here, at the mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Charlie and I were happy to help. we have plenty of rooms!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We never really saw much of him, though. But we did hear plenty of music!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ugh... Linoleum... If there's anything I hate, it's linoleum.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A mansion is no place for such... tackiness. As Winston would say.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, sweet! An old portable cassette player!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I remember fixing Grandma's old one many times!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Although, it tended to eat a lot of tapes afterward...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's a fancy-looking speaker...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: As an audiophile myself, I reckon it has a real rich sound.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've seen some of these designer chairs around... I think they were really popular in the 70s.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe not exactly to my taste, but somehow it really ties this room together!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder if Julius has any more of these?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These must be all his mixtapes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: l... don't recognize any of the songs...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are they all unpublished originals?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: ...More importantly, are they any good?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: For such a recluse, they sure won a lot ofawards...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, wait a minute!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Best dressed?!"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't figure out the name, but this must be someone the musician admired!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at all this amazing vintage stuff!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Holy smokes, some of this is even signed by the original musician!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I could really make a fortune selling some of this...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmmm, I should ring Julius.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He'd have a field day in here!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How cool! A light fashioned out of tin!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And it looks just like the Boulton cans...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He really was a genius!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How's it going, Roddy?
lines.author: laitostarr777
