lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: It took a bit of work, but I think I found something!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Her great-great-grandfather was a supervisor for the Mansion's construction.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: She let me look through some old designs and papers, and I found the name of an accountant.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: They might have more details, if not the documents we need, but...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But they need your help first?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Tried and tested!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Bad news, Maddie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wh- What is it?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: The accountant had some important documents, which finally led me back to City Hall.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: But when I opened the file box... They were missing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But didn't you say they were disorganized?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: No, Maddie, this box was behind a lock and key.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Those files were taken away! That's illegal!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Uh oh... What now?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well... I have one last thread to pull, but... it'll cost me.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Cost you? How?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Don't worry about it. Just an old friend.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But what happened to him, Grandma? Does he still make music?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, I don't think so, dearie. It's not a pleasant story...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well, Eddie had a sudden rise in popularity after his hit, and he needed a record label.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: He signed a contract with a smooth-talking record executive, even though he wasn't so sure.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh no, I don't like the sound of this...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The label started to act strange, taking over creative control.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: According to the contract, he was still obliged to write and perform four songs under the label.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's what those other songs were! What happened then?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: He made sure those songs were nothing like his first hit, and the label couldn't publish it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: After that, he left and never made music again.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh my...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So if Eddie hadn't signed with that record label, he might still be making music today...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I-I can't help but sympathize with him. After all, I am in a similar situation.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And this proves that I should never take Bruno and Victoria's deal.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: If I do, we could lose everything in a moment.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, dearie. It is a valuable lesson, and I'm glad you can see through their facade.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Never ever give away your power, my dear.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You're right. Thanks, Grandma! I needed to hear this.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmmm, I don't know too much about amplifiers but...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think this part goes here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I hope this actually works...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow, this amplifier looks... complicated.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This is definitely some high-quality equipment!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It also looks like it was customized...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Huh, the maximum volume on this device is 77? | didn 't know that was possible!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Homegrown in Hopewell Bay"... Oh wow! This must be the gold record for the hit!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The name is a bit faded, but I can make out an E... for Eddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie! I found them!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You did?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Yes! It's all here! Proof that this Mansion is protected as a heritage site!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Great!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: But I still need to verify these, just in case.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Remember the string I had to pull?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well, it's an old friend of mine. We both owed each other a few favors.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Some of the stuff I helped them with was... odd.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Remind me to never work at a restaurant again!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Alright, thanks again, Roddy. I'll be waiting...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, cool! A Steely 86' Rocker!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Mint condition, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A suitable replacement for my old guitar, which I lost in the fire...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This studio has some impressive equipment!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But many almost look like they're prototypes...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Where did he get his hands on all this stuff?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Or did he build it himself?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Phew! That's the last of the music sheets!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: of Eddie's rage at why these sheets were scattered around now. Col
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I would be furious, too, if I were hint. Co'
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow, that rhythm! So catchy and very much from the 80s!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, wait, there's a section here that requires an electric guitar!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's all the motivation I need to try out that fancy guitar next!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The guitar isn't even plugged in, and wow... it feels powerful.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is this how musicians feel onstage? How thrilling!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The sound is so crisp. I bet this guitar is modified as well.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'd love to see how it sounds with that fancy
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That red button is calling out to me...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: W-whatjust happened.... I-I'm shaking... And covered in dust!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait, that door! It has to be the way to the next room!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, that was certainly one of the more interesting ways offinding an exit...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm still a bit shaken up. The amplifier was way more powerful than I thought.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And it's possible that I didn't calibrate it right...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, I'm glad Eddie isn't around to see the mess I created.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I should get all of this cleaned up!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Phew, that was some heavy lifting. Now, to see what's behind this door...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: *Ring Ring*
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ugh, this better not be Arthur...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello? Winston? I'm kind of in the middle-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Slow down, I can't hear you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Leonard and Bruno are what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: At the ranch?! Why would they be there?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You've got to be kidding me. Does it ever end?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll be right there, Winston!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What is it, dearie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You won't believe what I found in the cellar! An old tunnel with tracks! It's huge!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That?! You know about it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ohyes, dearie. That's the old tunnel that lead to the Boulton tin mine!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Why don't you read Ignatius's journal about it? It tells about the mines "interesting" history!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Today, I've opened the Boulton Mine in the old meteor crater, and the first samples of tin are promising.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The miners are in high spirits as they uncover vein after vein of pure tin ore.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I foresee great things for the factory with this new supply.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Weeks have passed, and we continue to extract an abundance of tin, but strange red gems have begun to appear among the deposits.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: They are unlike anything I've seen before, shimmering with an inner light that seems almost alive.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I've decided to name the gems Boultonite after myself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The deeper we dig, the more gems we find! Amethysts, Topaz, even Lapis Lazuli! All in the same mine!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: This is truly a rare, if unique, find! Among the other precious stones, we still find Boultonite.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I have contacted some scientist acquaintances to come and investigate...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Edison arrived today and immediately took an interest in the electrical properties of Boultonite.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: He believes this gem could hold the key to a new form ofenergy, one that could revolutionize the world.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I'm eager to see what he and the others can uncover.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: More scientists have joined our efforts, and their experiments with Boultonite have yielded astonishing results.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: He claims the gem can generate a magnetic field more powerful than anything he has encountered.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I begin to wonder if this discovery is bigger than any of us anticipated...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: After months of research, the scientists are unanimous: Boultonite is no ordinary gem.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The potential applications are staggering...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Boultonite promises unimaginable wealth!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The workers are curious, and their excitement mirrors my own as we uncover more of these fascinating gems.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I'm confident that Boultonite will bring us unprecedented success and recognition.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: My scientists wishes to do more experiments on the Boultonite.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: News of our discovery has spread, and inquiries are pouring in from around the country.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Investors and scientists alike are eager to learn more about Boultonite, and the excitement is palpable.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I'm thrilled that our work is gaining the recognition it deserves.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Today, as we examined the mine's location within the ancient impact crater, it dawned on us that Boultonite might have come from space.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The unique properties of the gem suggest an extraterrestrial origin, possibly brought here by the meteor millions of years ago.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: This revelation has added a new layer of intrigue to our discovery, fueling our determination to unlock its secrets.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: With our scientists and Edison's encouragement, we've successfully used Boultonite to power a prototype machine that automatically sorts cans and their contents.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The machine operates with incredible precision, far beyond anything we've achieved before.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: This breakthrough not only showcases Boultonite's potential but also promises to revolutionize our tin can production process.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Maddie! Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow, calm down Mason. What's got you so excited?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: l- I just heard there are mines under Hopewell Bay, FILLED with treasure and and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Andjewels and all sorts of cool stuff! Maybe I could ask Santa for some of them!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You know, I did find something in Ignatius's journal on the mines about the holiday season.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He loved reading it to his children. Do you want to hear it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yeah!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: T'was the night before Christmas, when all through the house
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Not a creature was stirring, not even a mouse
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The stockings were hung by the chimney with care,
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: In hopes that St. Nicholas soon would be there
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The children were nestled all snug in their beds,
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: While visions ofsugar-plums danced in their heads
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: When out on the lawn there arose such a clatter,
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I sprang from the bed to see what was the matter.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: He was chubby and plump, a right jolly old elf,
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: And I laughed when I saw him, in spite of myself
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: A bundle of Toys he had flung on his back,
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: And he look'd like a pedlar just opening his pack.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: He spoke not a word, but went straight to his work,
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: And fill'd all the stockings; then turned with a jerk
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: But I heard him exclaim, ere he drove out of sight,
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: "Happy Holidays to all, and to all a good night. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: It seems Santa has saved the best for the last;
lines.author: ruphelkopter

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Rewarding himself for good deeds of the past
lines.author: ruphelkopter

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Today, a curious letter arrived, accompanied by an old key.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: It spoke ofa legendary sunken treasure and a crown jewel, with eerie and peculiar properties.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: From its description, I theorize it may in fact be a piece of Boultonite! Could it be true?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The key that came with the letter led me to the archives where it unlocked an old dusty chest.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Filled with dusty records, the chest contained clues that will hopefully lead me to the treasure's location.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I should take time to study these clues, if I'm to seek this treasure.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I've spent many nights poring over the various documents and old maps the chest contained.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: But I believe I have finally discovered the location of the last known location of the sunken ship!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: A chain of uncharted islands off the coast may hold the fortune that I am seeking!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Preparations are underway!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I've chartered a power steam ship and assembled a capable crew.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The promise of fortune and discovery fills their hearts and my own. The adventure is about to begin!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: After months at sea, we have finally arrived near an uncharted island!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Its rocky silhouette that looms against the horizon is almost exactly described in the clues I uncovered!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: A massive cave entrance beckons us, emanating a ghostly sound, whispering secrets of what lies within.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Incredible! Our exploration of the cavern's depths has revealed a wrecked ship!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: To our astonishment, the ship hadn't sunk at all but was left derelict within this cave...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Why? But a disturbing question remains...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Exploring the ship has frustratingly not revealed any answers why the ship was hidden here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Furthermore, the main hold of the ship has flooded, halting our exploration.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We must proceed with our diving equipment if we are to reach the treasure hold!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: With diving equipment secured, we descended into the watery depths...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: After struggling to remove some rotten wood and debris, we have finally arrived at the main treasure hold.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We must rest now and continue in the morning. After all this time, the treasure is finally within reach!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: With excitement, we finally opened the treasure hold, revealing its wonders!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Golden artifacts, ancient trinkets and unbelievable hoards of riches greeted us.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: And there, amidst this hoard ofa century, I finally saw it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: A Colossal Boultonitejewel, radiant and untouched, a crowning jewel to a lost dynasty.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Now, as I sail home and the jewel gleaming in the sun, I am struck with a thought.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: What became of the crew of that ship? And...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: What if this jewel had something to do with it?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I have continued my studies on the mysterious properties of Boultonite.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Its potential is staggering, yet I find myself hard- pressed to find any practical use for it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I have decided to head to the World Fair in search of the brightest minds that could help me solve this riddle.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Ah, the World Fair! An astounding exhibition of culture and science.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Hopefully, I'll find someone here who can help me harness the potential of Boultonite!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Who knows... I may be perhaps attending next year with my own inventions, powered by Boultonite.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Success! I have encountered a mathematical genius showing off his new computational machine.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We had a very productive meeting, as I showed him a small sample of Boultonite. He was astounded!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: He believes Boultonite could power a very similar machine that could be ten times more powerful!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: At last! After months of designing and tinkering, my Mark I prototype is ready for testing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: If my calculations are correct, my new Boultonite- powered machine will revolutionize the world.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: And put the Boulton name firmly on the map!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Failure! Soon after starting the prototype, it overheated! Try as I may, there was nothing I could do.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: A chain reaction began that resulted in the destruction of the prototype and a better part of my workshop.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Regardless, I have gathered plenty of data from this and have begun working on a new Mark 11 design.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: My Mark 11 design is complete! I discovered that there was inadequate shielding for the Boultonite core.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: This time around, I have reinforced the housing and increased the power output, ten fold!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Ifanything, it is safer and more powerful than before! I have also added some new "intelligent" functionality.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I have moved to my secondary workshop. Testing my Mark 11 model seems to have given explosive results.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: While the shielding held, the Mark 11 prototype became... uncontrollable. I cannot quite grasp what happened.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: It almost seemed alive! In fear, I had to disable it, which led to the inevitable destruction of my workshop.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Eureka! I have solved it! I do not know how, but... I have solved it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: It came to me in a dream and the moment I woke; I drew up the designs for a Boultonite Heart!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Testing it has resulted in a stable output of unfathomable power. THIS will power my Mark Ill!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: At last, it is complete! My Mark Ill prototype. But I shall call it the Computational Boss. CB-01 for short.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: It will definitely be of help in my factory plans and will be the model for all future automation!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: However, it still seems to have a few intricacies that need ironing out...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I don't know if it was the long night, but I swear... It feels like it has an attitude all of its own.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Boultonite has proven to be an exceptional material for my engineering research!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: It now powers the heart of my latest creation, CB- 01. However...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I am left with a curious thought. What OTHER uses may it have?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Is that Ignatius' oldjournal?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It is! I just can't put it down. The world was so different then - everything still there to be explored and discovered.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Which part are you reading now?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He's writing about a news story he read about a meteorite that supposedly landed somewhere in the Arctic...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He didn't really travel there, too, did he?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Keep reading! It is a good story.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Just this morning, I read in the newspaper about a fascinating case - a meteorite of some size that landed in the far north.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: This land is largely uncharted and very dangerous, but the meteorite could yield great resources.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I am in the process of putting together a crew to travel to the north and search for the meteorite, but I truly do not know what awaits us...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Our expedition has taken off at such speed that, since my last entry, we have already set out and reached the colder climes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I feel as though we are at the end of the earth. The sea is vast, with only some birds to keep us company.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Our ship is strong against the wind and tides, but there is a trepidation among our crew. There are many dangers ahead.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We are keeping warm as best we can, but I admit, I cannot wait to finally reach our destination.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The long journey has allowed me to make plans and calculations. The meteorite's celestial origins promise a great deal of possibilities.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We are drawing closer to the ice pack. We were forewarned about the dangers lurking here, but we must forge ahead.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Members of my brave crew are conducting scientific study of the area, which I predict will prove to be very useful indeed - as long as we do not become trapped by the ice...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Yesterday, we reached land. We disembarked, formed two smaller groups and set out with some basic supplies to explore further.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Our tents are woefully weak against the elements here, but our spirits are high. According to my calculations, the meteorite is close!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Alas, we have had to abandon our initial plan. The pack ice is threatening to trap our ship, if the worst happens, we will be confined in this frozen realm for a considerable time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We are not out of danger, but the safety of the crew must come first.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We must be close to land - and the meteorite! If my calculations hold true, the movements of the ice have been most fortuitous.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: A small group I dispatched to scout the area returned and confirmed what I so hoped for: The meteorite is here!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Yesterday, we set out before first light, and sure enough - we found a sizeable crater. What I found there quite astounded me.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: A blue gem, light and luminescent in quality, and abundant in the crater. I want to return to the site to collect all the material, but the ice encroaches upon our ship once more.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: There is still time...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: My enthusiasm was premature. We are imprisoned by the ice once more - this time without any recourse.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We have no choice but to wait until the winter eases, but that is many months from now. While we wait, I will begin my experiments with the new gem.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Unique and exceptionally beautiful - it must be worth this pain.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You know a lot about the Boulton family history, don't you, Julius?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You could say that. I have conducted research into your family's heraldry, and let me tell you - it is fascinating!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No doubt... but would you happen to know anything about Ignatius?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Are you interested in his travels?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't help it - I'm totally hooked!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I am not surprised. Have you read about how he ended up shipwrecked on a desert island in the middle of the ocean?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No! He didn't!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: He did, and made it all the way back home.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Mrs Boulton, my wife, recently came into possession of an old oil painting.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: A trifling image in itself, it concealed an altogether greater enigma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Pictured in the portrait is a lady wearing a necklace with an astoundingly beautiful, iridescent pearl!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I am captivated by it, and desperate to find out more about its history and present.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Alas, the magnificent necklace is lost to history, but I have managed to find some information about it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The story of the Pearl is both exciting and tragic, and it seems it has claimed countless poor souls.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: However, I find myselfconflicted.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The journey to the origin of the Pearl is full of dangers, but it will not leave me alone. It occupies my mind, day and night.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I am resolved to find this Pearl, but my research has yielded little in the way ofdirections.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The ocean is vast, and I am unsure how to continue. This uncertainty plagues me.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I must find a way forward.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I have corresponded with a distant associate, located on a faraway continent, and he has been able to tell me more about these legendary pearls.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: They are formed inside large shells, called conchs, found in shallow waters around certain tropical islands.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I have my directions and I have my mission.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Our journey to the tropics is under way. I have an able crew, and the winds are fair - not storm in sight!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We have been very lucky. I expect to be home to Agatha earlier than I expected.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The winds are picking up, and the waves are gathering strength. My crew fears a storm is rising.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: I am still confident we can circle around the foul weather and arrive on schedule.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We must, for my plans for the Pearl are coming along. I see great business potential! This Pearl is exactly what I have been looking for...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: A coveted asset! TAP to collect 500 points.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Our plan to steer clear of the weather has failed. With storm fronts approaching from multiple directions, we have found ourselves in a perilous position.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Our ship creaks with each crashing wave. It was not built for such battles, nor was l!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The hope of finding the pearl gives me courage, but for how long can we keep going?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The very worst has come to pass. A mighty storm caused our ship to run aground, leaving us shipwrecked on a remote island.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: With little hope of finding rescue - or indeed, the pearl - we are faced with certain doom.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The most incredible thing has happened! A large sailing vessel, attempting the fastest circumnavigation of the globe, happened upon us.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We have been saved!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Not only that, but our defeated days on the desert island turned victorious when we discovered the fabled conchs in the shallow waters around it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We are lucky, indeed. And soon... rich!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: We have returned home at last, weathered and alive.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: The pearl rests now in my study, glowing faintly even in darkness, as though it holds a light all its own.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: What began as an enigma in a painting became a journey ofa lifetime.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ignatius
lines.text: Yet, as I gaze upon the pearl, I wonder... Did we truly find it? Or did it find us?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, man...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What is it, dearie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I just realized that I'd promised to organize a ghost tour at the Mansion for Halloween.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You know, before the storm and the cans full of secrets...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maybe it is not such a bad idea.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm not sure how many people would want to come...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And I'm not sure I really want to see anyone, either!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm still upset with Jackie for writing in the newspaper about our family. I get why she did it, but STILL...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The first step out ofany mess is to make amends, Maddie dear. Maybe this isjust the thing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Let's get all the skeletons out of the closet!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hey. Listen, I'm so sorry the exposé about your family... I thought I wasjust doing myjob, but l...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I let my ambition win.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You knew it would hurt my family - and me! I don't know how I can trust you again.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: It wasn't personal... I just believe people have the right to know the truth.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm so sorry, Maddie. Let me make it up to you! You're organizing a ghost tour at the Mansion, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Let me publish an ad for it in the paper. I know it doesn't make up for anything, but let me help. Please?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whatever, it's not like anyone's coming anyway.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: You might be wrong about that. We can make the ad funny and inviting.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I want to save our friendship. Please, let me try.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Your plan for the tour looks excellent, and the Mansion looks way creepier when you're looking for ghosts!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It sure does! But all the spirits here are friendly -- or at least I think so.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I'll talk to Cherry about making snacks for the tour, and we're good to go!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: 0K, let's write this ad. What do you want it to say?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't know... I'm not sure there's any point.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Come on, this ad could really help draw in some crowds.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Fine. I guess it could say something like, "Experience the most haunted house in Hopewell Bay!"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And maybe, "Come for the scary stories and stay for the Halloween snacks. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: No one's able to turn down free snacks!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The ad should be upbeat and fun. Don't you agree?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Perfect.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: We have a problem.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Cherry said she's too busy to help with the snacks.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: It's weird because she'd already promised to do it before.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I'd even briefed her on soda flavors and the right shade of frosting.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I'm sure I saw her duck into the frozen aisle when I ran into her in the supermarket.
