lines.text: Maddie! How ya doin'? What do y-- Whooaaaaaaah!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is everything okay over there?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Not really! Owww
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This stained glass depicts a flower...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes. Do you know why, dearie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I suppose it's in remembrance of those who served in the war. Like he did.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Very good, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't believe you broke your leg... Again!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: What can I say... Plumbing is a dangerous business.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Team"?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Amelia Boulton!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Celebrated philanthropist and co-founder of Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow... She really loved Hopewell Bay, always making sure it came first.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: She was well loved in return. She truly was ahead of her times...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Incredible... I wonder what she would think of us
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I'm sure she would be proud of you, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aw, shucks!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Clara Boulton...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes... Amelia's sister.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You said she died ofa broken heart, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, It's a sad story, dearie. She died soon after her betrothed sailed off.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sounds familiar...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What you didn't know was that he stole a large portion of her fortune too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Supposedly sank somewhere off the coast. They never did find it. Good riddance, I say.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He stole from her?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, dearie. They said he was a sailor, but I think "pirate" would be a better moniker.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: She loved the ocean and especially Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess that would explain her love ofa sai- Er... Pirate.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, well. We've all had that one person who wasn't right for us.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Tell me about it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ah, a butterfly... How sadly fitting.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It makes sense...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A flitting love, precious and delicate. But also short lived.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A wreath... A sign of honor and victory!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh my... This is beautiful!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Incredible! l... I remember hearing about the "Family Tree" but I never realized it was an actual tree!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These must be Ignatius and Agatha! They look so happy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, they were really in love. She was brilliant, a natural born inventor and managed to steal his heart.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: If it wasn't for a small accident, Ignatius would have never asked to stay the night in her family's barn.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Nor would he have ever met her. Funny how little things can have such a big impact.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, how come you haven't visited the tomb?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, I did, dearie. I was here all the time when I discovered it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Back then, I even had some memorials commissioned.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But, it takes a toll on the mind and the heart and it was increasingly difficult to maintain.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I understand, it is quite... heavy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, I'll make sure to fix it up now so we can visit more often!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm, there's some sort of special tile here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A frog tile is a bit strange when it comes to decor but...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Stranger things have been found in this mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder if it's important though...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Can't get more obvious than a tin can.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: He was always a very blunt man...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I do wonder what the mirror represents, though?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You mentioned that Agatha was an inventor?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh yes, very prolific. She had a brilliant mind and practically ran the tin can operations!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But... Why isn't she as celebrated as Ignatius or Lindsay?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well... It was unfortunately a different time, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Many ofher inventions were put under Ignatius 's name, "To keep things simple. "
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ugh... How archaic.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, look!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The light from above is reflecting on Agatha's mirror and-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, the light is pointing to something...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think there's something behind that stone tile!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's a heart! And it looks like it was fashioned out of tin!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh! I understand it now!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: To declare their love for each other, they had a vow renewal ceremony. I think we're looking at it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Beautiful. A love set in stone...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know these two! Katie and Casey!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hah, yes. Those two were real rascals and surprisingly adventurous.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: They loved exploring, trying to find the best places to surf.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I guess their curiosity got the best of them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why do you say that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Don't you know? They went on a maritime expedition one day, and were never seen again.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's terrible...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Dearie, I'm afraid I'll have to let you continue on your own.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: My book club starts soon...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This is starting to sound a lot like the early days but I'll give you the benefit ofdoubt.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh don't be silly, dearie! Toodles!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A dolphin!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: To represent a free spirit of the ocean, adventurous and playful!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Much like they were, dearie. They loved the water.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A torch for the trailblazer, Lindsay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: She will forever be the explorer.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oooh! Lindsay Boulton!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She's my favorite.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: One of mine too! While she was remembered for inventing the spray can she-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She was one heck ofan adventurer!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I didn't know she travelled and explored so much. Just like you, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I guess it runs in the family!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait... This one is different!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: l... Think I know what this represents...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Charlie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?! How can that be?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: He must have known about this place and hoped we would find it so he left us a message.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It's an hourglass, meaning he's still alive. But I think he's also saying that time is running out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess the snakes mean we're in danger?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Perhaps... It could also mean eternal life. But that doesn't make sense.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandpa... What are you trying to say?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Sometimes, Charlie's a bit too secretive. But he clearly has a plan for us.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No offense, Grandma, but I don't like being pulled around like a puppet on a string.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whatever plan he has, he could surely tell me IN PERSON. And everyone else for that matter.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You're being investigated for his disappearance for goodness sakes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The police may not be the only people after him, dearie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are you saying-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes. I fear this may have something to do with Crutchley and his mob...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A snake eating its own tail?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: An ouroboros. Symbol of infinity and the cycle of creation and destruction.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's almost ominous.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It feels like Grandpa Charlie's trying to communicate to us...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wish we knew more. We could help him!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Bring him back, perhaps!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Dearie, I wouldn't worry too much about Charlie. He can take care of himself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Don't you miss him, Grandma?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: With all my heart.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But, there are dangers surrounding our family. And I trust that Charlie knows what he's doing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sigh, I understand, Grandma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Where lilies bloom in shadow's grace,
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The serpent's eyes embrace,
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The truth that lies in a glassy place."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: ...What does that mean?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's no path anywhere. And what exactly is under those vines?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ugh, and what about that frog tile? It stands out and looks like it's slightly elevated.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, wait a minute! If there's one thing I learnt from the Landing, it's that tiles can reveal paths.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: 3,2,1 andjump!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hooray! Just as I expected! And what's that in the water?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Stepping stones!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can finally get to the island!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm.. that's odd.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There are fresh flowers here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Was someone visiting this memorial recently?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder who this could be...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: Well, either we hit an old sewage pipe, or something died in this pipe.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: ugh!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Ash
lines.text: You and me! Taking on all the plumbing of Hopewell Bay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How cute!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This frog here reminds me of dad.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I remember distinctly how dad called me "his little frog".
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We would even have frog races, and he always let me cross the finish line first!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sigh, dear old dad.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: M-mom?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Dad?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's really them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: l- I need a moment...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It feels so strange to see them like this. Almost life- like.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Dad's sparkly eyes, Mom's warm smile -just like in the photos I have of them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These statues capture their essence so perfectly...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's almost as ifthey could step down from their pedestals and wrap me in their arms.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait a minute, these flowers. They couldn't have been left by Grandma, she said she hasn't been here in a while.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Lilies. Grandma once said Charlie used to call her Lily. Could there be a message for her?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Could he have been here?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That inscription on Charlie's memorial... I have a nagging feeling that I should take another look.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Where lilies bloom... Wait! This inscription is meant for Grandma to understand!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It must be some sort of riddle! It talks about a serpent's gaze... Hey! The snake on this memorial!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's looking at the seal on the floor! A glassy place!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Lets see... It's loose!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's this? A Journal? Charlie's journal! I think he meant to leave this for Grandma...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, wait a minute! It's in code!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Gaah... What is it with my family and codes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But there is something here that seems to mention another room in the mansion...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Deb, you'll never guess what the mailman just dropped off!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Nothing exciting ever lands in our mailbox, but this time there was something pretty cool among the bills and the letters from the city council!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Well, what was it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A letter from a traveling circus! They are coming to Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Hmmm, are they indeed?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Apparently they were supposed to set up in the park downtown, but some official regulation forbids it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Their plans are already made and it would be impossible for them to skip Hopewell Bay, so they need a new location - and fast.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We have plenty of space, and it would be so cool to have the circus here - at the Mansion!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: I thought you would say that. You should check this with Ursula, my dear. She might... have some objections.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, Grandma. What's so interesting on your phone?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: W-what? Ohl just comparing insurance prices, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You can save a lot of money with a good deal.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That sure sounds fascinating! Anyway, I just got a letter...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: M-mm... Extra liability coverage against property damage...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What were you saying?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's nothing big... You wouldn't mind if a circus set up in front of the Mansion, would you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Uh-huh... And I would get cyber insurance, too... Interesting...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, are you listening?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, yes. Sounds great, dearie. Now let me do this.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thank you, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It has to be the circus equipment!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Circus equipment??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I never did such a thing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You did. Remember you were checking the insurance prices, and I asked...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Aaargh... Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Besides, who doesn't love the circus!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What's all this?? Are you putting on a circus?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: vell, you could say that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Huh?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The Mansion is hosting the touring circus, and we'vejust accepted the first shipment of equipment.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What does Ursula think about it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She's so into her cat videos and knitting tutorials that she barely paid attention when I told her.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Still obsessed with her smartphone?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yep. I don't know what to do! It's like living with a phone-addicted teenager.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's time to get all this circus stuff organized.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: More ropes, juggling balls and posters!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't even imagine what it would be like to travel around the country performing wild tricks and wowing audiences everywhere.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I love all of it - the fire-eaters, acrobats, magic tricks and knife wheels...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: If only I could do anything like that, but I'm not a big fan of heights - or fire.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's probably best to leave it to the professionals.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've got most of the circus stuffin order, and I've set up a little fun fair next to Grandma's house like the ringmaster asked.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't wait for the big top to go up!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Talking about your Grandma...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is it now?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: This whole business with the smartphone seemed kinda sketchy, so I did some online research.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Well, there's a whole bunch of people spreading weird rumors about Ursula.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Could Jackie be onto something with Grandma and her phone?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I mean, it's obvious she is up to something. She panicked when she thought she'd lost her phone.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And I think she has multiple accounts on social media. But why?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Either she's doing something sketchy like Jackie suspects, or she is covering up something in order to protect me and the Mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Jackie is always so suspicious - she's so determined to get to the bottom of Grandma's secrets...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's been so busy around here with everything and Grandma is no help at all!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know Grandma hates eavesdropping, but desperate times call for desperate measures.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What are these comments under my last cat video?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I thought I already took care of this...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ugh! This is going to take more work than I originally thought.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I won't let her keep going. She is too unpredictable. And she can't find out I'm onto her...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, I hope my pie is not burning!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Jackie was right - there IS something going on.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But who was Grandma talking about?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So many questions, so few answers...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I say, Maddie! I think I just saw a group of clowns in the grocery store!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What on earth is going on?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Are you talking about the strongman training in the park?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: No, I am talking about the clowns!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: There are clowns, too??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yep, the great traveling circus headed by the legendary Fiona DuVal.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Get ready to be wowed, because we're in for a treat!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, did you hear that the circus folks are in Hopewell Bay?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Are they really? I wonder if they still have the same old wagons and big top...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait a minute. Have you seen them perform before?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: In a manner of speaking. It is quite a spectacle!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know. I can't wait to see the show!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: You must be Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I am, and you must be Fiona DuVal!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: That's right! Thank you again for letting us come to the Mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: We had planned our tour, paid for all the permits, and then the council told us we couldn't use the park after all.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: You're a real lifesaver.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The pleasure is all mine. I'm just so happy to finally meet you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've read so much about your circus.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: Thank you, Maddie. You're so kind!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let me know if there's anything I can do to help you while you're here. I can organize clown noses or hand out flyers.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: I might just take you up on your offer!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Can you do any magic tricks?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can make a pile of twigs disappear from the garden!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Wow, can I see it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's not a real magic trick, Hank. Just gardening.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Oh... but can I still see it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: You were right! The circus is in town!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I saw them setting up the big top right in front of the Mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's pretty cool, isn't it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: It sure is. But I just have one question.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: How in tarnation do you ride a bike with just one wheel?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I bought lots of raffle tickets to make sure I win the biggest prize!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: My ticket has never won, but this time the prize will be mine!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Ah, the excitement! I think I will get some raffle tickets, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What is it, Ursula? Are you not going to buy a couple of raffle tickets?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I know this crowd... At the circus, the house always wins.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: Ursula Boulton, as I live and breathe! How long has it been?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Too long to remember. It is nice to see you again, Fiona.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You look well. Still traveling and performing, I see.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You two know each other??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: Oh, yes. We go WAY back. Don't we, Ursula?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: We slept in the same wagon back in the day. We trained together and shared so many stories.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: About this place too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: The Mansion looks so much better! Someone's been working hard to turn it around.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: Is it still full of old stuff?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Like you wouldn't believe.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: Could you be a darling and hand these flyers out in town? It would be such a big help.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll get right on it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: Thankyou again, Maddie! I have to dash to the dress rehearsal.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Break a leg! I mean, not actually...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You should be careful with her.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why? I thought you were friends.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We are, dearie, but I know her better than you think.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I know she is impressive, but she has a lot of secrets.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thanks for the heads up, Grandma, but I think you might just be paranoid!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I just heard the wildest rumor. Someone said Ursula used to be in the circus!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Actually, I think it's true.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Fiona DuVal - the ringmaster of the Circus - was just telling me about how they once trained together.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Why doesn't that surprise me?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Did you hear that Ursula used to be in the circus?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Yeah, I heard she was a trapeze artist.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I thought she was shot out the cannon.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Come on, guys!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: She was definitely the knife-thrower.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are you going to the circus?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: You bet I am!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: But I don't want to see any clowns...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Nothing scarier than a clown.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I don't want to toot my own horn, but I'm pretty good at throwing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: You don't say!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I could probably win you the main prize, if you wanted.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Aww, thanks little guy... Maybe I'll win it for you first.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ever since I got the letter from Fiona, I've been looking forward to seeing her and the whole troupe.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I love the circus and its magic...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's such a nice distraction from all my usual work.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Everybody knows these things are always rigged!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: I know - totally rigged!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Don't be such sore losers.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I beat you both fair and square!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She said she was going to the dress rehearsal, but I can't find her anywhere.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I ran out of circus brochures, but I know I saw more of them somewhere.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: No, haven't seen her... She's probablyjust getting ready for the show.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ofcourse. But I don't want to disturb her...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I'm sure she won't mind if you get more brochures from her wagon.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Now where are the rest of the programs and brochures?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This wagon is a mess!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess people who work in the circus are pretty bohemian, but maybe I could help Fiona and straighten the place out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These old crumpled leaflets can probably go in the dumpster.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you think this location would be good for the circus?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: Let's see...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: It's next to your beautiful Mansion, and right by to the road for easy access.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: I think it would be perfect!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: The circus would be a great cover for a criminal enterprise, don't you think?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why? I don't think there's a more colorful and conspicuous group.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I know! They're hiding in plain sight.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: It's the perfect sleight of hand.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What are these scraps of paper in the dumpster?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's some writing on them, but I can't make it out...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This one says something about the Mansion!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder if I could put them together with some tape.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These scraps are starting to look kinda suspicious.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's a list of things in the Mansion, but some of them have been crossed out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's almost like some kind of... shopping list for a thief!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So it was Fiona all along!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She asked to bring the Circus here, because she knew about everything that was in it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And she kept me busy with brochures and flyers, while she was planning her heist.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She completely took advantage of me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The perfect sleight of hand, indeed.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It must be so exciting to be a part of the Circus!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How did you become the ringmaster?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: That, Maddie, is a long story. I suppose I had ambition and the right vision.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: You have to go big or go home if you want to make it in this business.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: And sometimes you have to break the rules to get what you want.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: But I don't want to bore you with my life story...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: Would it be too much to ask you to take these programs to the big top?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You don't have to ask twice!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I do not want to worry you, dearie, but there has been some weird activity around the Mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are you talking about... the circus?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: No, but I wouldn't be surprised if they had something to do with it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I am serious, dear. Things have been moved around, but nothing seems to be missing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: See? You're just being paranoid.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Let's hope so...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is there something hidden in the bushes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A set of lock picks!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe Grandma wasn't just being paranoid... Maybe there IS something going on.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Fiona!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look what I found.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: Lock-picks? Where did you find those?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They were hidden in some bushes right next to the Mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't want to sound suspicious, but do you think there's someone in your troupe who could be planning a robbery here at the Mansion?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: What a shocking thought! I promise to make sure no one in my circus steps out of line.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: After all, you've been so welcoming to us.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Someone's broken into the old safe!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is going on in here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It seems like whoever is behind this doesn't want just anything. The Mansion is full of valuable things, but they cracked the safe.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They must be after something specific. But what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look, it's Malzar!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What can you tell me about the future?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Malzar
lines.text: With sleight ofhand, it slips away, vanishing in the light ofday.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What slips away?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Pfft, cryptic as always!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Malzar
lines.text: The mysterious speaker of truths.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: What do you remember of your time in the circus, Ursula?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It was too long ago...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Come on, I know you remember everything.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You are not wrong there, Mason.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I can tell you that the circus is a very exciting and sometimes dangerous place.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Wow... Do you think I'm too young to join?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Stop right there, Fiona! I know what you're doing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I just can't believe you'd take advantage of our hospitality like this!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: I told you. In this business, you sometimes have to break the rules.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I wish I hadn't guessed this, Fiona. I wanted to give you the benefit of the doubt.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: I almost pulled it off, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: I'd be on myjolly way by now if it weren't for your meddling granddaughter!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: Just tell me, where is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: The damned Boultonite!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: So that's what you were after...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Fiona DuVal
lines.text: You didn't think I want to tour with the Circus for the rest of my life, did you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well, you can think about that for a nice long while - behind bars!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a show that was!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I really didn't expect the magician to pull a raccoon out of his hat.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What did you think, Julius?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I'm a little bit disappointed.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Deb won the biggest prize in the raffle - and she had only bought one ticket!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Could you settle an argument, Ursula?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: We've been trying to figure out what you did in the Circus.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: What was your act?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well, I tried my hand in several things, but I was best known for my motorcycle stunts.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Really?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes. What is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: No one guessed it right, did they?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: 1 have to hand it toyou, Maddie. You did a greatjob
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She almost pulled it off!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But she didn't, thanks to you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I just hope she didn't ruin the magic of the circus for you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: No, I still love the circus. But next time they can pitch their tents somewhere else!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, guys! Wh- What's going on?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hey, Maddie! Didn't you read the newspaper? I wrote an entire article about it...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh... Er. I must have missed it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: We're digging up the old Hopewell Bay Archaeological Museum!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Museum?! I didn't know we had a museum!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: We did, but it collapsed on its grand opening many years ago.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Something about illegal mineshafts below the town...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh... Well, surely you won't find anything of worth anymore, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: We've already found many! Many pieces are still in great shape.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: And the best part is that we're going to be sending them back to their rightful homes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oooh, awesome! Let's help, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh alright, dearie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ooh! A complete set of tools! This will definitely do the trick!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Yessiree, these will definitely help break the ground over the dig site!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Now be careful, Maddie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You need to take great care in clearing away the earth to get to the artifacts within the museum.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Huh... Feels sort of backwards to be digging up what was once in a museum already!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Obviously, what we're doing here is... Re archaeology!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Eh?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well... This certainly isn't from Hopewell Bay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: No, it's not. We're currently excavating where the Aztec collection was housed.

lines.text: Agatha had a particular recipe for her chocolate treats, that was very popular! All the children from the town would come and have a great time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did you ever go, Julius?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ha-ha, very funny. I am not quite that old, my dear!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I can't believe you built these machines to make candy and chocolates and... all kinds of treats!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I couldn't imagine anything better, honestly!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Is there anything I can do to repay you? I'll do anything!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Anything?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Anything!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There is one thing...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: What?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: You don't mean...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Can you wear your bunny costume?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Okay, I'll wear it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Mason?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Come out already. We have to take a photo of you in your costume!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I'd prefer it if you didn't.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Please? Pleeeeeease?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Fine. I can't help my cuteness!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think everything is finally ready for the egg hunt!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We have candy, we have chocolates, we have cakes, we have...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Painted eggs! I knew I'd forgotten something!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, I need you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What is it, dearie? The chocolate machine didn't blow up, did it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No... the chocolate machine is fine, but I'm in serious trouble. I forgot to paint the eggs for the egg hunt!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Could you help me? I got so carried away with the old blueprints and the machines.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I still need to wrap the lollipops and fix a cylinder on the candy machine and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Don't worry about the eggs. I will take care of everything!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Reward +200
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Reward +50
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Julius, you have to hurry up. We still have dozens of eggs to paint.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You invited me over for some apple pie. I did not sign up for all of this painting!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: How many eggs do we really need for this egg hunt, Ursula?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Just keep painting!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: What is going on, Ursula? I got your message and rushed right over.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Deb! At the nick of time, too! Here is a brush and some paints, and there are your eggs.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: What is the meaning of this?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We are in a hurry, Deb. The sooner you start painting, the sooner we are ready for the egg hunt!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Reward +50
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You know this whole thing started with an egg hunt, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, but who am I to stand in the way of progress? It's been a long time since I got to build something really exciting.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Come on, you have to admit - a cake baking machine is a pretty nifty little invention.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is very impressive, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But are you sure the pressurized extrusion manifold won't destabilize the flow equilibrium?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's actually a good question... H-how did you...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Anyone can see that the nozzle array is not quite right. Let me show you...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We're in business!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What an impressive contraption! A chocolate machine, I presume?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You presume correctly. What do you think?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Are those parts from Ignatius' old machine?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes... I did borrow a couple of nuts and bolts... and hoses and levers... but it all runs great, I guarantee
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I am sure! So, what recipe are you going to use for the chocolates?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Recipe?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You need a recipe to make chocolates, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That does make sense...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I think I can help. Let's get the old family recipe book.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: If I remember correctly, Agatha - that's Ignatius's wife - had a good recipe for chocolates.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It was quite... special!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy, do you have a second?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Sure! How can I help?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A flux anomaly in the cocoa particle suspension matrix disrupts the harmonic shear resonance of the tempering coils, causing unpredictable high- velocity chocolate ejection events.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: S-say what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I know how to fix it. Can you just hold a couple of things for a minute?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It shouldn't take long, just a little twist and a minor push...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whoooops!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy! Are you 0K?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: W-what happened?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Cool! A chocolate Roddy!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Reward +150
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Reward +300
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Reward +200
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Reward + 100
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Reward +500
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That HAS to be it. I simply cannot paint another egg!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I think we are done! Thank you both!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: I think I was promised pie in return for my help!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I think my rheumatism is flaring up...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Reward +1000
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I can't believe I had to put this costume on again...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Next year, someone else can wear it, because I'm not dressing up like a bunny AGAIN! I'm just too old and cool...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: And no one else has to get dressed up for the egg hunt!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Oh, I was wrong!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Your costume is WAY better than mine!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Reward +2500
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How was your egg hunt? Did you get all the chocolate you wanted?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Oh, I did! Your chocolates were just out of this world!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Your machines were amazing - and you were like some mad chocolate scientist!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: By the way... what are you gonna do with the machines?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why do you ask?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Well, I could take them out of your hands, if you wanted.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe that's not safe, considering what happened to Roddy. The machines arejust prototypes with a lot of kinks!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He got covered in chocolate! That's a happy accident, if you ask me...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, this place is rather obviously an attic!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But why was the entrance hidden like that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: . Who am I fooling? Nothing in this place makes sense.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But... It has a reason and purpose!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll look around and see what I can discover.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandpa wanted Grandma to come up here, after all!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: 1 don't believe it! It's mom's original wedding bouquet from their special day!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I see carnations and pink roses... how lovely!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I adore that they saved so much of their wedding here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: 't deserves a specialplace. I'll make sure to honor heir wedding day and their love!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well... time to get rid of all this oldjunk.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Junk?! Dearie, if I thought it was just junk, I wouldn't have put it in the attic, would l?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma! You snuck up on me! Well, most of this stuff is worthless. Besides, I wouldn't mind never seeing some of it again!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I understand, dearie. But perhaps, instead ofjust throwing it away, you might find it a new home?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Everything deserves a second chance, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: l... I guess you're right Grandma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, a lot of these things are just broken pieces!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I guess she never got around to it...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, I'm sure someone will! Let's make sure these get donated! They are very pretty, after all!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey... this ship looks familiar!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ha! That devilish thing! Your grandpa spent months building that little ship.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Never seen him work so hard in his life! Hahaha. Michael loved it and couldn't believe how it fit.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aaaw. Maybe this will bring the same joy to someone else?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I just saw mom's bridal shoes so this must be dad's wedding shoes...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The very same shoes that they walked down the aisle in.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I bet they had a beautiful first dance in these shoes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oooh, that's a nice dress! Was it yours?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, it was, in fact! Cut a fine figure too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I wonder if it still fits?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How about we find out?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This rug has been barely touched! It's almost brand new!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, crumbs! So he was right!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Huh? Who?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Your Grandpa swore he bought a carpet on one of our holidays, but I never believed him! I guess he was right!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What attic wouldn't be complete without an old TV...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Looks like these are some sort of music video promo tape for a band called "Cheers for Shears".
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, let's see what you guys are all about!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aw, shucks. No sound. But from the look of things, it seems like a music video from the late '80s!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I should hang on to these, perhaps they're worth something!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And I admit... Going through all these memories with you was really nice.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Exactly what I'd expect mom to have had! I bet they had such a wonderful time at their wedding...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder what she would have thought about my "wedding". Or lack thereof...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Being devastated. Alone. Left at the altar by Arthur!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ooh! I almost wiped this smudge off while I was cleaning until I realized...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's mom's handwriting! B+M for Becky and Michael!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aww, weren't they adorable?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... That safe was really old and tricky to open.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I had to use some of my lock picking skills!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's see what's inside...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh! This is dad's birth certificate! But...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: His last name is scratched out! Why would someone do that? And why leave it in a safe?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What does this mean?! Was he switched at birth? Ugh... keep it together, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey... A writing desk. Perhaps I can find more answers here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A letter! But... Wait a minute. This doesn't make sense!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It looks like it's a letter between Grandpa and Grandma. But, the C he usually signs is... different.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But the letter itself is even more strange! It sounds like Grandpa is angry with Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Something about her leaving him without a word and that she should honor what they have...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But, they were happily married?! Why does he "demand her to return or face the consequences"?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This... doesn't sound like Grandpa! But... who else could it be?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's probably why setting up this blanket fort came back to me so easily.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It was my perfect little escape! Especially during hide and seek.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... an old vinyl. Wait... something is written on
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Becky and Mike's final record"... Mom and dad were in a band?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This vinyl also looks like it came from the music studio...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did that mean that mom and dad met in the Mansion as singers?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I see some cassettes as well. I've got to find a cassette player!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, look, there's a little write up on "Cheers For Shears".
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's probably something related to Eddie from the Music Studio.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I was right! It mentions that Eddie was a part of this band but as a producer.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The band was led by a couple who-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The rest is all smudged. Ugh. Guess I'll have to dig around these old boxes to find out more...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ah good, a player, and it even has batteries!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Here we go! Mom. Dad. Don't let me down!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hearing mom and dad sing a love song to each other wasn't quite what I was expecting...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's... so odd. I know those voices. And... I know this song! I think they sang it to me as a lullaby!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This is wonderful!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... It looks like it needs a numeric key code.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Most of the things up here are about mom and dad. Their music, the wedding dress...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll try their anniversary date!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It worked, and it looks like it held a key!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Now... let's open this door.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, wow! It looks like an elevator!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Behind a wardrobe?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess it's convenient to have an elevator up here, but it sure is odd.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: well... might as well fix it up all the same. Perhaps later 1 can get an engineer to fix it properly.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe I can find out where it leads and see what it was truly used for...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well... that's the attic, done and dusted.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No pun intended, ofcourse.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But I think this part of the mansion is complete! I should probably head on over to the western part.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I understand the office over there needs some work!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's nice to take a break once in a while!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Rufus?! There you are!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is it, boy? Did you find something?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... Looks like a glass bottle! No... A message in a bottle!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's see if we can get it open!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ugh! Finally, I got it open!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's see what's inside...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm, that's odd. There really isn't a message except something that looks like co-ordinates.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And the letters C and S! These co-ordinates point to something out at sea... an island, perhaps?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You know what? I'm going to check it out! You'll hold the fort while I'm gone, right Rufus?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's a good boy! I hope this boat can get me there.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh wow! This looks like an abandoned beach shack!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But... Who owned it? And why did they leave co- ordinates to it in a bottle? Hmm...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Darn, the door's locked. Maybe there's a key around here somewhere?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: well, it won't hurt to clean the beach up a bit, and perhaps I'll find the key while I'm at it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These surfboards look vintage but expensive!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait... C and S. Casey and Skatie! This must be their surfboards.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This island must have belonged to them, but I wonder what happened?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why did they send out a message in a bottle?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... I think I'll find more answers inside once I find the key.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aha! I found the key!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Quite an odd place to be in, though... I don't think this was deliberately hidden.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: More like cast aside. And looking at the state of the place, with everything boarded up...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Someone must have come here afterwards to do it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well... Let's get inside and figure this out!
