lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: No, of course not! It's just that... could we talk alone in private for a second?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ofcourse! Let meju-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: She ain't going anywhere alone with you, buddy. Whatever you need to say, you can say in front of me.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey! I can make my own decisions!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Yeah, buzz off.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: I was here first!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Yeah and you LEFT first too, so why don't you do it again?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Stop it! What's gotten into you two?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie... I need to tell you something. Something I've been meaning to tell you for a long time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: O- Okay Roddy... Let's go to the next room and-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Come on, you aren't actually listening to this schmuck, are you?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Arthur!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: No, I'm serious! This guy is BAD news!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: I'm telling you Mads, you shouldn't trust him.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Trust me? What about you?! Quite convenient for you to turn up again, right?...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What are you both talking about?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Mads, do you actually know who he is? Where he's from?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ofcourse I do! He's from Hopewell Bay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: R-right?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: See? I know who he is... And where he's from.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't understand, what are you saying?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie, don't listen to him. He's obviously trying to manipulate you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: Give it a rest, "Roddy". We both know who you REALLY are.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: If you know who I am...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Then you know that this is not a smart thing to do.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Arthur
lines.text: There he is!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: R-Roddy?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie! I'm... I'm sorry!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Both of you get out. I've had enough of your testosterone-laden fake machismo! Ugh!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And don't do anything stupid!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: *Sigh* Why did Arthur have to come back, NOW?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And I've never seen Roddy like that before!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And here I am talking to myself again!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Okay... Get a grip, Maddie. You need to talk to them and get to the bottom of things.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: For now, I need a break. And restoring the cinema is just what the doctor ordered!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Pardon me, Ma'am, but I would like to turn your attention to a rather surprising development.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh? What's going on?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: The two gentlemen who left this area moments ago have decided to have a bit ofa row, Ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: 0b, cone on!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I'm doing my best to clean up after them, but they seem quite vigorous!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why don't you stop them?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Certainly not! I am a butler, not a referee.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ah... Comedy and Tragedy. The foundations of theater.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And ironically, my life...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow! I know what this is...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's a mutoscope! Coin-operated too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Instead of film, it would use a series of images, much like a flip book.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... What an odd movie! Looks like an instructional video for spies...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Nothing like the smell of fresh popcorn in the cinema!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Just something so magical and special about it that it makes you forget how easily it gets stuck in your teeth.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Worth it though.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Don't tell me...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Yes, they are still at it. I must inform you that the chandeliers have unfortunately become casualties.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You must do something!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I have, Ma'am! I've come to you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These chairs look... Different.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Almost regal and not really something you'd see in a cinema.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They're not in great shape though. I should probably switch these out to something more cozy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These stones look familiar...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I saw them in the secret society chamber as well!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder what their meaning is?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Perhaps their symbol?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ah! This character is familiar...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I loved these movies, and they made me want to become an archaeologist as a kid!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What makes you say that?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Well, judging from the hole he left after chucking Arthur through the table, I would say he exercises!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Through the table?!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Heyy... What's this? Documents between the seats?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These look old... But important. Assuming that the label "Top Secret" in big red letters is to be believed.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Don't think it'll hurt to open it up... Oh wow! It's from the secret society!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... Interesting! Looks like instructions on how to use the seats!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It seems like they used this cinema as a way to pass on secret messages, and the seating order was important!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They passed messages either via the films themselves or the actors! Quite cunning...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I have good news, Ma'am!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They've stopped! Finally...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: No, they're still at it, I'm afraid.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: But they have decided to finally take it outside!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh... Lovely...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's an inscription on the stage floor - "All the world's a stage..."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... I wonder if they ever performed Shakespeare here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There seems to be some kind of control panel here as well. Maybe it's for stage lights...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No! I've had enough!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You go out there and tell them to stop, or so help me...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Ma'am! Contain yourself! Ijust merely wished to inform you they have stopped for the day.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I've controlled most of the damage, thanks to you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh... I'm sorry, Winston. Thank you for taking care of it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Quite alright, Ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Looks like an interesting collection of film reels...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Although, I've never even heard of most of these! Hey... What's this?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Award Ceremony - Homegrown in Hopewell Bay" Ooh... I should check this out later!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait, a minute... These symbols look familiar!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They're the same as the ones behind the old seats! But... that's not all!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Those confidential documents I found under the seats make sense now!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This chart helped identify where each important individual sat. Seems quite crucial!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This place definitely has a spy connection -just like the Library!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This film projector is old but...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It seems to have some unique features to it. Almost like it got an upgrade...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder if Eddie the musician had something to do with this.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I really have to host a movie night here, some day.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whoa! That control panel was for this screen!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How cool! And... strangely modern for this place...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But thanks to whoever set this up, I can actually have a movie night here someday!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm, this projector is quite old but luckily I learned how to fix these on the dance floor!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Just got to adjust this wiring and voilå!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hold on, there's a reel in here already. Let's see if it works!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow, that looked like a movie countdown! But there were way too many numbers...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It almost seems like a phone number that could be important.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Good thing I have a photographic memory and managed to memorize all of that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... I thought I was done renovating this room but...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There seems to be more behind this wall!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Huh... a hidden green room.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess it was in use when this place was a theater...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This room clues about the performers
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... I still can't figure out the encryption in this journal! If only there were instructions an-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait a minute! The mutoscope! The instructional video seemed to focus on symbols!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes! They match the ones in thejournal! I think hey're the key! Let's use them!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... It first mentions to "Go up to discover the secret." and then "Go down to uncover the truth!"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What does that mean? Is there a hidden passage that leads to an upstairs area?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Interesting, I wonder why there's a phone in here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is this more like an intercom for the actors?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait, that number I memorized earlier
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This feels a bit odd but maybe I should dial the number.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So that's 4...8... and lastly, 3!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I hear something! A recording...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "The Curiosity Fellowship honors your curious mind"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "In these hallowed halls, blue stones whisper tales untold,"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Each placed with purpose, a story to unfold."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Follow their path as truth shows the way."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "For secrets deep within shall see the light ofday."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How fascinating! I've always loved riddles!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This Fellowship seems to have left quite a trail of breadcrumbs for curious minds like mine.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I should keep an eye out for any more gems or symbols...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This place is scattered with items from the Curiosity Fellowship!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's the same masks and even some theater costumes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ohl look! A photo!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I was hoping to get some answers...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But, everyone in it is wearing these masks.... Creepy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These must be super important Fellowship members.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They really take secrecy to a whole new level, don't they?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's this?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's a ladder above! Looks like it leads to some sort ofattic.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe this is what the journal was talking about...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's something up there that could be really important.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I should go have a look.

lines.text: Do you know what day is almost here?

lines.text: Hmm... Tuesday?

lines.text: Nope! Guess again.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Friday!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.text: No, my birthday!

lines.text: My mom promised me a pool party with floaties and lemonade in coconut shells with little umbrellas and--- Aah, I can't wait!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.text: Sounds very exciting - especially the coconuts. Did you know that they're not actually nuts?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I didn't, and I'm sure you want to tell me more, but right now I would like to concentrate on my party.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.text: I understand. I'll tell you all about coconuts afterward!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.text: What have you got planned for Mason's big party?

lines.text: Pfft, you know what he's like.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: He wants a pool party with all the trimmings, but I'm not sure I can deliver all of that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I'm afraid he'll have to settle for some coconut drinks and a big cake.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Not necessarily!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: What do you mean?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I would love to help you set up the party of his dreams.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Are you serious? That would be amazing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ofcourse! He's such a great kid. He deserves it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: Mason's dream birthday party, huh? I bet I can make it even bigger and better.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: Maddie will have to admit that I am more fun!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: Hello, Mason! I heard your birthday is coming up soon.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yep, and it'll be AWESOME!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: You know... I'm a pretty awesome party planner myselfand I'd love to help your mom put together something cool.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: What would you really love to have at your party?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Anything?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: Within reason.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Well, ifa wave machine is too much...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: It probably is.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: ...then I would love to have some pool chairs for chilling out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: Pool chairs? Done.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yessss!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So, your birthday is soon, isn't it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: It sure is, and I have a feeling it's gonna be epic.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is there something you'd really like to make it even more epic?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Huh.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Bellajust asked me the exact same thing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Bella?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yeah. She wanted to help my mom with the party.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's... just great.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I bet I could do something EVEN better than her!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: How about a HUUUGE sandcastle?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Consider it done!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't believe Bella's trying to outdo me with this party! She doesn't even like Mason!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She'sjust trying to make herself look good in front of Emilio, but if she thinks she's winning, she can think again.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Are you ready to see your party?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: You can bet your pool floaties I am!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Ta-da! What do you think? Maddie and Bella both helped me put everything together.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: It is.. ... . AWESOME!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: And two cakes?? This is the best birthday EVER!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Very impressive! Bella and Maddie, you have been incredibly selfless, helping Pearl with Mason's party.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: This party is better than I could've imagined. Thank you, both. You rock!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You're welcome.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: It was our pleasure!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: What do you think you're doing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What do you mean? I was just helping my friend organize a birthday party for her son.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What were YOU doing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: The same.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: This isn't over.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.text: Mason's party was excellent. It was nice to see you and Bella work together to bring it all together.

lines.text: We weren't exactly working together...

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: I know she can be a handful. She's always had trouble making friends with other girls, and she can seem...

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Rude?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Yes, but it only masks her crippling insecurity.

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Give her a chance. Underneath all the other stuff, she's great really, I promise.

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll do my best, I promise.

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think the sound was coming from in here!

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow! This place is a mess!

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I should probably-

lines.text: Wait...

lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: If Grandma sees me, it could cause some cosmic meltdown of the space-time continuum...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And that would be bad.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, Julius? Have you seen Charlie anywhere?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: He had some business in town. You know he's been talking about getting a COMPUTER.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Computer?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: An intricate hi-tech machine you can use to write things and do calculations, maybe even play games!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: VERY advanced technology.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder if I can get inside the Mansion and take a look around! Maybe I'lljust try the door...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's locked. OF COURSE!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Some things don't change, it seems.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Remind me - what does Charlie want a computer for again?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is it for his work?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: His work? Well... I suppose you could say that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: But you know we don't really talk about that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Plausible deniability, remember?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why are you having a yard sale?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ursula, it was all your idea, remember? To raise some money for the repairs the Mansion so desperately needs?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ofcourse... It was my idea!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It looks amazing! With the games and rollerskate ramp, there are so many cool things to do.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Those were your idea, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I-I know that! Seems like I have lots of good ideas!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ursula? Is that you? Could you help me with these boxes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What happened to your hair? Oh, never mind! Those sunglasses are EPIC!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Julius?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Yes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You look so...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: D-different!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I'm glad you noticed! I've been lifting some weights, and it's going pretty well.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Do you want to see my new Walkman? It's really neat!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This is too much... Where am l? Or- WHEN am l?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Did you bump your head? You're not making any sense!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How do I get the key?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Julius knows everything around here and he thinks I'm Grandma. How can I get him to tell me everything without raising his suspicions?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I have to be careful, or this might end badly.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you play the guitar?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ahem, keytar is my instrument of choice now. I've been practicing a lot, and I think that this time I can hit the right notes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: T-this time?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So, Grandma was also fixing the place up. It doesn't look half bad, but it's definitely showing signs of disrepair.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Does she live here alone?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hang on... Shouldn't Grandpa Charlie be around?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Rollerskate ramp? This is by far the best yard sale I've ever seen!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That was the goal, and I have to admit it did turn out pretty well.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Let's hope we get a good turnout. You really do need some cash to bring this Mansion back up to code.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The council have been too harsh to you, in my opinion. How is one person expected to fix up a place this size on their own?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Tell me about it...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll just have to climb up and get the key from Ignatius' tin can!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whooooah, the statue is much taller than I realized. But I have to try.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll just climb onto the statue's shoulders and reach into the tin can. Easy peasy!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Here I go...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Could you just remind me - what needs to be fixed first in the Mansion?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You name it! The Conservatory roof is leaking, the Maze is totally overgrown, and there's something odd going on at the Lighthouse...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: . Yes, totally... Hmm..
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Are you feeling 0K? It's not like you to be so forgetful.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: And what's with the hair? The red does look good on you, but you didn't mention you were going to dye it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I just wanted a little change, I guess... so surprise!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a cool arcade game! Grandma always says she used to be really good at these. I mean...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Your Grandma played arcade games? She must be an impressive lady!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Actually... I just managed to beat your high score.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It only took 5 hours, and I got blisters on four fingers, but I did it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Victory sure tastes sweet.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Please don't beat it again!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's with the bandstand and the game zone?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Jeepers, Ursula. You really aren't yourself today, are you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You wanted to put on a show to draw more people to the yard sale.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't know what's with me today... Who's going to be performing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Well, Charlie skipped our last band rehearsal, but I think we can do it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I have also prepared a comedy show as a little back- up plan. I have some terrific jokes ready to go!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a relief!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What on earth is Ursula doing climbing Ignatius' statue?? Why isn't she using the ladder?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The statue can't take her weight... Ohl no - it's falling!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ursula! Ursula, are you alright?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ursula...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Maddie... Maddie? Are you 0K?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: W-what's going on? Why do you look so old? And where's your Walkman?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Harumph, I don't look THAT old. And I haven't had a Walkman for decades!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You must have stumbled and hit your head. Why are you wearing Ursula's old clothes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I was just trying them on.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Hmm...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Nothing... It reminds me of something. Like a strange flashback!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maddie, I think I owe you an explanation for before.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I am talking about Julius's story. You see, he has always insisted that I was the one who climbed...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, it's 0K! You don't have to tell me anything.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well... I would like to explain...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No, no, that's totally fine!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Are you sure? I know you get annoyed when I do not give you the whole story.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This time you're off the hook. But let's talk about your old 80s clothes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Now they are something I have no explanation for!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Voyance! It is nice to see you. Where have you been hiding?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I attended a retreat all about celestial secrets, which was very interesting indeed.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Ever since, I've been pouring over my star maps. It seems that there is something BIG on the way.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Are you talking about the northern lights they predicted for tonight?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maddie invited a group of her friends to come see them in my front yard. You are more than welcome to join us!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I might just take you up on that! But we might get more than just northern lights...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Here we go! We should be seeing something pretty soon.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: How exciting! I've never seen the northern lights before.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Me neither. Hey, is there something happening up there?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Looks like it. Amazing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Voyance, are you seeing this? Isn't that wonderful?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: I can see the lights... and I see something coming!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: My maps were correct! The stars have SPOKEN! There will be TWO turns offate - nuptials and a burial.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: W-what is she talking about?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I think she said there will be a wedding and a funeral.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: A wedding? So, who's getting married?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Don't look at me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How about the funeral?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Listen, she's just trying to be mysterious... right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Right...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did you hear about Voyance's premonition? About the funeral and wedding taking place soon?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: She is a strange lady. I find it difficult to believe her premonitions. There is no room for such things in science.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Exactly! She's just spinning tales about stars aligning and lunar events.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: I wouldn't worry, Maddie. There won't be a funeral - or a wedding!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Lady Voyance is an interesting character, isn't she?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: She sure is. It's not very nice - creeping everyone out with a crazy prediction.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: I agree. These thing shouldn't be ajoke.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: My parents have been married for 30 years, and they are very happy. That's what I aim for - a love that lasts forever.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Bella, you know them. You understand what I mean, don't you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: A relationship that endures.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Exactly.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: A partner who'll be there for you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: That's what I've been looking for and now...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: Yes! I would love to be your forever partner!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: You w-what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: I've been waiting for you to ask me forso long - years!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: Y-yes, right...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: What just happened?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can't believe that just happened. Bella and Emilio are engaged!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Poor Emilio looked like he was about to pass out when Bella said she wanted to have the wedding immediately!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: No kidding!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: They're our friends, and that's what you do for your friends, right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Lady Voyance said there would be a wedding - and a funeral.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Now the wedding is actually happening, and half of the premonition has come true, so...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What about the funeral? Do you think... she could be right?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: If she is, whose funeral will it be?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Harrumph! You should be more careful, old friend.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: These young people take your words too seriously, and that will turn them into a self-fulfilling prophecy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Well, well, Ursula! Did youjust call me a PROPHET?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: No, I just... *sigh*
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Just be careful, 0K?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: Very well. I know you think I'm a little bit... strange with my premonitions.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Lady Voyance
lines.text: But I am guided by the movements of the stars - and they are more powerful than you might realize!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow! What a race! Didn't I tell you it would be fun?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Yeah! That was pretty awesome! However...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I should probably wear something other than a suit, next time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, at least your hard hat will make it easy for us to find you if you ever go overboard!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Overboard?!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Deb said I should check this room out next, because it was interesting.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's a bit ofan understatement if you ask me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Or laboratory!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But for what?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: Ah... I see you've found Lindsay's Perfumery.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Lindsay's? What?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: Perfumery, girl. Oh wait, that's right. YOU didn't live here as long as I did.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And much good that did. I see you're still trying to spruce up the place with pictures of yourself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: Hmph...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Why are you still around? It's obvious you don't enjoy being here!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Every great lab needs a sink. Even one as fancy as this!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey... These look like some unique handmade soaps and they smell wonderful!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder if this lab was also used to make soaps?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Maddie Boulton. Still rummaging around in junk, I see.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Victoria?! Who let you inside?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Please. Your mansion is like a sieve. I can come in and out as I please.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then please get out. And STAY out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Relax. I've come to bury the hatchet.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, right. Probably in my back.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Ha! Don't threaten me with a good time!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Trust me, I wasn't.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: So snappy! I guess there's no fooling you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: You're right! I'm here to make your life a living hell!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey! Get back here!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: Well, girl. I won't be around for much longer, thanks to you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: n collecting my things, because YOU have thrown
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: You do RUIN everything you touch, you know.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What are you talking about?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: For example, the deal I made with Bruno.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: I could have been living in a penthouse suite!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Selling your ancestral home is never a good plan, Leonard. It's wrong.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: Don't be too quick tojudge, Maddie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You were selling out your family, Leonard! You didn't want to save this place!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You wanted to sell it to make a quick buck!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: Ha! So young, thinking that you know EVERYTHING. The naiveté of youth, I suppose.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, stop it with the over-bloated rhetoric. You're a greedy old man who was only looking out for number one.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: I'll have you know, little girl, that I made sure there would have been enough money for everyone.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: Cover all our family debts, and even get Ursula off the hook!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wh- Why didn't you tell me?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: Because ofthe wayyou are acting now! Besides, you made it clearyou would not sell, anyway.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: You are not as smart as you think you are...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: Sometimes it's best to not know everything.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's wrong with you?! You're acting like a mad woman!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Ha! I have nothing to lose!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: You've taken everything away from me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: And now it's my turn!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey! I thought I threw you out?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Like a sieve Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look, Victoria... I'm sure we can figure this out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Just, PLEASE. Stop breaking things!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Victoria
lines.text: Never!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh? I guess you didn't heed your own advice when you told Deb she was adopted!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: How do you think I learnt that lesson?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: I saw how it ate her up inside. How it led her to go searching for the truth. How it hurt her in the end.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: I couldn't stand seeing her so hurt after she came back.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: You see, Maddie... All this family has is pain and debt.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Leonard
lines.text: Something Deb learned all too well during her time in Europe.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What do you mean? And tell me more about how Lindsay started this...
