lines.text: But it's been her go-to excuse for the past 3 years. But honestly?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: l- I just don't think she wants to see ME. I chose for us to move here, and she was against it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Against it? Why? Her mom lives here! Hmm... I should talk to Deb.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Hello, sweetie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hi, Deb! Thanks for dropping by. I just wanted to talk about Charlotte-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You see... She's supposed to be coming back and Mason is REALLY excited, but...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: But Pearl isn't? Poor girl...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's going on? Why does she think Charlotte doesn't want to come home?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: Well, I can tell you it isn't Pearl's fault! Charlotte chose a life that doesn't leave room for family.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Deb
lines.text: I don't believe she thinks she gets to come back from a life like that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What does she do?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Sure! I know a guy who might help. Just give me her number and I'll look into it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Mom! When will she be here?! Do you think she'll stay now? I can't wait to show her what I've made!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oooh, that's pretty gnarly!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Isn't it cool?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I'll head home to see if I can find a whole skeleton to throw in!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: He's so excited! I don't know if I should tell him...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm sorry Pearl... I tried calling her, but she didn't pick up.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: You got the numbers, huh?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah... What do they mean?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I don't know, but I know she's doing something important...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maddie! You won't believe what we found! This'll make one heck ofa story!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: She's a spy, Maddie! Charlotte is some sort of spook!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Those numbers were a coded message my contact recognized. Not sure who she's working for but...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: It's up there Maddie. WAY up there!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's what Deb meant!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: So... What are you going to do, Maddie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Are you going to tell them?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: l... I don't know Jackie. Pearl deserves to know. But...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But something tells me there's a very good reason
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maybe to protect them?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've noticed that Grandma's acting a bit weird. I mean, weirder than usual!
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Honestly, Maddie - that just sounds like Ursula being Ursula.
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But she was rummaging around in the closets, going through the old table linens and porcelain.
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I even saw her shining the silver cutlery!
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hmmm... Maybe she's planning a dinner party.
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder... Could it be for the 5th anniversary?
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Did you receive a sealed letter from Ursula?
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I did - an invitation to a dinner party! Did you?
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Yeah! Who else is invited?
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I got an invitation, too!
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: You did? The whole thing seems a bit mysterious to me...
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: What's so mysterious about it? She's cooking us a yummy dinner!
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Fine, I'll tell you a secret.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yesss! And remember, it has to be juicy - like the one Julius told us!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Someone in my family ended up being accused of something they didn't do, and I wasn't able to help her.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I felt totally powerless, so I found a way to bring the truth into the light.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: And now you're trying to do the same here, at the Mansion?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Something like that. And you all KNOW there's more than meets the eye at this place.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: My guests, welcome! You have played my game of secrets well, and now it is your turn to ask the questions.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I will pull them out of the hat, one by one. The first one is...
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: "Why was the Mansion abandoned? Because of the Mafia? Why did you hide the Mansion from Maddie?"
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hrmm... There are three questions here.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: But one question just isn't enough!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Fine, let's see. The costs of keeping up the Mansion are exorbitant, as you can imagine.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: After Charlie... disappeared, I just could not afford it. Coming back to the old house was painful, so I kept away.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: How about the Mafia? Is there a connection?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You have watched too many movies, my dear Jackie.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: So we can ask her ANYTHING?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Sounds like it... a-and then we owe her one secret each?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Yup. This must be one of the famous Boulton party games I read about.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So we just write our questions on these pieces of paper and put them in the hat?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then Grandma will pull them out one by one and answer them? And she'll tell us the truth about anything we want to know??
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I suppose so...
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: This party game is WEIRD.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Has your Grandma taken up a new hobby?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Not that I know of!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I saw her tinkering with an old movie projector. She had a big pile ofold slides and film.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Old slides and film? What is she up to??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I need to do some good old-fashioned snooping...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Have you noticed anything strange about Grandma? Do you think she's been more secretive than usual?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: All I know is that whenever Ursula gets very secretive, something is afoot.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Like what?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I have my suspicions, my dear, but I have an inkling we will find out soon enough.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: But listen to this part: "The evening will include some entertainment - a traditional Boulton party game."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: "This one time, you are allowed to ask me anything at all, and I will answer any question."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: "Upon arrival, please write a question on the piece of paper provided. Each guest may ask ONE question, so think carefully."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: THAT is a traditional Boulton party game? You couldn't make this stuff up!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow! I just saw Grandma's polishing all the best dining room furniture.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That means we're going to have a REALLY fancy dinner party -just like in the old days!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Is it your Grandma's birthday? Is that why she's organizing a dinner party?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No... and she'd never throw big party for herself anyway.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But I think it's to do with us... and the Mansion. It's been five years since we started renovating this place.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Five years?? Has it really been THAT long?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yup. And that's absolutely worth celebrating!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Speaking of which, I've read about the dinner parties they used to have at Beaumont Hall.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Apparently, they were lavish affairs with all the trimmings.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: And according to legend...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: The party games were pretty legendary, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The extra special table cloth, cleaned, starched and ironed, and the family porcelain all lined up.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Seems like we're invited to one of the Boultons' legendary parties!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Who knows what we're in for, but I have to admit... I'm kinda excited!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: What are you going to ask her, Jackie? Are your reporter's senses tingling?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I don't even know where to begin! I have about a million questions.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I know exactly what I want to know.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: What?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Hey, the game hasn't started yet!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie, what are you going to ask? You must have so many questions...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: My Grandma never gives up her secrets - and I mean, NEVER.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've spent years - pretty much five years so far - trying to uncover the mystery of this Mansion, and Grandma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well, are you ready to finally hear the truth?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Is itjust the five ofus?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Looks that way. The table is only set for five people.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Isn't Ursula going to join us?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And why is that projector set up at the top of the table?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Maybe we should switch it on and see what happens?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Welcome, my dear guests.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You are probably wondering why I invited you here tonight.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: As it happens, today marks a VERY special anniversary - five years since Maddie and I returned to Beaumont Hall. What a journey it's been!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: And soon, you will get to experience a true Boulton tradition.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I asked all of you to write down one question for me, but there's a catch!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: In exchange for one of my secrets, you will have to give up one of your own.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Are you ready to play?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Jackie, what is your secret? What dark history are you hiding?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: No dark history here, folks. I don't have any secrets, you know that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Really? You've been writing about the Mansion for a long time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: True, and you've done a lot of research about it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: So what? I'm telling you - I'm an open book.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What made you want to become ajournalist?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I have a hunger for the truth. I wanna believe that good journalism can right wrongs and expose lies.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What kind of wrongs? Have you been wronged?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Wow, we're reallyjust laying it all out there!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's how the game works...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Phone
lines.text: Classified number.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Mason, your turn.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Okay... So, I found something kinda weird.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Well, I was fishing one day, and I thought I'd hooked a big mola mola, but it wasn't a fish at all. It was a big old suitcase!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: But it's locked! And I know it's important, and it has Charlie's initials on it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I've kept it a secret, but I figured someone might have the key to open it. Now I think I was right. Julius?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Looks like you're going to start, Roddy! What's your secret?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: M-my secret? Do I really need to tell one?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: That's how the game works, my man. Out with it!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well...
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Maybe you have some dark family secrets, too!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: No, no, nothing like that, but... maybe there is one thing.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Let's hear it, my boy.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: There's someone I really like, but I just can't tell her.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Is that so? Who is it? Why can't you tell her?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Hey, we were only asked for ONE secret!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Julius, you're up!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: O-oh, right. My secret is... that I really hate peas.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: That's not a proper secret!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Mason's right. It has to be something juicy, like you hid the key to the Mansion, or burned down the Sauna, or helped Charlie disappear!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I never hid the key to the Mansion or burned down the sauna, I assure you!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Wait-- But you helped Charlie disappear?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Julius, did you help Grandpa Charlie disappear?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: l-- I did help him ONCE, a long time ago.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: There was an issue with... his work, and I rustled up some supplies to help him keep a low profile.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What issue?? Where did he go?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I think he already told us one secret.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: And it wasjuicy, too!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I cannot believe you found Charlie's old suitcase! I was certain it was lost forever!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: But how did you guess I had the key??
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: You're Charlie's friend - you just said you even helped him escape once - so you seemed like my best bet.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Very clever, Mason. But I'm afraid you will have to hand the suitcase over to Ursula.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I think she has been looking for it for a good while!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Next question: "What happened to Charlie and where is he now?"
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I believe you wrote this one, Maddie.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The honest answer is that I believed him to be deceased, until... Well, now I do not know where he is.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I wish I could give you a better answer, but your Grandpa has always been a very secretive man.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Perhaps we will find out one day - I certainly hope so.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The third question: "Did you dress up as the Ghost on Halloween? If not, do you know who did?"
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Roddy, I am aware of your feelings towards ghosts, but I did not contrive to give you a fright last Halloween.
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I personally believe it was Pearl. After all, she was the one who boasted about her great ghost costume.
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That is my answer, and I'm sticking to it.
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: And then it's Maddie's turn. I just can't imagine what secrets you could be hiding!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Come on, tell us!
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Okay... This is not a total secret, but not all of you know what first brought me to Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You found out about the Mansion, right?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes, but only after my life had spectacularly fallen apart.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: What happened?
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: My fiancé left me at the altar. Then our house mysteriously burned down, so I was pretty much out ofa home.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: What??
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It was awful, but I'm fine now! The Mansion was exactly the distraction I needed to get over everything.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And I've made great friends in the process.
lines.author: chasemad5

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: On to the next one. "Did you ever receive a letter from me about 20 years ago?"
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Is this from you, Julius??
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Err... well, yes. It is...
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: B-but, did you? Receive a letter?
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Not that I remember. Should I have?
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Err, I suppose not... Never mind!
lines.author: jouki

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: "Where do babies come from?" Mason, I presume this question is yours.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Hah, I wasjust kidding!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: My question is, can you REALLY fly a plane?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Let'sjust say that I have spent enough time in a Boulton T99 to know which end is up.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I knew it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is the game of secrets really a Boulton tradition?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is, indeed. Our ancestors were masters at keeping secrets, but they also knew how to have a good time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I know I am not always exactly straight-forward about everything, but I hope you got some answers you have been looking for.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I did... But it's not like you to throw dinner parties.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: True, but I thought we were due a little bit of fun for all the hard work we have done over the last five years.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The Mansion looks better than it has in a LONG time, and that is certainly worth a celebration.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess you're right. It's been a pretty busy few years, but I wouldn't change a thing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Here's to us and the Mansion, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hear, hear!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Pheeew, I really need a holiday!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've been raking, digging, dusting and polishing for so long that I can't even see straight.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Hello, Maddie! My, you have worked hard. This Mansion is starting to look like new!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know - I was just dreaming about a little break to recharge my batteries and find new inspiration for the Mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: You should travel to Japan!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, I'd love to! I happened to hear once that Grandma used to live there. Is it true?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: It is. That's where we met. You must travel there. It will be very good foryou, I know it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, twist my arm!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: It's settled then. I'll speak with Ursula and organize everything!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I thought we could have a Japanese dinner before you go away. You know, to help you get used to the local cuisine.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sounds great!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Do you know the art oforigami, Maddie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know of it, but I can't say I'm very good at it...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Let me show you. It is a great practice of patience and of how to calm the mind.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What are you saying?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is a long flight to Japan, dearie. Are you sure you've got everything you need?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Snacks? A warm jumper for the plane? It is always cold on a plane with the over-eager air- conditioning...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've got everything, but are you... fussing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I never fuss!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But you're going far away, and I just want to make sure you are prepared for everything.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Don't worry, Grandma. I'll be 0K!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So you and Grandma met in Japan, while she was living there?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: That's right. She told me about Hopewell Bay, and it sounded so wonderful that I ended up moving here, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you ever miss Japan?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: All the time! But I still visit from time to time, and I can always reminisce with your Grandma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've never been able to figure out what Grandma did in Japan. Did she work?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Yes, she worked in a number of places, from a small ramen shop to a fish vendor, and for a time, she was an English tutor.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: However, I always got the feeling she was actually searching for something there. Something she had to keep secret...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: She never told me, and I never asked!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a feast, Grandma! How did you learn to cook this?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I picked up a trick or two while I was traveling.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Salutations, Maddie! Are you really traveling to Japan?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I sure am. Kazuko told me about how Grandma used to live there, and I really want to explore some of the places she used to go to.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ah, I might be able to help you there, my dear! I have these old postcards Ursula used to send me from her travels.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: They are all from famous Japanese sights. There are others, too, but I thought you could use these as inspiration for your itinerary.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thank you so much, Julius! But where are the other postcards from?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: We'll save those for your future travels.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I sometimes have this nightmare where I'm leaving for the airport, and my bags are totally unpacked.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This time I'm so prepared. I've got my passport and tickets, a travel pillow for the long flight, and plenty of snacks.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Did you pack some comfortable shoes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Got them!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: A sun hat?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: A wig?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: W-will I need one?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You never know when you might need a good disguise, dearie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've got my comfy walking shoes on, my camera is fully charged, and I'm ready for an adventure.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Now I just need a travel card.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Easy peasy!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A good old-fashioned bicycle is totally the best way to see a new place.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: On a bike, I feel like I'm blending in better, and I can see all kinds of places other transport just can't go.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at me, moving through Tokyo like a pro!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I finally know where I am and where I'm going. Now I just need to hop on a train!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These old postcards Julius gave me are full of interesting stuff... but they also form a pretty good list of things to visit.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's gonna be so cool to visit some of the places Grandma loved to visit while she lived here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And it'll be interesting to see what might have drawn her to them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is there something you'd like me to bring for you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: No, dearie. I've already got everything I need.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Although... If you get a chance, you could maybe bring back some of that dried octopus.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: D-dried octopus?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What an amazing structure!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It says here that it was originally built in 597! And it is supposed to have been inspired by a dream.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can see why they say that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What does Grandma's postcard say about this place...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "The pagoda stands tall, but no sign of him."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What does that mean?? Who is she talking about?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Kazuko told me to always have some change in my pocket. I wonder why?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess she knew I'd get totally hooked on the gachapon machines.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: After this feast, I'll be ready to start exploring the locations Grandma visited back in the day.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I thought I knew what Japanese food is like, but boy, was I wrong!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I remember when Roddy tried to make sushi once. Those floppy rolls were not anything like this!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma's sushi on the other hand... Now I know where she got her skills.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So, Kyoto used to be the capital of Japan.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And it says in my guidebook that Yasaka Pagoda is over a thousand years old!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's so much history on these streets... I can't wait to explore more!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Fushimi Inari... What an amazing place!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The Japanese really seem to have a gift for slowing down and staying in the moment.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder how many of these torii gates there are along the paths... I bet there's at least a thousand!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's see what Grandma's postcard says about this place...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "l followed the trail of breadcrumbs to the mountain and found the gate. He was here."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Who could she be talking about? Hmm...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Maddie writes from Fushimi Inari in Kyoto! She really is following in Ursula's footsteps.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: But will she figure out what her Grandma was up to, I wonder...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: She writes: "l walked through a thousand torii gates, but couldn't find the one Grandma was looking for."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So many different kinds offoxes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma would love one of these kitsune masks. She has such a strange love for any kind of disguise!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It says in my guidebook that these torii gates have been donated by people and companies over the years.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder if Grandma donated one?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There arejust too many to check!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hot springs just for monkeys?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These guys are pretty spoiled, if you ask me.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma's postcard says:
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "l was able to find out that he was here, searching for something. I am just not sure, whether he found it - whatever it was."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She was following in someone's footsteps...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: A postcard from Jigokudani!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Is it from Maddie? How wonderful!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Yes, indeed. She has been touring the places on Ursula's old postcards.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: She is a bright girl, Julius. You will see that she will see what her grandmother was searching for.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: And that they are not that different at all!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You might be right. This is what she writes:
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: "The monkey onsen at Jigokudani is like nothing I've ever seen. But who was Grandma looking for here?"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It would be more than amazing to have a little bath like this at the Mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I can imagine soaking in it after a hard day's work.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But this holiday is already starting to take effect. I feel more relaxed than in a long time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's good to have some time away, and I'm really starting to enjoy solo-travel!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I have to snap a photo of these monkeys. They are so cute!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Mason won't believe me when I tell him about this place.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a place!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder what Grandma made of Akihabara. Let's see what she wrote!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "l know now that he came here to see the railway station. It must have inspired him to build his own tracks back home..."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A railway? She must be talking about Ignatius!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Is that another postcard from Maddie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: May I read it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Go ahead!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: "The claw machines of Akihabara are great, and I can't wait to see more of Japan. Grandma's postcards have been a good guide."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Akihabara is so full of interesting things that I don't even know where to begin!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe it's time I try my luck with the claw machines...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's see... Where are the best ones?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This place has been a complete change of pace from the previous sights I've seen, but it's so full of energy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I would love to take a piece of Akihabara's magic home with me...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe I could build something similar at the Mansion!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The famous Shibuya crossing - the busiest pedestrian crossing in the world!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It sure is busy here! I'm so used to the quiet small- town life that I forget that there are places like this in the world.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's time to read the last one of Grandma's postcards.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "l think I now have the full story. It has taken a lot of time and effort to put the pieces together, but I will crack this mystery."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So she was following in Ignatius' footsteps, trying to solve his mysteries!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess we have more in common than I've realized...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I understand this place now. At first glance, it seems like total chaos, but it's not!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: There's a structure and a rhythm that make the place work like a well-oiled machine.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, this must be the statue of Hachiko, the dog who waited for his master every day at the station.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a good dog... Always waiting for his master, even after he passed away!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: l... miss Rufus!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I'm starting to get a little bit homesick.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Did Maddie send another postcard? Is she 0K?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: She is fine, and she's enjoying Japan.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: She has been following the tracks left by your old postcards.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You have kept them all these years?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Of course! And it seems Maddie has figured out what you were doing in Japan.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well, she is a bright girl. What does she write?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Let's see... "Finally in Shibuya. I've found what I was looking for - complete holiday mood. Grandma's postcards make sense now."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's so good to be home!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But did you enjoy your trip?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I loved it. From the Yasaka Pagoda to the Shibuya Crossing, I learned so much - also about you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did you travel to Japan to find out something about Ignatius' past?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It was so long ago, but... yes, I did. You see, the mystery ofour family is a little bit like an onion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: An onion?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: There are many layers, and we have all had to peel them back, one by one. That goes for me, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So why don't youjust tell me about them?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Some things you have to find out for yourself, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: But come now. I've madeyou some sushi, andyou can tell me all aboutyour trip!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello, Mason!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Mason? What's wrong?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Oh, nothing... Just that...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Mom should be here by now!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: But she said she had some last-minute "work" things to do!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Ugh. You grownups with your work. Always getting in the way of important stuff!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Like fun!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Poor Mason...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I need to cheer him up, somehow.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Rufus! Just the dog I was looking for...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And your frightful feast is ready, Ru- Er... Boo!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's actually quite spooky how you can make your howl echo like that...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Alright, alright. You're a pro, I get it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Maddie, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Mason! What is it?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I think I've seen a ghost! Look!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Is that a ghost dog behind you in that photo?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yeah! Someone slipped this under my door. Maybe it's that stranger from last year!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Wow!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: It's... IT'S THE DOG!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: THE GHOST DOG!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Huh! A ghost dog. Gave us quite a fright, didn't you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How about we call you Boo?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yeah! Oh boy, my very own paranormal pooch!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Huh! Sounds like a bunch of ghosts are loose in my...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: My...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: My graveyard?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Maddie! Yeah, isn't it great?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Got to admit, it's the cutest graveyard I've ever seen.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: If not a bit morbid.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Hey! It's Halloween! You'll make Boo angry!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Alright, alright!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe I should have an exorcist on speed Hmm... dial.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I heard that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, it looks like you two have been having a downright ghoulish time!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yeah! It's been so much fun, but...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: But what happens when Halloween is over?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Does Boo have to leave too?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, let's ask him!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Boo, want to stick around for a while and keep Mason company?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think that's ayes, Mason.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Really?!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Yippee!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Hello Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I've heard what you did for Mason and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: And thank you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No problem at all, Pearl.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The kid's kinda grown on me.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Yeah, he's an endearing little troublemaker, isn't
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That he is, he practically lives here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I hope that's okay! l... I don't mean to intrude or any-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Pearl! It's okay!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You guys are practically family.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These two lions are familiar, so this place belongs to the Boultons, alright!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The infamous tin can factory. The heart of the Boulton Family fortune.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And some might even say its downfall.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But, how about we change that, huh?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I have plans for you, factory...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: BIG plans.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And while I'm doing that, I'll snoop around a little and learn all your dirty secrets.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm sure to find more answers here about Dad and that criminal organization.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No time like the present!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's get to work!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, this sign had seen better days, but now it's as good as new!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And if anything would confirm that I'm in the right place, it would be a sign that says,
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Boulton Tin Can Factory,"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I should probably amend this sign a little after I'm done with the place.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's not really going to be a working factory anymore...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's going to be something MUCH better.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And grander!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... I don't know much about this place!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Apart from what I've read, ofcourse.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And that whole tin can chaos during the storm revealed that this place was collecting people's secrets.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But surely there's more to it than just that! This place wasn't just a cover!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I should give Winston a call. If anyone knows our family history the best, it would be him!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Also, he's the only one I trust to give me a somewhat straight answer.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: *Ring Ring*
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello, Winston?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Is everything alright, Ma'am?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yes, of course! I was wondering if you couldjoin me at the tin can factory?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: So it's true that you're renovating the old tin can factory.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: What, the mansion wasn't enough ofa headache for you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Holden?! What are you doing here? I don't have time for your schemes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: Relax, I'm here as a photographer for The Holden Howler. No schemes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, right. How's your tabloid doing these days?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: Thriving, obviously. And it's not just a tabloid!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: Or it won't be, if you let me cover this place. Big story potential.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Fine. But you get limited access. And I'm watching you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: How may I be of service, Ma'am?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've decided to fix up the old factory! And was wondering if you could tell me a little about it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's more rust than roof right now, but there's something about this place. It feels... Proud.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll admit, this place isn't like your typical smoke and noise factory...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Not at all, Ma'am. Ignatius believed that function didn't exclude beauty.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Every brick here is intentional.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And the garden?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: That was Agatha's domain. She inspected it daily, I believe. Not a hedge dared grow wild under her watch.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sounds like the factory ran on more than just steam.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Despite its dubious history, Ma'am, it ran on the passion of two very powerful people in love.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: 1 wonder iflgnatius and the workers used to take their breaks sitting by the river...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And gathering secrets from any visitors.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I bet some of those secrets are still hiding in the overgrowth.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Good thing I'm here to uncover them!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmmm.. Looks like the remains ofa bell.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Indeed, Ma'am. That was Agatha's. She cast it herself, you know? Pure tin, and it rang twice a day.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Lunch and end ofday?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Precisely. She believed in structure. A well-run garden, a well-run household...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Naturally, then, a well-run factory.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: It was said she treated the workers like family and always cared for them like a mother.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then let's make sure it will ring again in her memory!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Agatha's pristine garden, Ignatius' meticulous brickwork, the factory crafting the family's inventions...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Our history feels as close here as in the old mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Not just the Boulton's history, Ma'am. This factory brought prosperity like Hopewell Bay had never seen.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I believe that most residents can still name a relative or two who used to work on these grounds.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've decided, we're turning the factory into a museum! This history deserves to be shared.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Not only fixing a factory, but rebuilding a legacy. You're a Boulton, through and through.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No pressure... I'll call Julius, he can help me get on top of the permits from the start.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Very prudent, Ma'am. Given your history with the council.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's a pretty small dock. They used to ship cans from here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: By daylight, 1 suppose. Othershipments were better
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What kind ofother shipments?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: The kind that preferred no paperwork, ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey! There seems to be a plaque hidden under these bushes!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, cool! I wonder what will be inside? I guess there's no harm in trying to dig it out!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What secret- Oh! Hey! It came loose! How'd you know that would be there?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I didn't. But I assumed that there'd be one. With this family, there's always a secret latch, door...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Old tin cans, newspaper clippings, even letters from residents! This is incredible!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ooh, there's even a letter addressed to the future mayor and a... Wait, is this... Code?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Perhaps it has something to do with what the factory was REALLY about?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Can you decipher it, Winston?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, ha ha.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: So, why the sudden interest in the old factory?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: Just uncovering more of your family's infamous history, or do you have bigger plans for it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You sure ask a lot of questions. But yes, I do have bigger plans for it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: I'm a journalist! It would be unethical for me to not ask this many questions.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Right... What's your interest in this, anyway? I thought your paper only covered gossip and scandals.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: Gossip? At The Howler we call it "democratic storytelling".
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: And there's nothing wrong with covering scandals, but every now and then we need a positive story.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: This factory has brought many people to Hopewell Bay before. If it could do it again...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: Just think of the impact it'd have on The Holden Howler's sales.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ah, that explains it...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: Are you sure your sudden interest here has nothing to do with a certain... incident?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: You know the one, when a storm spread cans filled with secrets all over Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Good try. When it comes to that, I know as much as you do.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: Sounds like the Boultons are still keeping their cards close to their chest...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Holden... Are you sure you're not working for Victoria anymore?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: Of course not! I'm just brainstorming headlines. I'll think of something else.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: I took some great pictures! The whole town will be looking forward to the "Boulton's Secret World of Cans".
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: Just thought ofa name for your museum, figured you could use help from a pro.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Holden... I'm not letting you name my museum.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: But honestly, thank you for letting me cover this. I really needed a good scoop.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thank you too, Holden. I'm sure your article will bring more visitors to the museum.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Holden
lines.text: And even more sales to the Howler!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a cute little kiosk. Was this also part of the factory?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Indeed, Ma'am. This used to be the worker's café, it was run by your cousin Cherry's great-grandmother.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I need to invite her here. Cooking must run in their side of the family!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What a lovely spot for a quick lunch break, right by the river.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wouldn't blame the workers for getting lost in time before rushing back in to finish their shifts.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Luckily, the Boulton matriarch owned a rather large bell.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This will be the museum's café! I'm sure guests will love the outdoor seating.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And enjoying the boulevard at their own leisure.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This little place kept the whole factory running, didn't it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: The rhythm of the workday was set here, ma'am. Assisted by Agatha's bell.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The old menu had a coffee and sandwich combo for two cents. No wonder they loved it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: A strategic investment. Well-fed workers were 35% less likely to dent the production-line cans.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's hope this also works for museum guests and exhibits.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The water wheel's completelyjammed. It's just packed with leaves and debris.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: It is quite unfortunate. That wheel used to power a third of the machinery inside.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I thought it was just for show!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: No Ma'am. Agatha designed it herself. While coal was all the rage, she was very adamant about using the river.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Not only did it give power, but it was quiet, efficient, and self-sustaining.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Made for a more comfortable and productive work environment.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Not to mention eco-friendlier!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Agatha was quite ahead of her time. She believed beauty should be useful and not destructive.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I want to get it working again. Not just for display. I mean REALLY working.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I want it to run the museum and have it showcase the factory's innovative spirit!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Not to mention being a great teaching tool about renewable energies.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: A wonderful idea, Ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A tin can fountain? That's... oddly charming.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I believe this was Agatha's touch, ma'am. She believed even humor should be structurally sound.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And so she plopped a giant can in the garden? I like her style.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I hear she measured the water arc to the centimeter. "A proper fountain shouldn't splash the begonias."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's rebuild it so perfectly, even the flowers won't know it's new!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's stuck... shouldn't a maintenance door at least maintain its ability to open?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Unless it was maintaining something worth hiding, ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Okay, now I need to know what's behind Door Number Spy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: A question for another day, it seems.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: An old fire truck!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Ah yes. This was donated to the factory after the fire in '24. A freak lightning strike, if I recall.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: It had taken out half the eastern wall before they got the fire under control.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: This fire truck was the one that answered the call. Afterward, it remained here. Ever vigilant.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, at least the fire didn't take out this flag.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: That banner was indeed lucky to survive. It was raised every morning. Flying bright over every shift change.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's going up again. A great reminder of the history of this place.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, Julius, it's Maddie. I've decided to reopen the tin can factory as a museum.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The Boulton factory? My word! That's remarkable.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I was hoping you could help me with the paperwork and zoning permits.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I'll draft the application today! But first I must inspect the grounds, I'm on my way right now.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thank you, Julius. But you really don't need to rush.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Understood. Let me finish my coffee and I'll be on the way with my best pen in hand!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So this old hero saved the factory, then got put on permanent display?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: And it was remakably preserved. The leather hose alone could tell stories.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Bet it never thought it'd retire as factory mascot.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Better than scrap, ma'am. Some histories deserve to keep their shine.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A tin can mosaic, that's dedication to the brand.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: A rather elegant homage, if I may say so.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Functional made beautiful. Who knew tin cans belonged in a gallery?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Ignatius and Agatha Boulton, apparently.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess they inspired more than just factories.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Agatha was powering this place with renewable energy before anyone even had a name for it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Apparently, the council required some persuasion before approving her turbine design.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Some things never change...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll make this the museum's crown jewel. Imagine kids seeing green energy in action!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Agatha would be proud to see her vision getting its due, ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: The garden's coming together nicely, ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You think Agatha would approve?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Without question. It has her same meticulous touch.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then I'll make sure it thrives.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I knew this place mattered, but I didn't realize how much until now.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Most things don't reveal their value until someone bothers to look closely, Ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, I'm looking and I'm not stopping. This museum is going to tell the entire story!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The people. The work. The legacy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The outside is ready. Time to see what's been waiting inside all these years.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Shall I bring the keys, Ma'am?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Bring everything. I've got secrets to uncover!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Cutting these vines was like going through ajungle!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But worth it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This room looks like an office of some sort.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder who it belonged to?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, this thing shouldn't be in a terrarium!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let mejust... Hey! It's fake!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ah... 1 think it was placed in the to keep
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Uhm... Maddie? Could I speak to you for a sec?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Look, I'm sorry for what happened. l... I don't know what got into me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy, I'm not in the mood to hear apologies right now, alright?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No, seriously! You, of all people! Getting into a fight?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I thought you were smarter than that.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm, an old mechanical typewriter.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Shame, 1 don't think 1 can fix this one. 1 don't think they even make the parts anymore.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait! I see a name on the side. Charlie Boulton! This was Grandpa's!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I bet this was HIS office!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder what he was working on in here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: HeyJackie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What... What's wrong?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Holden is up to something! I think he's stealing my scoops!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, I wouldn't put it past him...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: This is different! He told me I've gone soft and only he could tell the truth!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: "The truth of the corruption that festers in the heart of Hopewell Bay," as he puts it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: But his stories have gone too far! Sensationalist trash filled with half-truths!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Jackie... It's Holden, after all.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No. You tell me right now why I should accept your apology.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Tell me what is going on with you!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Alright!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Alright... I'll tell you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie, I have a feel-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Sullivan
lines.text: Oooh, you're in big trouble now!
