lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did he run the factory for a while?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Why yes, he did, Ma'am. For about 2 months.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: 2 months? I guess it didn't go too well...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: It did not.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What's this? An advertisement for...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: T-shirts in a... Can?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: As you can see, not his brightest idea.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh Leonard...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I should probably go over these letters before throwing them out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, Winston! Check this one out: "To the Boultons, are you interested in a revolutionary new fax machine?"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I believe that particular revolution has come and gone, ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ha! And this one is a notice for an unreturned DVD. The late fee must be huge by now.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Luckily for us, the rental store has been long-lost to the mists of time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These letters are like a time capsule of obsolete things. I'm keeping them!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Maddie, are you in there?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Julius, hi! Come on in. Are you here to look at the museum paperwork?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: In a moment. First, I need to inspect the yard. The town council is very picky about paving stones.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Really? I thought this was just about the building itself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: For a historical building, context is everything! Besides, I saw a few interesting pieces out there already.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Okay, I'll be here. I have the structural survey papers with me if you need them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Good! That will help me cross-reference what I see out there.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Phew, that's all cleared up!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oooh, the factory logo!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Winston told me it was Ignatius' design, but Agatha made sure it went on every single can. No exceptions.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No wonder they had such an impact. They weren't just making cans, they made standards.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Pioneers. Right down to the stamp on the tin.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Welcome back, Julius. How's the inspection so far?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Very good! I was glad to see that the flower beds were exactly measured.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The town council is very picky about flower measurements.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's all Agatha Boulton's work! She was incredibly precise with her garden.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She's also the one who planned the big water wheel by the river. Her designs were very well thought out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: A remarkable woman. Ifher eye was on that wheel, I'm sure it would be safe for the guests.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: That vintage fire wagon outside is a magnificent piece! The brass work is superb.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: But I hope you have a more modern system installed inside?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We do, state-of-the-art. Let me guess, the council is very picky about fire prevention systems?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Not particularly.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: But you should be. It's your legacy you're protecting.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I'm almost done with my rounds. One more and we can get started on the paperwork.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thank you for the help, Julius!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aaand... he's gone.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: CB-01 So, what do we have here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No way! A CB-01? I thought there was only one of these left.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How are you holding up, buddy?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: In rough shape, huh? That beep sounded more like a cough.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Don't worry, I'll have you fixed up in no time!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: First, let's bypass the damaged circuits... then I'll reroute power through the secondary panel...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's an improvement! It's missing the gemstone sensors, but the printer mechanism is intact.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'll give you a new life and a newjob, you'll be our new ticket master.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's printing! Those four years of engineering school sure came in handy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A fresh polish and a system upgrade, you're gonna charm every museum visitor.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmmm... Let's fix up this refreshment corner!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ifthe factory workers got to enjoy a good cup of Joe, then so shall my guests!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: With a state-of-the-art coffee machine!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And a selection of different beverages, auto frother and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A tasty accompaniment of baked goods and treats!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I should move in here...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These donuts and cinnamon buns are so fresh!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The smell alone should be enough to bring some people in.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I should probably try one to assure the quality.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah, one ofeach. For the guests' sake, ofcourse.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Perfect! A little sugar rush to fuel the history lesson.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, cool! An old employee time clock!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: This one is quite unique, actually. Ignatius designed it himself. Supposedly, it kept perfect time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We do like our clocks in the family.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Ignatius always said, "Time is money." With this, he meant it literally. He liked orderly paychecks.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey! Let's use this on the guests!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I beg your pardon?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I mean when guests come in, they can clock in their ticket!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then, when they leave, they can clock out!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It'll make the experience of coming to the factory even more immersive!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Ah, indeed!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's set up a relaxing lounge as well, so that the guests can enjoy their coffee in peace.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This couch managed to survive the elements as well.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So, it'll be nice for the guests to lounge on the same furniture.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Almost like being there!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Winston, look! I've got the clock working. Visitors will punch in right by the main door.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: And are you confident about putting the guests to work? It's a rather authentic touch, I suppose.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's immersive! This makes them part of the factory's story.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: I just hope they won't expect a paycheck after clocking out.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It'll be memorable! People love quirky, interactive things.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: As you say, ma'am. I'll prepare for the inevitable queue ofovertime claims.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I knew our family was ahead of the times, but the CB-01 is truly an amazing piece ofengineering.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder when it was first installed here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It must've been a hit with the workers!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I swear it feels like you can understand me sometimes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These photos must have been from the factory's grand opening and ribbon-cutting ceremony.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: It was a grand day, Ma'am. Everyone from Hopewell Bay was there.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess it was an important day for them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: It indeed was, Ma'am. I often wish I could have seen it myself!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: Pardon me, but if you won't be needing me anymore, I'll be heading back to the Mansion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ahyes, of course, Winston! You've really been a big help.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thank you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Winston
lines.text: But of course, Ma'am.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The pictures oflgnatius and Agatha at the grand opening... I can see the pride on their faces.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And Winston wasn't exaggerating, it looks like all of Hopewell Bay was there.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's Ignatius giving his speech. And Agatha, making sure everything is running in order.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wish I could've been there to see the factory lit up and buzzing with life.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But now I'm bringing that feeling back! The whole town, together in this place again.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A great museum starts with a great introduction. Let's give guests the full story right here in the reception.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: An infographic focusing on the history of the factory.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's start bold: "The First Tin can Factory in History!" in big letters. That'll catch their attention.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then the evolution: from Ignatius' very first tin cans, to Lindsay's spray cans, to...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: ...uhm, Leonard's t-shirts in a can... We'll tuck that one in the corner.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And done! A timeline of how the Boultons packaged innovation, one can at a time.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wish I had one of these growing up. So much history even I don't know.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But I'll start with what we can show.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Chalk art and coat hooks, the guests will hang their coats in style.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: A perfect first impression! The reception is looking welcoming already.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's starting to feel so real, I can almost see the first guests.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I'm looking forward to the opening myself. So much history is hiding between these walls!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm learning so much as well. It's exciting to share this with the people of Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ignatius and Agatha Boulton would be proud. You're honoring their work beautifully.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I hope so. They both put so much of themselves in the factory. It's sad to see it run-down.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Well, it won't be run-down for much longer if you keep at this pace!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thank you for the support, Julius. It means a lot.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: You're doing a great service to the town's history, Maddie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is this thing... an antique can opener?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Not just antique, Maddie. I believe that is the very first can opener prototype!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: didn't hearyou come in. Didyou finish
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Just did! And I'm ready to start working on the museum permits.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But, the first prototype, huh? Makes sense that Ignatius would've thought of it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The grooves, the angle... This was the blueprint for everything that came after.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's a bit clunky by today's standards. Definitely fits better on a display counter than in the kitchen.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Kitchen? Nonsense, this is the star of your museum!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We'll need a plaque for our VIP: Very Important Prototype.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The very first can opener, huh?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This must've sped up kitchen work by a lot.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess they had more counter space back then...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I mean, it takes up a lot of room, but it's got so much charm!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder what Ignatius would say if he saw an electric pocket can opener.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Doing council paperwork is almost pleasant now that Victoria is gone.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: She sure liked to make it a nightmare. But I wonder what she's up to now.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: well, 1 don't like to gossip... but 1 a
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That really doesn't sound like Victoria.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The other rumor is that she's a contestant in a reality dating show.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Julius... She's still married to Bruno.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It's just a silly rumour. I'm sure it's nothing like that. Now, back to section 4B...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: The reception is looking great, Maddie. Your Grandma will love the place when she comes
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm not so sure, she's never happy when I go around unearthing the family's history.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: About that, I'm nearly finished with the museum's operating permits.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Already?! You work faster than the old assembly line.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Retirement suits paperwork. But I must say, this place has grown on me more than expected.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh? Should I worry you'll start charging me antique prices?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Quite the opposite! I'd like to volunteer at the reception, if you'll let me.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Julius, are you actually offering to work for free?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Consider it my donation to history.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's the reception sorted. Floors waxed, displays up, and we even have a brand new ticket dispenser!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: It's remarkable, Ignatius would've been proud!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wait until you see what comes next! The factory floor has... potential.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Now, that's intriguing. Anything you'd like to share?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Not just yet, I wanna keep the mystery alive a little longer.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Ah, yes, the good old Boulton secrecy. I'll hold down the fort here, then.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Just don't get too comfortable! The best is yet to come.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I'd expect nothing less from a Boulton project.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But that's enough digging here for now. I think it's time I paid Grandma a visit.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I hope you don't mind my going through the festival decorations in the attic. I just-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: l... I think Julius is in love with me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Well... I was sorting through some of the festival decorations you left all over the place, and I found this.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, this looks like a...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Love Letter. Yes.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmmm, let me have a look.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Woo boy... IT IS a love letter.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maddie... Dearie. I'm a bit at a loss for what to do!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What do you mean? Of course you're going to tell him!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Tell him?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You mean break his heart!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: No, I mean talk to him. He deserves to know how you feel. Be honest.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Ho- honest?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Salutations, Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello, Julius.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Julius!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: None other.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What are you doing here?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: I er...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Was only wondering if you would like to come over for some tea?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I'm sorry, dearie, but I think I left the pie in the oven!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What was THAT about?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Er... That pie is very special!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Marvelous! She can bring it to tea then!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma! You shouldn't have ghosted Julius like that!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I'm sorry, dearie! I was just too nervous to face him!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, you're never nervous! About anything!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hold on.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What's that hanging over my window?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh... THAT.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I see you've found my little reminder.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Every time you avoid Julius, you'll see another of my little friends. Cute, aren't they?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Good grief...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Isn't this cozy, Grandma?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Despite "Your little friend" sitting there.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ha Ha!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: What a glorious fire pit you have set up!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: May I join you and perhaps partake of your glühwein?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But of cou-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I'm sorry, dearie, but I fear there is no more room left!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Oh? I'm sure I can sit right here where-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh no. The er... Teddy took that seat.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Oh... Alright then. I apologize for the intrusion.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello, Julius. Is everything alright?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: AntiqueDealer
lines.text: Quite alright, Maddie. I was just wondering if you could...

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: It seems to me that this old tradition could cause some chaos.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That is precisely the point, Roddy!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: The holidays come when you let go of your schedules.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Now we've turned the clocks, what comes next?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We finish decorating the tree.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: I can't wait for Maddie to see all of this! She's going to be SO surprised.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I think we did well here, fellas.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: And we worked together.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Ursula was right. This really IS a holiday miracle!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hello, Grandma! I just had the most glorious nap! I feel so totally rested and recharged.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I am glad to hear it, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I think I'm going to start the holiday preparations. We need a tree and the Mansion needs to be decorated, and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Actually, I think you should go and take a nice bath. I got you some of those lavender bath salts you like so much.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You did? Well... I guess I could do that. Are you sure?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Have you already started preparing the food for the holiday dinner?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I thought I was going to help you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I was just making you a little snack. Are you hungry?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess I could have a little something, but--
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Would you like some of my Hopeberry cobbler?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's my favorite!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, is it? I completely forgot...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is this?? The tree is up and decorated, there are presents, and there's even some... Is that soup?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's like a...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Holiday miracle?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Exactly. Did you do all of this?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: We did!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I-I'm speechless. Thank you so much!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: B-but, what's the time?Am Igoing crazy, or are all he clocks showing a different time?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: That's a long story!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I cannot thank you enough. You really went above and beyond to give Maddie the most relaxing holiday in years.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I could not have done this on my own. The Mansion looks wonderful, and everything is ready for a celebration.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: It's what friends are for. And we all love Maddie - she's the best! Right, guys?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Totally! The pleasure was ours.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Y-yeah, we love Maddie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Mason
lines.text: Don't make this weird, Roddy. Come on, hot chocolates are on me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Sounds good.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Hey, guys? Happy holidays! I'm glad I get to spend them with you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I was going through some of the stuffin your attic and I came across this old Go board!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I didn't know you played Go.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: That's it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Those are all the pieces found for the game.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Nowjust to find someone who could teach me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I see you're still playing with that silly thing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, that's the thing. I don't know how! Care to teach me?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: No... Not really, dearie. But...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Kazuko would know.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Maddie! So I heard you wanted to learn how to play Go! Wonderful.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yeah! I found this board in Grandma's attic and-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Hmmm...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is it, Kazuko?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: This board is very familiar, and if we look at the bottom...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Yes... This board belonged to my cousin, Sakura.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: It is a sad story.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Sakura was a brilliant Go player. The best in the village.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: And she was a wonderful teacher.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: She even taught your grandmother!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I knew she knew how to play that game!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: And very well! She lived with my cousin in Japan for a while. They were like sisters!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Until they played that one fateful game...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: But perhaps she was a better teacher than a player!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Your grandmother won that game in front of everyone, and Sakura felt publicly humiliated.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Kazuko
lines.text: Pride and misunderstanding grew between them until your grandmother left Japan. They never spoke again.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma, I found this letter inside the Go board.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's from Sakura.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Let me read it, dearie...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: ...Ohl poor Sakura!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: All this time you were waiting for a rematch.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What are you going to do?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Practice! Come on, dearie. Time I teach you the Sakura method.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You're going to Japan?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, dearie. Sakura has challenged me, and I must face it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But... But, the letter is over 50 years old!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: A challenge is a challenge, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is only right I take her up on it. She deserves as much.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Good luck, I guess?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Thank you, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... A walk-in closet!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I've got to say, this is not what I pictured for Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Deb would totally have one of these - color-coded racks, fragrance diffusers, the whole nine yards.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey! These footsteps look somewhat fresh!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Which is weird, because Grandma hasn't been here in years. And they're not hers. Too big.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe this closet holds something beyond old, moth-eaten coats.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: THAT is more ofa Grandma thing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So, how about we find out what it is?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maddie! You never did respond to my text!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Huh? Oh, heyJackie! What are you doing here?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I had to come over to find out how your date with Arthur went!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh that. Well, it definitely wasn't anything to write home about!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It started well, he even brought me flowers. But, he just had to complain about everything on this beach date!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The wind messing up his hair, the sand getting in his shoes. Who wears boots on the beach?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Ugh it looks like it went just the way I expected. He's never not been full of himself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Arthur did ask, but I'm not quite sure. All of it just feels... Wrong.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You're suddenly quiet, Jackie. What's on your mind?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: It's my sister, Grace. She's in jail, you know.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You're thinking about her case again? Did something come up?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I was just looking at some of her old news reports. I've always thought she was guilty, but now I'm not so sure.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Do you think she was framed? How?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: She was looking into the City Council. The charges don't add up.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So what's the plan?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I want to investigate it. Town hall, then the police station. But I need not to look like myself.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then look around, Jackie. The closet is filled with tools and costumes, everything you need to be unseen.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't believe it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Gone to Japan. Time to finish what I started. Love, Grandma"
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I wonder what she'll do?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Maddie! Perfect! I was uuh...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Looking for you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What is it?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Well... I won something at the farmer's market raffle!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: You wouldn't have space for another pet, would you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm telling you, Roddy, I don't have space for a cow...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I know, I know. But you might have space for this one!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What do you mean by-
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, my-!!!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's so cute! What's its name?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: McLeod.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: McLeod? Why'd you pick that?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Huh?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Nevermind...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Alright, little McLeod. What do you think?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So cute!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I mean, it's nothing out of the ordinary, you know?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Just your typical farm animal... Well... Almost.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, this collar definitely has a cowbell on it.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy! Are you bringing over a cow?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Just... Trust me, okay?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Hey, Maddie! How is our little friend doing?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: See for yourself!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He's doing all right. Hejust misses you a little.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Oh, no! I'm sorry, little guy, I just... I can't keep you at my place!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's alright. Roddy can come by and visit you whenever you like!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: ...So he has to fight the bad guy in New York!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: But the bad guy was waiting for him...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Quite the story you're telling!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Oh Maddie! I uhh... I was just telling McLeod about where his name comes from.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Sounds exciting!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You should show it to me sometime!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: With McLeod ofcourse.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: You got yourself a deal!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So what do you think?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I got to admit, I'm getting pretty good at this!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ain't that right, Roddy?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: You'd make a great architect.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Give you a run for your money, that's for sure!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Grandma! You're back!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Hello, dearie... Yes, I'm back.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well?! How did it go?! You look... lighter.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: In a manner of speaking.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Care to elaborate?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Not right now...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Maybe later. Over some tea.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmmm...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What is it, dearie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: A bamboo spoon, whisk, cup, and teapot...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This looks like a tea set.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is, dearie. From my time in Japan.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But... These look old. Antiques?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: From my... first time in Japan.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Nice. Why haven't I seen it before?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Because now I brought it back with me.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow! You made this rock garden?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes, I needed somewhere for my thoughts to settle.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Those lines... They're so gentle, deliberate. Yet...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Graceful. Like you, Grandma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: . Like I'm trying to be. Hmm..
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Nice looking bamboo fountain!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It's called a shihi-odoshi. It fills, it tips, it knocks.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's quite calming, actually.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is... originally meant to scare away deer. Sakura's family had one in their garden.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I made it to remind me of them.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are you going to tell me what happened in Japan?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Soon...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I love the sound of running water!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow! This is really impressive! Another memory from Japan?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Why yes, dearie! Sakura and I used to play Go next to a small waterfalljust like this one.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Okay, I admit it is very soothing!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It is.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: This is really beautiful, Grandma.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So... care to tell me what happened?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Alright, dearie. I went back and met Sakura.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We spoke about what had happened so many years ago.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Was she still mad?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Not at all! In fact, she was thrilled to see me again.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: She's a 9-dan Go player now! One of the best.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh! I guess you didn't need to play against her again, then!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, we played. It was a challenge after all.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: What happened?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We had our match. In a room much like this one!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: By the waterfall we had played at so many years ago.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: She had only one request. I wouldn't hold back. And I didn't.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Who won?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: She did! I had no chance.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You seem to be taking it well.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Dearie, I was so happy! I had my old friend back after all these years!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We laughed about it afterwards. There was no resentment. There never was.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: All she wanted was a rematch. And I had foolishly run away.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So, what now?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: We've promised to keep in touch! And play Go online!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm really happy for you, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: To go back and make amends is a really nice thing you did.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I should have done it a long time ago, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Now... how about a game of Go?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Okay... but I warn you! I've been practicing while you were away!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: That's good, dearie. I'm always up for a challenge!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Aah! Smell that, grandma?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Spring is here!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Yes it is, dearie! Time for a spring-cleaning I think.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Looks like you have something in mind?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: I do... Get your shovel!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Shovel?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How cute! Tiny greenhouses!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I love the snow globe! Ooh, and the lantern too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Why thank you, dearie! You use what you have.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: These plants are beautiful, Grandma!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Thank you, dearie. I'm sure you didn't mind the yellow!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm actually still thinking why we need shovels?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You wait and see!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Wow! I had no idea this was buried under the ground!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma

lines.text: But... I can't take Gizmo with me. Will... You take care of him?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ofcourse, kiddo. Gizmo will be safe with me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Are you excited?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Sure am! While I'm more ofa football fan, I don't mind a little soccer now and then.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, you're in for a treat! Grandma has let us set up a watch party for the entire championship!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Emilio
lines.text: It's going to be great!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Emilio, Bella! Wonderful that you couldjoin.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Bella
lines.text: And miss the big game?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmm... This cup seems awfully heavy for a replica.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: It's also pretty weathered and has a date here, I can't quite make out... Nineteen eighty-something.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It does look quite authentic... Grandma, where did you get this?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, that old thing? I found it at a street shop in Brazil.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Got it for a good price too, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You think it's big enough?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Big enough? Half of Hopewell Bay will be able to see the games now, dearie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Cherry
lines.text: Why, it would only be the right thing to do after all the help you've given me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Don't mention it. I still appreciate it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey! Leave some for the rest ofus!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, Grandma. I was thinking about that cup you bought in Brazil...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: What about it, dearie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, you see... The REAL cup was stolen back then, around that time... around THAT area.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: You don't say!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well... Maybe whoever sold it to you sold the REAL one!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Oh, dearie! Hahaha!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: It's just a silly trinket I found at the market.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: But why would you buy a championship cup at a market, in Brazil?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Grandma
lines.text: Because it's so delightful, dearie.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Step right up and test your goal scoring skills!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hey, wow! What a great setup, Roddy.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Thanks, Maddie. Want to give it a go?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ha! Maybe later. But I think I see someone coming over...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Roddy! Are you okay?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Touchdown! You just got sacked, Roddy! HAHAHA!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hank.. . It's SOCCER.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Soccer? Uh-oh.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Yeah! Nothing like doing it outside.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Interesting use of the football for the speed bag?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: Well you see... After I sacked Roddy, a totally legit play, I may add, I started thinking. In Football, we use our hands and...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: And in soccer you use your feet, so...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Hank
lines.text: I lost my train of thought.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: So did l.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: How are you feeling, Roddy?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: I'm okay. Hank didn't tackle me that hard.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: He's really enjoying the championship though. After I explained the rules to him, ofcourse.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He never fails to surprise me!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Speaking of surprises, I noticed the trophy cup has gone missing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Really?!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Do you think it was actually real?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I don't know... Grandma did say it was a piece of junk she found.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Roddy
lines.text: Still...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Still...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmmm...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Have you noticed how lively Hopewell Bay gets on summer nights lately?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Totally! The harbor's packed, music's always drifting from somewhere... It feels really magical.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: That's why I've been thinking... What if we gave people something bigger to gather for? A real music festival.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Pearl, that's an amazing idea. Local bands would love it!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: A festival's a pretty big project for a place this size.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Maybe, but we'd start small - one stage, local talent, some food stalls.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And we could set it all up at the Mansion. The place would look amazing all lit up!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Well... if we do this, we should do it properly. Permits, schedules, promotion... It's boring but important as we want this festival to be a success.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: So that's ayes?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: That's a "yes, before this turns into complete chaos."
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: This place is gonna need a lot of work before you can call it a festival site!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: We'll need to clear everything away and build a stage, stalls, a backstage area... And what if no one even shows up??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I hearyou. But you know what they say?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Vhat do they say?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: If you build it, they will come! Conti!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Do you have the permits for the stage, Maddie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, we're still waiting on the FINAL stamp of approval, but--
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maddie!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Me?? Oh, I don't sing. I can barely hold the drumsticks!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: You know what really makes a festival work?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Sure, but there's something even more important.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Amazing atmosphere?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Everything is ready for the festival to begin!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: But did we get all the permits approved?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Signed, sealed and delivered!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: So now we just need to...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Enjoy the festival!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Listen to that crowd — we actually pulled this off.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Against all odds, and with minimal disasters. I still can't believe how much talent this town was hiding.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Including Roddy. Who knew there was a real rock'n'roll hunk hiding under that hard hat? Right, Maddie?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, he did surprise everyone...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: After this, people will expect a festival every summer.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Maybe they should. Tonight feels special.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Careful, Maddie. Next year you might want to take to the stage, too!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Ask me again next summer!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did you see there's a storm coming? I think it's going to be a big one, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Yeah, I have tons of stuff to do before I can hunker down with a cup of tea and a blanket.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I know! There's so much I need to-- *Gasp*
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Jackie, come here quick... There's something moving under the leaves. Please tell me that's not another ferret.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: It's... an iguana??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: An iguana? In Hopewell Bay? During autumn? Sure, why not.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Oh, it's freezing cold! Look how sluggish it is. Poor thing probably took a very wrong turn somewhere.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: We can't leave it out here tonight. We have to warm it up somehow.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Okay... The final heat lamp is up.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Moment of truth. Look - it's lifting its head!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And moving closer to the heat! That's the most energy it's shown all day.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hey there, little guy. Welcome back.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at you climbing already!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Yesterday he could barely move. Now he's acting like he owns the yard.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: But we need to figure out where he came from... Someone might be missing him.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Let's see... Blink once if you have an owner!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Did he blink?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Hmmm... I don't think so. He really seems to enjoy that basking rock.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I guess that means he's staying with us for now.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maddie, your iguana is loose again.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: He's not loose. He's exploring.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: See? He's settled in so well. I'll really miss him when we find his real owner...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Umm, he's currently inside a flower pot staring at me suspiciously.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, that's normal. Reptiles can sense uncertainty.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Why do I suddenly feeljudged by a reptile?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The temperature's dropping again tonight. I'm worried the enclosure still isn't warm enough.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: You can feel it too, can't you?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I'll reinforce the wind barriers before the heat escapes and get extra greenhouse plants for insulation.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Thank you! Rascal is very grateful, too.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Rascal?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, he needed a name!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Look at this place... warm lights, tropical plants, cozy rocks.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Meanwhile, our guest is living better than the rest of Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Just look at that! I wish someone would build me a personal spa.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: It's hard to believe he was freezing under those leaves just a few days ago.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: And we happened to be in the right place at the right time!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Turns out Hopewell Bay's pretty good at keeping cold-blooded guests warm.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Me neither! But I promise I'll make it up to both of you.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whoah! What's in this old box? It weighs a ton.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Oh my goodness, look at these crystals! Some of them are labeled. Quartz, amethyst, agate... And a few aren't labeled at all.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: My ancestors collected rocks from around the world for generations. Things get misplaced.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Weren't they known for finding some pretty unusual stones? I think I read somewhere that some of them were discovered right here, in Hopewell Bay.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: It's true, but I don't know half of it. It's another secret Grandma is keeping from me...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: I think these treasures deserve to be shown off to the whole town. How about we put on a little showcase?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Maybe we'll find some answers along the way!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Here's the last box. Wait... why is it so heavy?
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: There's a huge gray rock inside! Let's handle it carefully. It might be fragile.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Carefully now... Don't trip over those box--
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Whooooah!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Maddie, are you okay??
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I'm fine, but the rock is not...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Wow! Look at those crystals!
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Well, we found our centerpiece.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: I keep finding more stones tucked into these boxes. Whoever packed this collection was very thorough.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Some of these have notes attached. Dates, locations...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: "Found along the northern cliffs, 1968." That's pretty specific. Imagine how many hands these passed through before ending up here.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: The labels on the display tables make such a difference. Visitors can learn what they're looking at.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: I've added magnifying glasses too. But this sample doesn't match any description we have.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Then the label must have been lost years ago.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Or nobody ever identified it properly.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Maddie
lines.text: Hmmm... Very intriguing.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: Look at those prisms! The sunlight is scattering rainbows everywhere.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: And these jars ofcolorful pebbles are gorgeous.
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Pearl
lines.text: But look at this! This stone has a strange shimmer. I wonder if it's rare...
lines.author: laitostarr777

lines.speaker: Jackie
lines.text: Let's just say unusual rocks have a habit of appearing around this family.
lines.author: laitostarr777
